{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"臣等謹案：六壬大全十二卷，不著撰人名氏。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928136704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"卷首題懷慶府推官郭載騋校，盖明代所刋","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928153088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928153088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬與遁甲、太乙，世謂之三式，而六壬其","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928169472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"傳尤古。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928169472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂出於黄帝元女，固屬無稽。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928185856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"要其","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928202240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"為術，固非後世方技家所能造。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928202240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵數根於","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928218624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376561355748442151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，而五行始於水，舉隂以起陽，故稱壬焉；","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928218624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"舉成以該生，故用六焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928218624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"其有天地盤與神將","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928235008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"加臨，雖漸近竒遁九宫之式，而由干支而有","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928235008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"四課，則亦兩儀四象也；由發用而有三傳，則","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928235008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"亦一生二，二生三，三生萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928235008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"以至六十四","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928251392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"課，莫不原本羲爻，盖亦易象之支流，推而衍","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928251392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"之者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928251392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"考國語伶州鳩對七律，以所稱夷則","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928267776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"上宮、大呂上宮推之，皆有合於六壬之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928267776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928284160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376561310001283123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"特以五音十二律定數，未可即指為六壬之","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928284160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"源。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928284160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"呉越春秋載伍員及范蠡雞鳴、日出、日映、","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761136655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"禺中四術，則時将加乘與龍蛇刑徳之用，一","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761136655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"如今世所傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761136655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"而越絶書載公孫聖亦有今日","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761153039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，時加南方之語。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761153039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"其事雖不見經傳，似出","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761169423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"依托。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761169423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"然趙煜、𡊮康皆後漢人，知其法著於漢","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761185807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"代也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761185807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"其書之見於史者，隋志二家，唐志六家，","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761202191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"宋志三十家，而焦竑經籍志所列多至八十","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761202191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376561355748425767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"三家，然多散佚不傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761202191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"其存者如徐道符心鏡、","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761218575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣日新開雲觀月歌、凌福之畢法賦及五變","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761218575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"中黃經，術家奉為蓍蔡。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761218575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"而流傳既久，其說多","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761234959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"岐，或専論課體而失之拘，或専主𩔖神而失","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761234959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"之麤，或雜取神煞而失之支，又皆不可以為","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761234959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"法。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761234959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"是書總集諸書遺文，首載入手法、總鈐及","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761251343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神、月将、徳煞、加臨、喜忌，旁采唐以来諸論，","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761251343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"若括囊、雲霄賦、課經之類，而緯以心鏡、觀月","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761251343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376561497041797158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"諸篇，採撮頗為詳備。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761251343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"案明史藝文志有袁祥","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761267727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬大全三十三卷，名目相同，而卷帙不符，","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761267727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"未必即祥所輯。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761267727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"要其博綜簡括，固六壬家之","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761284111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"總滙也。","logicSentenceId":"76790680 {"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"徳者，福祐之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047267855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"凡臨日入傳，能轉凶為吉，其名有四：","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047284239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四徳入傳皆吉，日徳尤吉，俱宜生旺，不宜休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047284239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"凡徳入傳，忌逢空落空，及神将外戰。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047300623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562106939981851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"凡三合入傳，主事闗牽連，必過月方能了結，又主親識","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047579151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1766,"lineType":1,"content":"朋儕衆多之應。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047579151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"凡三合入傳，缺一神，若日辰偶足之，名凑合格。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047628303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"主有意","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047644687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1778,"lineType":1,"content":"外和合之事，以所凑乘神决之。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047644687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1778,"lineType":2,"content":"如凑足者是貴人，即主貴人提携之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"凡中正合，乘貴人，主貴人成就，見貴得喜，與徳神併，能","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047759375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"解諸凶。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047759375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"若與隂后玄六相乗於夘酉，主有貴入奸邪","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047775759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1790,"lineType":1,"content":"不正之事。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047775759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"凡仁義合，乗吉神，主內外和合，作事端肅。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047792143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"若乗陰六玄","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047808527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"后，臨夘酉，主假仁義以行奸邪之事。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047808527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"凡威權合，乗吉神，主施威徳，佈號令，觀兵耀武。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047824911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"若乗凶","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047841295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562106940031003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1800,"lineType":1,"content":"神，主挾令凌下，卑幼勉强承順。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088047841295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"凡合與徳同入傳，百事皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088067289122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"即㑹凶神，亦主凶中和合。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088067305506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562125931544639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1818,"lineType":1,"content":"凡合入傳，視其進退，傳進利進，傳退利退，百事如意。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088067321890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1820,"lineType":1,"content":"凡寅合亥為破合，巳合申為刑合。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088067338274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1820,"lineType":1,"content":"主謀事合而不合，成","logicSentenceId":"7677113088067354658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"而不成。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088067354658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"若得貴、青、徳、禄乗之，仍主順利。","logicSentenceId":"7677113088067371042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人順逆，為吉凶之分。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618727604243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"又看侍從之神，在吉則吉，在凶","logicSentenceId":"7666016618727620627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"則凶，諸神將倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618727620627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"論：螣蛇在天事：天乙為車騎都尉，雷部鞭馭之神，位居","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728882195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"前一家丁已火旺，六十日凶將也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728882195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇為太乙，照","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728898579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"則福生，過則禍生。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728898579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事造釁發端者，此神也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728914963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"既過之","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728931347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"後，風火刀兵，大刼小盗，流災凶旱，風水蟊賊，蟲毒疾","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728931347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"疫，多行暗道，私匿婦人，姙孕不明事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728931347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"愛陰虎龍玄","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728947731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562201378684955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"后，畏戌。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618728947731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"類為文華金火，每物變異，為金火之精。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749149190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"于人為驚狂婦","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749165574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"人，或作熒惑小人。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749165574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"于祟水木土神，或不葬客鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749181958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"于病","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749198342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"為頭目四肢癰腫見血。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749198342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"于五榖為豆黍。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749214726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"于獸為蛇蛟。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749231110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"受味甘羙，食物色紅赤數四。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749247494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"雀吉，得地，主文章印信、勑命服色、王庭事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749362182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"失地則凶，主","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749378566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1324,"lineType":1,"content":"火燭焚煌，口舌生病，公訟文字，財物損失，馬畜灾傷","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749378566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"等事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749378566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"若旺相披刑帶殺，為害必深，反此則淺。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749394950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749411334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"公事，雀逆理，刑賊日干，官必嗔責，反此無害。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749411334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"占科","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749427718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1330,"lineType":1,"content":"塲與投獻文策，雀不入傳，亦須尋討。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749427718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1330,"lineType":1,"content":"最愛為歲月建","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749444102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562199956963339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1334,"lineType":1,"content":"與月將并，不然與歲月日相合，帶禄附馬，并德加臨","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749444102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺之地，文策必中。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618749444102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1336, {"lines":[{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"六合主婚姻喜慶信息，求望交易、胎産、媒妁牙保、陰私","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832805951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"財物交契，木植船車之𧰼。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832805951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"其戻主陰刑不明，先喜後","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832822335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"憂，小人女子之過，傷失六畜之象。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832822335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"又云六合主門户","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832838719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"道路，更改變遷。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832838719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"　凡六合乘旺相，氣相生，順理而入，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832855103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562199294214159"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"用傳者，的主婚姻或胎産，喜陰私財物。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832855103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"若死囚刑克，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832871487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"則主財物口舌，陰人煩撓。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832871487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"　六合乘酉戌，多主奴婢","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832887871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"走失。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618832887871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1446,"lineTyp {"lines":[{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"賦六合之神，婚姻嘉㑹在亥，為待命平和。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833084479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"在已則不諧","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833100863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"驚悖。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833100863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"在子。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833117247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"反目兮，無禮之事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833133631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"在酉，私竄兮，不明之因。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833150015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"乘輅在寅，結髮在申。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833166399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"從媒妁而成歡，皆主婚姻喜羙。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833182783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"違禮在辰，亡羞在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833199167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"因妄冒而加罪，皆主婚姻訟事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833215551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"升堂在午，入室在卯，并為婚姻就已之占。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833231935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"納采在未，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833248319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562201378766875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":1478,"lineType":1,"content":"麗粧在丑，總是 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"論：勾陳在天為大將軍，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833756223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":1520,"lineType":2,"content":"一云左將軍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"雷部中作喚雲神，位居","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833756223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"前四家，戊辰土旺，四季凶將也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833756223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"　勾陳乃宫中殺炁，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833772607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":1524,"lineType":1,"content":"職任将軍，得地則上令兵威，失地則兵卒不利，持重","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833772607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"威權，又為兵甲守門之吏，大好争訟，多蓄二心。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833772607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833788991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":1528,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮帶弔，則為不孝之神。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833788991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":1528,"lineType":1,"content":"愛玄空，畏龍后，不立四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833805375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562201378799643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":1532,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳主兵戈、官訟、公事、印信虎符、留連皮革，或争田宅、","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833821759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"土舎財帛、占望信息，財帛出行，俱主留滯。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833821759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"其戾主病，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833838143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇厄牽罣，財物損失。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833838143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"庶人得之如此。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833854527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"若官員見之，乃","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833870911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":1538,"lineType":1,"content":"為印綬，盛則吉，衰則凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833870911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":1538,"lineType":1,"content":"　凡占訟，先以勾陳為主，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833887295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":1540,"lineType":1,"content":"如勾陳賊日，理難伸。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833887295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":1540,"lineType":1,"content":"雪日克勾陳，訟得理伸。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833903679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":1540,"lineType":1,"content":"又忌勾","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833920063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"之陰神，附蛇、鼠、雀，帶殺克日者，最凶。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618833920063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":1542,"lineType {"lines":[{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":1678,"lineType":1,"content":"賦：青龍財喜，多主亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850533382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":1678,"lineType":1,"content":"伏陸在酉，允宜退守。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850549766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":1678,"lineType":1,"content":"蟠泥在丑，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850566150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"所謀未稱。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850566150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"登魁在戌兮，小人爭財。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850582534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天在已兮，君子","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850598918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"欲動。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850598918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"乘雲在寅，驅雷在卯，宜于營運利進。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850615302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"摧角在申，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850631686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"無鱗在未，宜乎安静動凶。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850631686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"午焚身，辰掩目，縁財有不","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850648070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"測之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850648070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"子入海，亥逰江，囚，動有非常之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850664454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

icSentenceId":"7666016618850828294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"無毛損才，憂官府。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850828294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"若妻有孕，動揺即無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850844678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子俱主","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850861062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"舟車財帛之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618850861062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"亥又主婚姻。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920542271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"一説子乘龍合，女占必","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920558655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"受皇恩。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920558655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：子午乘龍，妻妾懐孕，不然家蔵孕婦。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920575039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"論：天空在天為司直官，雷部中為黄埃塵霧之神，又為","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920771647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"渴雨神，位居後六家，戊戌土旺，四季凶將也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920771647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"　天空","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920788031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562201378947099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"乃陽土之神，燥灰之土，為中央最𤰞之位，列奴婢之","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920788031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"行，為天地之雜氣，作人間之詐神。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920788031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"得地則當直之吏，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920804415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"非多是少，妄起事謀。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920804415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"失地則奴辱婢舌，或顯或隠，動","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920820799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"無濟物之心，静有妖氛之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920820799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"愛元后，畏龍，合陰雀，不","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920837183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":1738,"lineType":1,"content":"立四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920837183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"天空主奴婢公吏市井小人財帛言約私契。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920853567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"其戻主奴","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920869951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"婢口舌，脱空不實，虚偽巧詐，是非毁敗之事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920869951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"以其為","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920886335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡寂滅之神，即空亡之類也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920886335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"若在辰戌丑未四宫，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920902719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562201378963483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之天空閉，亦可以成小，不可成大事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920902719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"其或順理，旺","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920919103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"氣相生，主財帛喜。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920919103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"奴婢小人同心，更帶財星及天喜","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920935487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"者，必因小人獲財也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920935487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"不然因僧道獲財，或因虚詐有","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920951871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"功。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920951871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"　花瓶記曰：天空安居，有言不虚。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920968255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗夏占鑄鍾，天","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920984639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"空附火，發用旺相相生，鍾遂成，止有小釁。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618920984639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"占詞訟，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921001023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":1758,"lineType":1,"content":"最愛天空發用及終傳，主訟解，謀不成。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921001023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":1758,"lineType":1,"content":"若求財物，又","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921017407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"深忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921017407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"一説加臨日干旺相，主作營運行商。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921033791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚，","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921050175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":1762,"lineType":1,"content":"天空發用及臨日辰者，其家必有孤寡之人。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921050175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":1762,"lineType":1,"content":"不然更","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921066559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562201378979867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":1766,"lineType":1,"content":"徙祖業。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921066559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":1766,"lineType":1,"content":"　占奴河魁，婢從魁，皆以天空為主星，要天","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921082943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":1768,"lineType":1,"content":"空乘神與干支生合，無克賊則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921082943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":1768,"lineType":1,"content":"不然主逃走，更值","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921099327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":1770,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡，其僕不良。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921099327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":1770,"lineType":1,"content":"占行動，主道路𤰞賤相損。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921115711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":1770,"lineType":1,"content":"　占赴","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921132095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"試奏對，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921132095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"天空乃奏書之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921148479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"　託人謀事，最防","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921164863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":1774,"lineType":1,"content":"虚詐。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921164863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":1774,"lineType":1,"content":"占宅墓，若宅墓上見水神，或門户上見天空","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921181247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"併者，必主水道垣墻壅塞，泥淤不便。","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921181247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓者，宫音，宅","logicSentenceId":"7666016618921197631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":1778,"lineType":1,"content":"在未，墓在辰。"," {"lines":[{"lineId":"2642","lineNum":2246,"lineType":1,"content":"論天后在天事，天乙為后妃。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021828159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2643","lineNum":2246,"lineType":1,"content":"雷部陰霖霧雨之神，位居","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021844543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2644","lineNum":2248,"lineType":1,"content":"前一家。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021844543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2645","lineNum":2248,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子水旺，冬三月吉將也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021860927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2646","lineNum":2248,"lineType":1,"content":"　天后，六陰之極，","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021877311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2647","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562216650407986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2648","lineNum":2252,"lineType":1,"content":"北方黑帝之五女，處人臣之位，任用財物，為陰户之","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021877311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2649","lineNum":2254,"lineType":1,"content":"事，掌握后宫，配貴人，多柔順，主遲滯。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021877311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2650","lineNum":2254,"lineType":1,"content":"體天地之至位，","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021893695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2651","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"作羣侯之慈母。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021893695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2652","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"得地則清真亷㓗，髙貴尊崇；失地則","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021910079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2653","lineNum":2258,"lineType":1,"content":"淫濫奸邪，雜亂人倫。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021910079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2654","lineNum":2258,"lineType":1,"content":"愛龍常貴合畏勾空土神，不立","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021926463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2655","lineNum":2260,"lineType" {"lines":[{"lineId":"2656","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"天后主宫庭隂私喜慶，婦人財物，婚姻胎産與賞赦慶","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021942847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2657","lineNum":2264,"lineType":1,"content":"賀恩澤。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021942847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2658","lineNum":2264,"lineType":1,"content":"其戾，主帷簿不修，陰私不明，欺詐不實，口舌","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021959231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2659","lineNum":2266,"lineType":1,"content":"走失。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021959231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2660","lineNum":2266,"lineType":1,"content":"　凡占后乘太歲加日臨門户，主恩赦之兆立","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021975615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2661","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562216650424370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2662","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"至。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021975615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2663","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"更值三陽三光尤准，占公事最宜見之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619021991999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2664","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"如不臨門","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022008383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2665","lineNum":2272,"lineType":1,"content":"户，但入課傳者，則主遲慢。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022008383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2666","lineNum":2272,"lineType":1,"content":"　天后所乘神，切忌下賊","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022024767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2667","lineNum":2274,"lineType":1,"content":"上，必有小人凌辱之事。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022024767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2668","lineNum":2274,"lineType":1,"content":"葢后是皇后星，女弱之象，不","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022041151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2669","lineNum":2276,"lineType":1,"content":"宜為下所制也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022041151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2670","lineNum":2276,"lineType":1,"content":"　占婚宜后與日相生，及三六合者","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022057535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2671","lineNum":2278,"lineType":1,"content":"成，反此不成。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022057535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2672","lineNum":2278,"lineType":1,"content":"天后克日干，女貪男不肯。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022073919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2673","lineNum":2278,"lineType":1,"content":"日干克天后，","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022090303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2674","lineNum":2280,"lineType":1,"content":"男貪女而女不肯。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022090303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2675","lineNum":2280,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦傳大吉，主先阻後成。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022106687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2676","lineNum":2280,"lineType":1,"content":"天后乘","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022123071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2677","lineNum":2282,"lineType":1,"content":"神，可以定女子性情容貌。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022123071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2678","lineNum":2282,"lineType":1,"content":"　天后乘馬，命見解神，主","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022139455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2679","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"隂人離别。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022139455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2680","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"后隂作玄，暗昧不明。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022155839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2681","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"后陰作虎，主妻病凶。","logicSentenceId":"7666016619022172223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562229392457728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null, {"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病傷財禍轉惡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638456335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":240,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：若與日相生，不克戰，所求皆吉。更有氣不落空亡，或居福徳位上建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":242,"lineType":2,"content":"無内戰，宜求財幹事。若青龍克日，主破財。若作白虎隂神，魚克日，必死。若落空亡，則不凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562230625779724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎皆凶須見詳，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638538255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"男女分占斷死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638554639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"免死須歸道路傍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638587407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":260,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：白虎陽神克日，主女子得之必死。白虎隂神克日，主男子得之必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":262,"lineType":2,"content":"健者主病，病者主死。如白虎加卯酉臨門，如不見凶，必有出入之理，謂白虎主道路也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"太常無克歡事寜，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638603791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562230625828876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"事因酒食起官刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638652943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":272,"lineType":2,"content":"太常不克日，主酒食，賔客歡樂。如克日，雖聚㑹更妨，因酒飯筵㑹起官事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":274,"lineType":2,"content":"破財同勾陳克日最凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武相刑忌賊傷，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638669327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"破財官事主逃亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638685711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":278,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：不克日無妨，克日主逃亡，遺失財，或隻目人，或奸盗人相害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"類與日辰無戰克，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638702095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"凶中就吉却無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638718479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":282,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：元武乗惡煞，與日不克，何畏生日，宜求橫財于隂私中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰克日起奸私，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638734863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"終有陰人撓訟詞。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638751247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":286,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：太陰克日主奸淫，若乗寅申，口舌自消。同元武主暗昧破財。若在末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562233851150346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":290,"lineType":2,"content":"傳，繫不克日，不用　奸神，春寅、夏亥、秋申、冬已。　邪神正未逆行十二支，若太陰與二神並，必起奸邪事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"更同卯酉為合類，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638767631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"同凶為惡定不疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638784015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"天后相刑暗昧生，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638800399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"不逢戰克必婚成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638816783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":298,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：天后克今日，主隂人口舌不明事。若臨沭浴之方，或亥子卯酉，亦主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":300,"lineType":2,"content":"淫亂，起口舌，無戰克，宜求婚親，又宜求婦人之財也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"子亥卯酉同傳者，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638833167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"必見奸邪在獄庭。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638849551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":304,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：若天后乗亥子卯酉，更初傳乘沭浴，主奸事。更有勾陳克日，主官事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562233851215882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":308,"lineType":2,"content":"至，牢獄不明也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":310,"lineType":9,"content":"二字訣","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638865935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳日辰並來期。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638898703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"見其二字决凶疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638931471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":318,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：三傳為三件，行年本命為二件，太嵗來方，日上辰上正時共十件，占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":320,"lineType":2,"content":"課不出十件物事，其吉凶。日上三傳本命行年六處最𦂳，外四事亦可思。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"寅亥遇之身主病，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638947855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":322,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：課内三傳年命，日上若見寅亥，有氣克日，無救，即主病。若更今日乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562233851199498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"行之道，或六處有一處見白虎旺相克日者，即應矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辰逢處獄囚遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638964239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":328,"lineType":2,"content":"課中三傳年命，日上若見寅辰，主官事。再論日行之道，及六處有勾陳，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":330,"lineType":2,"content":"朱雀克日，宜言官事。若不見勾陳克日，只初傳與日在囚墓之中，亦主官事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"子卯當逢占賊盗。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638980623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":332,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：課有子卯，主賊盗。若更有𤣥武克日，或𤣥武克財，亦應。又如不見𤣥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":334,"lineType":2,"content":"武克日、克財，只見日財落空及受下尅，亦主盗賊失財。又如不見財落空及下克，只見財乗𤣥武，為財去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":336,"lineType":2,"content":"從賊。元武陰神克日，必見不明，損財事，臨時細詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"馬見已亥在路岐。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443638997007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":338,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：己亥主出入，若六處中有玄武乘天驛馬，六丁逰神，主取財在外方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":340,"lineType":2,"content":"又天上正時加馬，逺行亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562233851166730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"丑入午傳多咀呪。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639013391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":344,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：六處有丑午，主呪罵口舌。更六處有朱雀，准驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"酉未加之姑嫂離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639029775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":346,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：未為離神，酉為孤煞，二煞中建干克日，在六處必見離别夫婦。又更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":348,"lineType":2,"content":"隔角准應，隔角煞乃未立辰未戌丑，酉立午酉子卯，皆名為隔角煞。若行年，更立離神准應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"要知心中多猶豫，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639046159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"勝光傳送事疑惑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639062543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":352,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：申為肺，乃傳送，午為心，午加申主心有疑惑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"河魁行年臨玄武，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639078927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"身主鬚鬍事不疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639095311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":356,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：河魁為𤣥武，建干尅日，即有一鬚鬍人相害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562245871894582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神復行凶神位。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639128079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":362,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：甲日用申酉，或建干庚辛為白虎，在三傳年命日上，更在今日三刑、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":364,"lineType":2,"content":"四煞、六冲、六害，轉凶。若白虎在今日，三六合貴神，干合雖凶，亦减半矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"帶煞被刑無制度。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639144463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":366,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：論凶神、凶將帶煞，更坐三刑、六害、四煞相冲，地下無制，大凶。若坐下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":368,"lineType":2,"content":"克上，凶神有制，其凶稍减分數。戊日寅為白虎，帶煞更臨亥地，故曰被刑，大凶，主死也。若亥中干克寅，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":370,"lineType":2,"content":"凶减半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"救也不救復來傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443639160847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":372,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：若白虎帶煞被刑，克日即凶。若三傳年命日上，却克得白虎為救神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":374,"lineType":2,"content":"更㸔誰先到。若救神先到即吉，後到即不用。如戊日寅為白虎加亥，亥中水生木，必先到，主必凶。若庚辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":376,"lineType":2,"content":"申酉在三傳，被下制，雖在三合有路，却遇四煞、三刑相冲六害為有制，后到即不救不用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"凶吉應期看日助。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187325492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":528,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：俱忌今日干與正時落墓，或白虎、天后、螣蛇入墓，雖不見克日亦死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":530,"lineType":2,"content":"如不見入墓，却今日干臨在死絶地，亦凶。雖有救神、解神，亦不可用。若一歲至十五嵗，是小兒，忌螣蛇，克","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"日，必死。是女兒，忌螣蛇，陰神克日，必死。又十五嵗至五十，男子忌白虎，氣弱凶。女人忌白虎，陰神、天后，炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":534,"lineType":2,"content":"衰尅日，亦主死。又五十至九十，男忌白虎旺尅，女忌天后旺，即死。老年婦人不宜見天后旺也。白虎入墓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":536,"lineType":2,"content":"壮嵗畏，老年不畏矣。此論白虎陰陽男女與前異，并存之。　後課主病，又係小兒𩔖。日上神白虎遁庚午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":538,"lineType":2,"content":"克日，主死。陰神得六合，亦時遁得庚戌克日，又行年見螣蛇，皆凶。以螣蛇在行年，故謂小兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562233851281418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮車鍬钁臨門戸。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187341876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":542,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：己為䘮車，申為鍬，酉為钁，占病忌此三神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"也須沈滯災難度。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187391028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":550,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：課中白虎克日，更五行入墓，又有䘮車等煞，縱有救神，合輕亦難度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":552,"lineType":2,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plwy7sxg/1-SK1599_figure_00015.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VQ%2FO2vdqAm%2FYHYETTSqjqc9uv%2Fc%3D","pictureHeight":1246,"pictureWidth":212,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plwy7sxg/1-SK1599_figure_00015.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ANYrQSLvBKqgFBGpUmk9ZvVWQp8%3D","uri":"read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plwy7sxg/1-SK1599_figure_00015.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562245389647887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"日上救神當正時。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187407412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":558,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：得白虎等凶克日，占病主死。若日上神却克白虎，為救便不死。若更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"日上神，當時有氣，所事不畏矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562256282222602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"夲命上，得戌克日為白虎，主病凶，有死之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187489332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"却日上","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187505716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為救神，當時能克制白虎，是以不死。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187505716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"日上有救，諸","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187522100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"病不成凶，名曰患門有救耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187522100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"若無重數虎當頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187636788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":596,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：占病形状，若初傳犯重祌，主病急，先怕克氣，後怕白虎，克日即死。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":598,"lineType":2,"content":"初傳重神克炁，白虎不克日，雖病重不妨。如初傳非重神，只取白虎，亦不礙。氣者，日干之長生　上神也，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":600,"lineType":2,"content":"重神不得地，不得令，亦不妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"用神為太乙，　螣蛇病在頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187702324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":612,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：己為螣蛇，俱是火，火炎上，旺主喘𠻳敗，衰則主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":614,"lineType":2,"content":"目赤、口瘡、頭痛，重旺主咽喉災，此即重神也，乃指将神而言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"五行五臓待醫知。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187980852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":666,"lineType":2,"content":"註曰：男以辰加行年，女以戊加行年。男用天上功曺方求醫，女用傳送下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":668,"lineType":2,"content":"求醫。醫神臨亥，宜服湯藥。醫神臨辰、戌、丑、未，宜丸藥。醫神臨木，必主有祟。是火宜灸，是金宜針，餘倣此。天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":670,"lineType":2,"content":"醫克日，主醫人用藥不當。日克天醫，主醫人學醫未精。月當直醫神，月建前二便是天醫，今日前二辰為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":672,"lineType":2,"content":"當日，當直天醫，對冲便是地醫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":674,"lineType":9,"content":"照膽秘訣集","logicSentenceId":"7679070602187997236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗月為用，天乙將來占，必定于君王。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188013620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":678,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：太嵗作貴人，月建為𤼵用。如乘吉神，定于王敕主成。乘凶將，死氣遭刑，必然聞奏朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562245389713423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗后臨初年，將良遭囚，得此赦者塲。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188030004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":684,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：太嵗乃人君之象，天后乃皇后之象，行年日辰為用，占囚定遇赦恩解厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗天羅枷械蔵，嵗刑白虎見重䘮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188046388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":688,"lineType":2,"content":"日前一辰天羅殺太歲若入天羅，有刑害，主枷械用神。若是嵗刑，又為死氣，克干日辰，主死人重見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗刑其日建刑辰，福去災臨有禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188062772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":692,"lineType":2,"content":"假如丑年辛已日，丑為用，為刑日也。又如已日正月寅，用是建刑辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗破用神多是失月刑，家口不安康。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188079156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":696,"lineType":2,"content":"用神被嵗破，更乗天空𤣥武，主走失嵗，為之四破。若用被月破殺，又直虎蛇無氣，将主家長不安。月刑寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562245389729807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":700,"lineType":2,"content":"刑己，己刑申是也。嵗刑亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"日刑殺到憂妻妾，時刑陰小有災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188095540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":704,"lineType":2,"content":"用是日刑，又值虎蛇，主妻妾災。勾陳又主官事。各用時刑，更與鬼克。日值朱句，隂小官事。蛇虎主疾病，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"寅己申刑之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"占宅忌見辰克日，鬬戰先㸔日克辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188111924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":710,"lineType":2,"content":"日為人，辰為宅，宅克人凶。若鬬爭財物，要日克辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"用時尅日多暗鈍，欲謀定可為災迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188128308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":714,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲日申時，又為用更囚死凶将，謀望不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562245872091190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"發用占時兩生日，百事有求從意覔。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188144692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":720,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲日得亥，時更亥子，發用乘吉将，旺相大佳，主得尊長之恵，有合徳方的。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害兩人，忌為鬼謀間行盗，人財毁。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188161076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":724,"lineType":2,"content":"註云三刑六害。若作日鬼加支局上，主官府損財。如加于局上，主惡人損退，人　口悲泣事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"支干上下休蔵鬼，定是災凶人財起。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188177460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":728,"lineType":2,"content":"註云蔵鬼者，如午日亥加午作朱雀，謂午日以亥水為鬼，上見朱雀，又被亥水作鬼，故鬼勝也。又如乙日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":730,"lineType":2,"content":"酉加辰，作六合，並被酉金作鬼，故逾災也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"財須分别內𠔥外，求用無令鬼耗㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188193844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562256282271754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":736,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：日財為外，支財為内，如日財臨辰兩課，名外財入内，圖用遂意；支財入日兩課，宜出則吉。若或良將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":738,"lineType":2,"content":"相加，氣不死廢，必進財。如乗太嵗二耗，乃日鬼休死，不須用，皆主不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"將神有類支干與，此中內外要詳慮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188210228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":742,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：前論日為外，辰為内，殊不知類神内外，且如甲子以青龍為外，天后為内，㸔青龍臨辰二位，為進人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":744,"lineType":2,"content":"口，乃外事；以天后臨日二位，主内事或動，以此前知則不悮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"日陰尅日日戴墓，暗鈍抑塞多齟齬。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188226612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":748,"lineType":2,"content":"假如戊午日，卯加辰，庚寅日，午加丑，主暗鈍屈伏，抑塞不足之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"辰陰刑辰罡處孟，定招𤰞㓜驚惶横。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188242996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562245872074806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":754,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲子日，戌加亥，是第四課，尅支為鬼，乃天罡加孟，主殺在𤰞㓜，驚𢙢不寜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽間尅傳蔵課，內外縈心成慮破。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188259380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":758,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：間尅乃日陽制辰陽，辰隂制日隂，此名雜濫，主内外不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"正課用神傷日辰，家門長㓜不安存。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188275764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":760,"lineType":2,"content":"三傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":762,"lineType":2,"content":"假如戊已日，得卯木，𤼵用曲直。又如甲乙日，得酉，發用從革，主父母不安。又如申日得午，𤼵用炎上，寅日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":764,"lineType":2,"content":"得酉，發用從革，主卑㓜不安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"傳凶陰吉驚無實，傳吉隂凶吉不真。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188292148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":768,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲申日，初傳臼虎，末傳螣蛇為救，主驚不實。又如臨日初六合末太陰為破。喜亦空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562245389762575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"順喜當觀母用兒，數憂何棄課扶持。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188308532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":774,"lineType":2,"content":"註云母傳子，乃春傳夏也。假如甲乙日，用午，是相氣，為子孫之神，在傳能御克木之金為救，取拘絆扶散","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":776,"lineType":2,"content":"憂疑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"用空傳復支與干，舊乆重新廢欲完。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188324916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":780,"lineType":2,"content":"註云空亡本无氣之兆，作用而中末復歸日辰上者，主重用事復求意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽互尅𠔥不備，元合天后多私意。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188341300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":784,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲子日，戌加寅上。又如辛丑日，酉加已，例此二課，主夫婦失義不和好，此名蕪淫課也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"傳化為陰分事端，兩途","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188357684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":786,"lineType":2,"content":"闕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"忘㸔","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188357684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":786,"lineType":2,"content":"寅辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562256282337290"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":790,"lineType":2,"content":"假如己日占見功曹為用，主尊者不和，此乃寅中有生火，凌己中生金。雖生火，乃刑金之物動也，此例不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":792,"lineType":2,"content":"可不明。又如罡加寅上，亦上下不和，雖木克土為財，殊不知辰中廢水，克下生火故也。凡遇生克，當自裁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":794,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"戌加卯上是合鄉，傳中支干理偏長。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188374068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛戊癸正相當，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188390452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"信至人歸見福昌。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188390452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":800,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰：卯加戌，合也；己加子，亦為合也。為三傳俱合，此𧰼主信至外歸之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡化鬼冲臨宅，魑魅蔵家䘮服白。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188406836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":804,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：天魁為墳，天罡為墓，若化鬼臨支，為蔵伏尸。魑魅冲支，亦主宅𤼵怪。若不化鬼，定有持服之色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562256282320906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡作鬼臨年上，下賊侵凌暗酬黨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188423220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":810,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：魁罡為奴賊凶惡人，元武為盗賊神，幷日鬼加年，主有連累不明事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"比合河魁兩同用，心謀不一或干衆。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188439604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":814,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：比合同心，魁為衆事，占之此卦主心意不定，或有干連衆人事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"罡乘天后陰人忌，有孕切慮傷胎氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188455988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":818,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：天罡為土水天后之墓，𠔥為東南𤰞濕之辰，天后為厭醫，如婦人行年有此孕，主足月傷胎，老㓜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":820,"lineType":2,"content":"腹病之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁太乙墓同虎臨支宅有衣麻服","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188472372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":822,"lineType":2,"content":"已酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562256282288138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":826,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：太乙為䘮車，從魁為白服，五墓死氣，白虎哭神，如并加支上，必主有持服人為用的。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"天傾西北日月隨，地陷東南江海歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188488756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"已亥歉然不用疑，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188505140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"重求輕得吿君知。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602188505140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":830,"lineType":2,"content":"已亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":832,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰：西北，亥地也，天傾西北。東南，己地也，地䧟東南。天地尚且不足，况於人乎？求三得二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
