{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"假使金神臨火上，末傳遇水必無他。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418241576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有災殃自消散，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418257960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"湏知福祿重嵬峩","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418257960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":982,"lineType":2,"content":"儻得土神，亦成吉慶。他皆倣此推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"已前秘訣雖陳露，猶恐三傳吉凶悮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418274344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"假使土上用水神，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418290728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562267954954281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"末傳木救無憂懼。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418290728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然無救将復凶，未便極凶仍更慮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418307112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"如還年上吉神臨，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418323496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"遙克凶神何必怖。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418323496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":994,"lineType":2,"content":"假令正月癸未日寅時，占以登明加時，河魁臨癸水，上克下為用。将得白虎，凶将，中傳小吉。将得太隂，末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":996,"lineType":2,"content":"傳天罡。将得螣蛇，此三傳皆克癸日，又首尾俱凶将，三傳俱不救也。如人行年二十八嵗，行年在癸巳，上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":998,"lineType":2,"content":"見功曹為六合，是木乃遥克三傳土神，即為救神，必轉禍為福也。如行年在寅，木亦遙克三傳為救也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1000,"lineType":2,"content":"人行年立中，上見天乙為貴神，亦為救也。縁天乙貴人，至尊之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"用生終死憂最深，用死終生吉相聚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418339880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562267955019817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1006,"lineType":2,"content":"生者，是五行之所生之神也。死者，是五行所葬之地。假令甲乙日初傳登明，末傳小吉。丙丁日發用功曺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1008,"lineType":2,"content":"末傳河魁，是用生終死也。庚辛日初用大吉，末傳太乙；壬癸日初用天罡，末見傳送，是用死終生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"順道用傳母見兒，失禮還因子傳母。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418356264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"順則為和失則旋，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418372648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"此是三傳真秘語。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418372648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1014,"lineType":2,"content":"初傳母，末傳子，順道也。初傳見子，末傳見母，是失禮也。順道即為喜羙，失禮則為悖逆，所作稽留疑惑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1016,"lineType":2,"content":"初用㓛曺木，末見勝光。火為初見，用未見子，謂木生火也。　假令初用神后水，末傳傳送金。是初用子而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1018,"lineType":2,"content":"末見母，為水本生於金也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"喜不喜兮親與踈。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418389032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰之下辨相遇，母臨於子為和喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418405416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562267954970665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"交克魁罡事必踈。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418421800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1026,"lineType":2,"content":"假令甲日神后水臨甲木，是母臨於子為喜也。若還魁罡土臨甲，是下克為踈，不羙矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"初凶後吉終須吉，初吉後凶漸多凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418438184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇徳生名有救，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418454568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢刑殺惡神窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418454568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1030,"lineType":2,"content":"徳者得也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1032,"lineType":2,"content":"若三傳中遇徳神、生神者，卦雖凶而為救神，其凶可解也。若三傳卦凶，更犯三刑凶将者，其凶尤更深也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1034,"lineType":2,"content":"假令三月癸已日午時占月将，從魁加時，傳送金臨已火，下克上為用，是犯三刑也。謂己刑申，又更下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1036,"lineType":2,"content":"克上，為逆用也。　假令五月已亥日申時，以小吉加時，河魁臨亥為用。五月死氣在河魁，刼煞在亥，是下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1038,"lineType":2,"content":"克上，俱有凶神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562267955003433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰救之其事緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418470952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳用救急能和。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418487336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1044,"lineType":2,"content":"若三傳俱凶，却日辰上祌救之，其事緩慢。如三傳中有救神者，即變凶為吉也。　　假令正月丙辰日辰時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1046,"lineType":2,"content":"占，以登明加時，勝光火臨亥水為用。初傳勝光将得白虎，中傳大吉将得朱雀，末傳傳送将得𤣥武。三傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1048,"lineType":2,"content":"俱犯日辰，神将俱凶。日辰上神見神后，登明貴神遙克白虎凶神，此名日辰上神救三傳也。　假令正月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1050,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子日卯時，占以登明加時，河魁臨寅為初傳，中傳勝光，末傳功曹。河魁臨寅，下克上，雖凶神，却被末傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1052,"lineType":2,"content":"功曹克之。更功曹為日之徳神，更末傳克初傳。更用死終生，傳母見子，皆是三傳相救者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"日徳支徳并生氣，竒神天德解儀科。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418503720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"此上七神衝作救，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418520104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"日，年傳末記伊何。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418520104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031134772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"凶卦遇之凶漸止，吉卦遇之吉慶多。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418536488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"日上陰陽非屬已，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418552872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上陰陽匪為他。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418552872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1064,"lineType":2,"content":"日上陰陽為用，事非止於自已。辰上陰陽為用，非止他人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"陰內陽外各有理，陰往陽來可知委。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418569256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"陰主伏兮陽主行，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418585640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"隂暗損財陽損明。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418585640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1070,"lineType":2,"content":"用日辰之隂神主内事，用日辰之陽神主外事。日辰之陰神主彼事，日辰之陽神主自已之行事。日辰之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1072,"lineType":2,"content":"陰神主暗損財物，日辰之陽神主明損財物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽配在剛柔位，內外男女此中情。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418602024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日下克內憂女，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418618408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562267954987049"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1078,"lineType":1,"content":"若有上克外男驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418618408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"柔日下克還用外，上克下時凶內興。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418634792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"日克神兮神克將，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418651176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"事從於內定吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418651176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"將克神兮神克日，吉凶自外决枯榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418667560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡上下并蛇虎，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418683944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚為死旺為生。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418683944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1088,"lineType":2,"content":"魁罡凶神，蛇虎凶将，此二神二将相為用者，或在傳中得四時之旺相氣。若病者，生獄可脱也。若為用帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1090,"lineType":2,"content":"四時休囚死氣者，病者即重獄未得脱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相為多休廢少，更将物氣證其情。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418700328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"旺則相乘十數之，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418716712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031183924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"相氣因而倍更精。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418716712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1098,"lineType":2,"content":"凡用神及三傳帶旺相氣者，為多數也。若用神及三傳帶休囚廢氣者，數之少者，更将物氣卦證其由也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1100,"lineType":2,"content":"若旺相神則相乘其数而進一位，是十數之也。　　假令功曹臨辰為用，是旺神者，即功曹數七，辰數五也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1102,"lineType":2,"content":"五七三十五也。數進一位，則是三百五十，或三千五百也。若用相氣神者，以少因多數而更倍之。　假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1104,"lineType":2,"content":"太乙臨申為用，太乙數四，申數七，四七二十八，更倍之，即五十六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"休言本數莫疑惑，死囚折减數皆輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418733096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"支干之數翻復筭，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418749480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"拘檢卦內見其名。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418749480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1110,"lineType":2,"content":"若言休氣神者，只言本支干數也。　假令神后臨戌為用，神后數九，戌數五，五魚九是十四也。若用死囚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562256282419210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1114,"lineType":2,"content":"氣神者，即减其數，折半言之也。　假令從魁臨丙為用，從魁六數，丙七數，七六十三數，折只得一半，是六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1116,"lineType":2,"content":"數半也。或只用神减半言之，從魁六只言三數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1118,"lineType":1,"content":"亡盗行人知逺近，但尋此數自消停。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418765864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1118,"lineType":1,"content":"其他萬物皆如此，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418782248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"不可一途仍更寧。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418782248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"課逢旺孟有來意，旺仲必當朝夕期。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418798632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"死囚休廢狀如何，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418815016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"四般皆屬過去事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418815016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1126,"lineType":2,"content":"若發用旺孟神，或三傳俱孟，即來占新發意之事。　發用囚死休廢者，皆主過去事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"假使季神當相氣，舊事即今将欲至。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418831400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"孟神無氣臨相地，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418847784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562256282435594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"廢仲還同扵此義。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418847784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然相氣臨孟神，新事欲來須防備。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418864168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1134,"lineType":2,"content":"假令四季神卜臨相氣為用者，即占舊事再動之兆也。　初用孟神無氣臨相地，亦是占舊事動也。用廢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1136,"lineType":2,"content":"仲神臨相地，亦主舊事動之。用神是孟臨相氣，亦是新事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1138,"lineType":1,"content":"若占所事吉與凶，卦中神将言其意。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418880552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1138,"lineType":1,"content":"不比逺事反吟同。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418896936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"比合伏吟近之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418913320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1142,"lineType":2,"content":"不比反吟為用者，主事遲遲也。比用與三六合伏吟，其用主事近隣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"若占凶事與凶詳，更克日辰凶可畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418929704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"日鬼辰鬼月破神，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418946088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1146,"lineType":1,"content":"更𠔥刑害五般陳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418946088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031216692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1150,"lineType":2,"content":"若占人為凶事來，卦得凶卦更𤼵用。凶神惡将更用神克日辰，其凶可畏，不能解救也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰年上𠔥為用，吉卦先歡後却嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418962472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"復有解神孤寡煞，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418978856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1154,"lineType":1,"content":"憂喜無成是的真。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418978856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1156,"lineType":2,"content":"為前舉事也。　　假令七月甲子日己時占，用起傳送為日鬼，天罡為辰鬼，用起登明為日破神，末傳遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1158,"lineType":2,"content":"亦不能成其吉也。如子上見小吉，為六害也。如太衝臨子為用，是三刑也。遇此之殺者，吉事為凶。况若凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1160,"lineType":2,"content":"神惡将加之，并者尤甚。餘者倣此推之，無不驗也。孤辰寡宿者，春三月太乙為孤，大吉為寡，本法前孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1162,"lineType":2,"content":"後寡，餘倣此推之。又甲子旬中，河魁、登明是孤辰寡宿，本法十于後二辰是也。又名空亡神也。若此三煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1164,"lineType":2,"content":"在日辰上為用者，聞憂不憂，獲喜不喜，獄囚必脱，疾病得痊。占行人虚望失財，難尋也。餘倣此而推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031249460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"若占吉事，旺𠔥羙徳合，重重多喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602418995240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"徳生已說在前篇。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419011624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1170,"lineType":1,"content":"三六合神㸔用起，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419028008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1172,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占人來，若問吉事，三傳見旺相氣，及與日辰相生神，将不内戰。又三傳中用神合神見者，吉慶即多，求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1174,"lineType":2,"content":"事諧合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"事神年上兩相生，此主所為皆得成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419044392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"事神年上兩相克，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419060776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1178,"lineType":1,"content":"此主所為皆不得。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419060776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1180,"lineType":2,"content":"事神者，上用主事之神也。若事神與占人行年及年上神相生并加者，所占事亦得比合。縱得凶神惡将，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1182,"lineType":2,"content":"亦不害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031265844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"何以明其急與遲，但㸔天乙自然知。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419077160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰在前為事急，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419093544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1188,"lineType":1,"content":"支干在後遲無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419093544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1190,"lineType":2,"content":"假令四月戊寅日午時，以傳送加時，天罡臨寅為用，大吉為貴神臨亥順行，是用神日辰俱在貴神前，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1192,"lineType":2,"content":"事急速也。　假令正月壬子日辰時占，以登明加時，勝光臨壬為用，天乙加戌逆行，是用神與日辰俱在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1194,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人後，主事遲慢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"順行利陽雖急速，常陰不能成福竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419109928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行利隂復緩慢，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419126312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"龍合難為降喜儀。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419126312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1200,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙順行雖利陽，如遇太常、太隂，不能成福慶。　　天乙逆行，利陰不利陽，主事遲緩也。雖青龍、六合，亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031233076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1204,"lineType":2,"content":"能成其福竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然貴神臨二八，揺動不安主遷移。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419142696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"被刑帶煞皆凶惡，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419159080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"神在外兮亦如斯。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419159080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1210,"lineType":2,"content":"若用神被刑帶煞者，及凶将凶神，更神在外而煞在内，其卦尤凶。刑煞己注在前，加天罡、加四季，即神在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1212,"lineType":2,"content":"外，煞在内也。天罡加四孟，即神在内，煞在外也。如天罡加四仲，神在門，煞即入也。餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"神將所主為月內，已往将來用意推。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419175464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"斗在日前灾已過，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419191848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"若居日後事還遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419191848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然正當日辰上，凶吉只在朝夕期。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419208232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1218,"lineType":2,"content":"假令正月内，以功曺為用者，事應月内。正月建寅也，是神将所主之月也。　　假令正月内，用大吉為己往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031282228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1222,"lineType":2,"content":"之事，為十　二月建丑。若用太衝，主将來事。二月建卯，為将來也。　斗者，天罡也。天罡臨今日前，其灾己過；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1224,"lineType":2,"content":"天罡臨今日之後，其灾未過。天罡臨今日之上，灾發朝夕。　假令甲日寄在寅，天罡臨卯，事在今日前，灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1226,"lineType":2,"content":"已過；天罡加丑，事在今日後，為灾未過也。天罡正臨甲上，為灾只在朝夕發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1228,"lineType":1,"content":"前言課例都分顯，猶恐應期難盡善。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419224616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1228,"lineType":1,"content":"用起太嵗一年中，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419241000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"斗建發時當月見。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419241000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1232,"lineType":2,"content":"假令今年丁未年，以小吉未為用，事不出今年之中也。斗建，月建也。　假令三月建辰，以天罡為用，事應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1234,"lineType":2,"content":"在一月之内也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"傳辰旬內應期詳，用日克期在朝晚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419257384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444192819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1240,"lineType":2,"content":"假令戊子日，用起神后，是今日辰也，吉凶應一旬之内　也。　假令甲子日，以功曺為用，是用日也，為甲寄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":1242,"lineType":2,"content":"在寅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"氣首難過半月間，應候休言五日逺。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419273768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"得時不出八刻中，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419290152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"仔細記之心莫倦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602419290152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1248,"lineType":2,"content":"假令丙寅日立春，太乙為用，吉凶應在一氣之中，主十五日之事也。謂丙寄在已，故在太乙為氣首之神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1250,"lineType":2,"content":"應候者。　假令庚午日，為魚負氷，𤼵用傳送，吉凶應在一候之中。為庚在申，傳送為候首之神，故用在五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1252,"lineType":2,"content":"日之内也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"更有應日未宣陳，吉凶之卦各言因。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585440271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"今日生我為吉日，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585456655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031298612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":1258,"lineType":1,"content":"克我干者是凶神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585456655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1260,"lineType":2,"content":"課得吉卦者，以生今日者為用日。　　假令正月甲子日，寅時，占其日是木水能生之，合應在壬日，故云今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1262,"lineType":2,"content":"日生我為吉日。若課得凶卦，以克今日為應日。　假令戊日得凶卦，即應在甲日。甲木克其戊土，克我干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1264,"lineType":2,"content":"者是凶神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"事神與日何親屬？","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585473039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"或為父母或妻兒。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585489423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"或作鬼吏或兄弟，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585505807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"不離神將决因疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585505807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":1270,"lineType":2,"content":"事神者，用神也。㸔今日與何親屬也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然兄弟為鬼吏，那知還被兄弟累。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585522191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"旺為官爵相錢財，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585538575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562267955068969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"死亡囚獄休病忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585538575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然兄弟化為財，財物還從兄弟來。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585554959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1278,"lineType":2,"content":"忽然用神與今日為兄弟，更見鬼吏者，占人須防是弟為累。　　假令今日丙丁日，用太乙勝光為同類。忽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1280,"lineType":2,"content":"然兄弟得𤣥武，却克丙丁，為兄弟化作鬼吏也。　　用旺鬼，憂官厄。相鬼，憂財物撓。用死鬼，憂死䘮哭泣。囚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1282,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼，憂囚獄。用休鬼，憂病人。　假令庚辛日，以從魁為用神，是同𩔖為兄弟。将得六合青龍木，是兄弟化為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1284,"lineType":2,"content":"財，即財物因兄弟上得來。或見凶神惡将，却因兄弟失財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"大哉聖法實難測，須憑將神决疑惑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585571343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"其事有長有不長，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585587727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"此即專尋立用鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585587727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1290,"lineType":2,"content":"課事有長有短，但尋立用神所臨之鄉，看吉凶之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444241971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1294,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨冠帶長生位，福祿重重更顯揚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585604111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1294,"lineType":1,"content":"或值死囚休病地，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585620495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1296,"lineType":1,"content":"官灾凶事不能當。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585620495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1298,"lineType":2,"content":"但立用神，若臨冠帶長生，臨官帝旺有氣之地，即有重重福禄，更得吉将尤吉也。　　假令傳送臨未為用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1300,"lineType":2,"content":"是用神立冠帶之位。餘倣此推之。　若用神臨死囚休病地者，官灾凶厄。　假令神后臨丑，是為用神臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1302,"lineType":2,"content":"休衰之地。臨寅為病地，臨卯是死地，臨辰為囚墓地也。他皆倣此推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"大要先須㸔日辰，次辨尊𤰞長㓜分。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585636879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"官人百姓從頭記，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585653263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"賢徳姦邪次第陳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585653263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1308,"lineType":2,"content":"須㸔日辰之體。日為尊，辰為𤰞。日為老，辰為㓜。日為官人，為賢徳辰為百姓，為奸邪人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444291123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"舟車水陸夫妻定，病鬼人宅表裏尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585669647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"既往即須尋至處，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585686031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"為客方知有主人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585686031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1316,"lineType":2,"content":"日為車，辰為舟，日陸辰水。日為夫，辰為妻。日為病人，辰為鬼祟。日為人　口，辰為家宅。日為表，辰為裏。　　日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1318,"lineType":2,"content":"為既往，辰為至處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"出入但依南北路，左右須詳男女身。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585702415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"使作往住知的當，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585718799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"有求人物見虚真。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585718799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1324,"lineType":2,"content":"日為出，辰為入。日為南，辰為北。日為左，辰為右。日為男，辰為女。　　日為往，辰為住。　日為人，辰為物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"弓箭網羅為獵師，鳥獸禽鱗所獲因。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585735183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"干吉支傷順為喜，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585751567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444340275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1330,"lineType":1,"content":"干傷支吉逆為迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585751567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1332,"lineType":2,"content":"日為弓箭網羅獵師，辰為鳥獸禽鱗所獲也。日上神克辰上神，順也。辰上神克日上神，逆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1334,"lineType":1,"content":"支干相生旺有氣，舉動和合䟱者親。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585767951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1334,"lineType":1,"content":"支干互傷帶刑煞，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585784335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚無氣禍來臻。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585784335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1338,"lineType":2,"content":"支干上神若相生及旺相氣，舉動所求者吉。支干上下神交相克，更帶休囚氣，及披刑帶煞又無氣，主所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1340,"lineType":2,"content":"求皆多不遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰大體已分明，更㸔行年合事情。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585800719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"行年克日為不及，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585817103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"日克年神失節名。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585817103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444356659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1348,"lineType":2,"content":"行年克日上神者，名曰不及也。日克行年上神者，名曰失節。　假令占　人三十七嵗，行年在寅，今日丙　上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1350,"lineType":2,"content":"見大吉土是行年，寅克日上大吉土，是名不及　也。假令寅年寅上見神后，水被日大吉土克行年上水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1352,"lineType":2,"content":"名曰失節。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1354,"lineType":1,"content":"用神若還害天乙，是為四閉凶不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585833487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1354,"lineType":1,"content":"應喜反怒解復結，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585849871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"用兹三事要消停。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585849871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1358,"lineType":2,"content":"用神遙克天乙貴人者，名曰四閉。喜者復怒，解者復結，不及、失節、四閉之課，消息天官，斷其吉凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"卦體紀綱前已別，復有舉為未盡說。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585866255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"百事三傳見類神，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585882639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"與日相生為果决。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585882639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562267955183657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1366,"lineType":2,"content":"凡所求望，動止百事，於三傳中見其用神，幷為今日相生者，所求望事必果决也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"假令欲去見君王，須尋天乙為何方。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585899023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"酒食有無㸔小吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585915407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1370,"lineType":1,"content":"衣物將來視太常。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585915407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1372,"lineType":2,"content":"如欲見貴人視天乙，求衣服印綬視太常。酒食視小吉，財物視青龍。婦女視天后，罪囚視太陰。交易視六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1374,"lineType":2,"content":"合。水光詞訟視朱雀，鬬訟淹留視勾陳。病人視白虎，驚𢙢怪異視螣蛇。欺誕詐偽視天空，盗賊遺亡視元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1376,"lineType":2,"content":"武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"明舉三事將為例，欲求他課自消詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585931791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"此是神仙肘後訣，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585948175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"能曉乾坤掌內蔵。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585948175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444373043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1384,"lineType":9,"content":"大六壬玉成歌","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585964559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬元妙有靈機，支干神將辨安危。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585980943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"克衝刑破休衰害，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585997327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"七者言凶必定期。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602585997327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1390,"lineType":2,"content":"日為君為尊為官人，支為己、為宅為𤰞㓜、為物。　一克二刑、三破、四衝、五害、六休、七囚。神将相變，内外相克，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1392,"lineType":2,"content":"上下相刑，傳中相破。或見上下相害，又是囚死休氣加干支及傳者，凶也。凡占見刑氣克干，無氣作初傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1394,"lineType":2,"content":"動者為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"徳合相生並旺氣，此神相訪福來隨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586013711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1398,"lineType":2,"content":"徳者如已在甲之𩔖，及支前五辰之徳合，三六合也。相生子母相歸，旺相有氣。大抵無氣神将不能害有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444405811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1402,"lineType":2,"content":"氣神将也。旺相相生徳合者通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"將是神兮神是將，若得青龍便是寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586030095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1406,"lineType":2,"content":"天之十二将，便是十二神也。如乙日見虎，便是徳矣。又如甲日見青龍入辰兩課為外人入内也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"日主尊外幷人𩔖，辰為𤰞内宅𠔥身。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586046479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1410,"lineType":2,"content":"日主尊長之類，辰為𤰞，㓜為宅為已身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"占時考校日和辰，是財是鬼是何神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586062863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1414,"lineType":2,"content":"占時将與日辰，考校吉凶内外。如甲子日寅時，并又得子時，主凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"見機兩用艱難險，疑惑先難後易伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586079247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444422195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"知一每事須云近，遙克當傳主逺尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586095631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1422,"lineType":2,"content":"知　一卦者，占賊盗皆主近，占事皆近應。遙克主逺應。遥，逺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"元胎生下病人占，當用下生定有嬰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586112015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1426,"lineType":2,"content":"元胎卦，四孟上生下者，主人病。三傳四孟加長生處，主闕事及孕育事。老少乆病俱凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"神遙尅日，名蒿矢。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586128399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"日遙克神，彈射名。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586144783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1430,"lineType":2,"content":"主暗昧、口舌。遥逺事有客至，不可容。過夜，必主口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟占事休言定，往復𩀱雙兩事因。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586161167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"常占須主身離動，不動人情有怨欺。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586177551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1434,"lineType":2,"content":"反吟常占主身動不動，主人情不足之兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925026367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟舉動心無遂，剛主行人到戸庭。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586193935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"三交凶吉皆因內，昴星蛇虎定凶危。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586210319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":1442,"lineType":2,"content":"三交凶將，主釡鳴。天空，主失物。龍常雀，主遷官。勾后陰，主走失。蛇虎，主訟。三交卦皆主内。昴星，主外見。蛇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":1444,"lineType":2,"content":"虎入傳，病死訟枷鎖。太陰，主暗昧事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗月受傷克為用，虎臨䘮弔哭聲歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586226703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1448,"lineType":2,"content":"太嵗月建受克為用。得凶將，主長上灾。虎臨年命，䘮用為用，有䘮禍之事也。必嵗月在傳方是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"917","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑為鬼人家破，日鬼用扶官職輝。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586243087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1452,"lineType":2,"content":"三刑為傳，蛇虎克戰，帶凶煞傷日辰，主家破人亡也。日鬼為用，生行年本命者，主遷官之兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444389427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"墓神加日身灾滯，支臨干上所為危。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586259471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"921","lineNum":1458,"lineType":2,"content":"日墓加日，主身有灾滯。支為𤰞，干為尊。若𤰞加尊，所依皆危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月死虎加年命，相刑之月氣歸雲。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586275855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"923","lineNum":1462,"lineType":2,"content":"歲乗死神，白虎加年命者死。假令申年戊辰日，伏吟占行年在寅四月，申為死神，同歲虎傷刑行年者，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1464,"lineType":2,"content":"四月死。申為死神，刑行年寅也。此言太嵗乗白虎為死神也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"日鬼加臨辰兩課，門中官吏乃相縈。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586292239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"926","lineNum":1468,"lineType":2,"content":"日之官鬼來加内兩課，主官吏到門也。畢法謂鬼臨三四，訟災隨也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"吉將遭傷求事阻，休囚歸傳也不成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586308623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562270031331380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":1474,"lineType":2,"content":"吉将初戰，求吉事不成。休衰之氣為傳，亦主無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"930","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"時傷年命入傳來，必然卒暴有驚憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586325007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"931","lineNum":1478,"lineType":2,"content":"占時克年命，又乃入傳，至卒暴驚恐之事，入三陰課也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"932","lineNum":1480,"lineType":1,"content":"徳神動處吉相隨，反遭刑制見凶危。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586341391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"933","lineNum":1482,"lineType":2,"content":"日之徳神臨日辰為用，上下相生者，主有大喜慶也。返遭刑制者，如己日見寅加申酉，徳神受克也。及将","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1484,"lineType":2,"content":"乗白虎，又或寅上見申酉，名無徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"支上有鬼家移動，干若逢之，人主憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586357775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"936","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"日課對隔，主人離，內之值時宅破。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586374159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"期。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586390543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925075519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":1492,"lineType":2,"content":"日之兩課，有對神隔將，主家宅離隔也。　　假令乙日，干上見六合乗酉，内二課有對神隔將，主家離隔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":1494,"lineType":2,"content":"假令丙日，朱雀乗亥加干是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"941","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"陰神却受陽神克，退除隂，小人墮胎。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586406927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1498,"lineType":2,"content":"第二課受第一課克者，主退陰，人口之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"四課相間干內外，傳用衝支宅不寜。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586423311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1500,"lineType":2,"content":"課間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1502,"lineType":2,"content":"四課相間，事須内外也。　假令丙辰日，亥時丑將，四課相隔。闕　　　　　　　　　　以將言之。元武走失，虎勾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1504,"lineType":2,"content":"朱貴，主訟。發用。或傳神衝支者，主宅不寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"947","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫陰刼同加日，逆亂欺凌尊上人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586439695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925091903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":1510,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爻乗太隂，刼殺加日，主𤰞小逆亂，欺凌尊上人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"950","lineNum":1512,"lineType":1,"content":"用將支𩔖家中事，三合支辰眷屬親。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586456079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"951","lineNum":1514,"lineType":2,"content":"傳用天将與支𩔖者，主内事。如已午日傳見蛇雀者是也。支辰三傳合，或傳日三合，皆屬眷愛。只如占盗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":1516,"lineType":2,"content":"見支合為玄武，主親人所盗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"953","lineNum":1518,"lineType":1,"content":"天空在未井多怪，𠔥主人遭疾病縈。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586472463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"954","lineNum":1520,"lineType":2,"content":"天空乗井，煞加未入傳，主宅中井損。厠竈門皆準闕，　主宅中人患宿疾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"955","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁同虎住干支，宅中須言有孝人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586488847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"956","lineNum":1524,"lineType":2,"content":"酉主孝服。乗虎加干支，主宅上人孝服也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925141055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":1528,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎或乗日辰墓，來臨內外亦䘮迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586505231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"959","lineNum":1530,"lineType":1,"content":"傳帶凶將衝干支，疾病人灾官事至。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586521615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":1532,"lineType":2,"content":"三傳内有一神街干，主人灾。衝支，宅灾，主人病或官事。並以内外言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"961","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"本日墓與蛇虎併，棺槨墳灾欲動興。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586537999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":1534,"lineType":2,"content":"宅神日前五辰，或命前五辰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":1536,"lineType":2,"content":"本日墓與蛇虎臨宅神并日辰傳中，主有䘮禍之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":1538,"lineType":1,"content":"占身用與納音詳，相生有喜克時殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586554383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":1540,"lineType":2,"content":"發用克日之納音者，身灾，相生則吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"966","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"父母臨干憂子孫，雀傷支日閙如篁。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586570767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925108287"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":1546,"lineType":2,"content":"日上父母帶凶將，惡殺加日，主子孫有疾病也。雀克日辰，主文字口舌閙煼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"969","lineNum":1548,"lineType":1,"content":"子息見時官事解，妻財尊位豈安康。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586587151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":1548,"lineType":1,"content":"水乘火將皆驚恐，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586603535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1550,"lineType":1,"content":"勾雀同傳多訟傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586603535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":1552,"lineType":2,"content":"蛇雀乗子亥，主驚𢙢暗昧，口舌相傷。勾雀同入傳者，主鬬訟之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1554,"lineType":1,"content":"卯乘前二招脣吻，罡作朱雀獄訟囚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586619919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":1556,"lineType":2,"content":"卯乘朱雀，主口舌之事。罡乘朱雀，主入獄之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"975","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"熒惑加寅，音信至。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586636303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂為用，主隂謀。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586652687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1560,"lineType":2,"content":"朱雀乘寅，逺信至。太隂為用，主機謀，不欲人知事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925124671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":1564,"lineType":1,"content":"天魁立用須干衆，若加寅卯獄追收。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586669071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"980","lineNum":1566,"lineType":2,"content":"戌主衆，必有干衆之事。戌加寅卯為用，或加行年本命，主獄之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1568,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜貴人傳共見，或同日徳動髙尊。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586685455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1570,"lineType":1,"content":"天空立用事無憑，前四帶合勾引情。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586701839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":1572,"lineType":2,"content":"天空立用，占求事，須三闕次，失信無成。天空，不實之神也。支干與勾陳合者，主有勾引之情也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"后陰玄𤼵暗陰謀，傳出貴前將主明。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586718223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1576,"lineType":2,"content":"后隂𤣥為用，是天乙之私氣，皆主隂暗不明之事。若三将為用，却傳出天乙前者，先暗将得明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1578,"lineType":1,"content":"惡將從來只說凶，若逢生合却歡欣。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586734607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925157439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":1582,"lineType":2,"content":"虎、蛇、雀、勾空皆屬凶將。若不戰，却生日辰反吉。凶將若戰，或生日辰不戰，比合為有喜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1584,"lineType":1,"content":"貴臨已亥多反覆，罡加癸水主蔵名。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586750991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1586,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人臨地盤己亥上，主事有反覆之意。天罡，魚龍之物，下臨癸水，主蔵避逃形如得水蔵之象也。　假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1588,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉日寅時己将，主蔵逃也。為辰加癸為用。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"支干發用歲神臨，所望逺大及朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586767375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1592,"lineType":2,"content":"必主逺大之望，非細微之事。縁太歲臨干支為用，或歲君𤼵用是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"占時發用當日言，太歲連傳三二年。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586783759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"995","lineNum":1596,"lineType":2,"content":"占時發用，應在當日。太歲相傳，却三二年事必遲。却三二年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562284925173823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"支干入傳為事連，歲建幷煞亦如然。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586800143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"998","lineNum":1602,"lineType":2,"content":"干支入傳中者，占事主速。歲月建共入傳，或殺刑重，亦主速也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"999","lineNum":1604,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相氣發必欲速，休囚死氣皆遲延。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586816527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":1606,"lineType":2,"content":"春木旺火相，四時各以𩔖推。發用或傳陽傳順，事又速也。休囚死氣為用，三傳逆，又傳入天乙後主事遲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":1608,"lineType":2,"content":"目下未成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"日陰辰隂用為合，更乗吉將待求成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586832911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":1612,"lineType":2,"content":"凡下三合，在日隂𤼵用，主外親事。在辰陰發用，主内親事。支三合亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰相㑹無凶將，亦主他來相合。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586849295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"因","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586865679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562276444454963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":1618,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰相併，得吉将，主合事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳帶合，須求事𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586882063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"就其干衆所占，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586898447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":1622,"lineType":2,"content":"三六合多，主干求事。　假令甲乙日上見寅卯入傳，及丙上見己午，皆闕用之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"用與時傷干支凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586914831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"若生干支福興榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586931215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1626,"lineType":2,"content":"乃天網卦也。用與時同，克日則外灾，克支則内灾。占時興用，生干主外喜，生支主内福。集門","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"地足天頭加酉卯，將乗蛇虎逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586947599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"為","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586963983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1630,"lineType":2,"content":"戌亥為天頭，辰已為地足。若加卯酉為用，更乗蛇虎為将者，主逺行道路之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"斬關逰子身當動，支來日課亦如然。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586980367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562286225342499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1636,"lineType":2,"content":"二卦主身動之象。支來日上之兩課，亦主身動。故日為外，支為内，故主動也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":1638,"lineType":1,"content":"天驛二馬為初用，參星白虎動行神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602586996751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":1640,"lineType":2,"content":"日之驛馬及天馬為用者，亦主身動。參星者，傳送也。虎為路神也，為用必動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"玄空直財遭賊盗，財傷年命鬬爭因。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602587013135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":1644,"lineType":2,"content":"日之財神乗玄武天空，或為旬空者，主失財。若財神克年命，主因財而争，或失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"或陷空亡，須主失。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602587029519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"刼亡下克盗為真。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602587045903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":1648,"lineType":2,"content":"財在空亡，須主失財。刼殺同財，却又遭刼殺下克者，多招竊盗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"外財入內多財喜，忽然大旺貨物起。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602587062287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562286225358883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1654,"lineType":2,"content":"日之財入支二課，是外財入内，多主求財之意也。内見外財者，主貨物起求財，餘依此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"傷破須㸔天上神，財入傳來天將傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757406754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1658,"lineType":2,"content":"假令癸日己午，為財入傳，或發用上見水將克者，財破。如財遭天将破失，是傷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼下臨財位上，陰私用事畏人彰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757423138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":1662,"lineType":2,"content":"假令已酉日申将已時卯，是日鬼下臨子，水鄉是　也。天盤日鬼加地盤日之財位，陰私用事畏人知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"日往支辰親識至，返遭刑克被凶侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757439522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":1666,"lineType":2,"content":"日來支上兩課者，主外人至，及進人口也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"火主其明水主暗。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757455906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"失明只為火，難任","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757472290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562286225375267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":1672,"lineType":2,"content":"發用克日。蛇雀臨己午，主明信動。后玄臨亥子，主暗信動。火屬陽，水屬隂，故火明水暗也。火臨亥子為失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1674,"lineType":2,"content":"明，主虚憂驚𢙢事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1676,"lineType":1,"content":"少多大小詳衰旺，旺多衰少細推尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757488674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":1678,"lineType":2,"content":"占物數多少大小者，皆以係神将旺相為多，休囚為少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭丁符與將空，傷干怪動好沈吟。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757505058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":1682,"lineType":2,"content":"月厭，正月起戌，逆行十二辰。丁者，六甲旬中之丁及蛇亦是。符，直符也。甲日已、乙日辰、丙日卯、丁日寅、戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1684,"lineType":2,"content":"日丑、己日午、庚日未、辛日申、壬日酉、癸日戌是也。将空者，天将不曽逰到之地，却於天上乗之。　假令龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1686,"lineType":2,"content":"不到戌亥，却天上亥與戊為龍，乃是将空之地。餘依此。又月厭丁符将啌傷日辰，必主怪夢之事，取怪之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562286225391651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1690,"lineType":2,"content":"状，以類神主之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"生死二氣常順用，飛魂䘮魄畏來臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757521442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1694,"lineType":2,"content":"生氣正月起子，順行對生氣為死氣。飛魂正月起亥，順行十　二辰。䘮魄正月起未，逆行四季。未辰丑戌，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":1696,"lineType":2,"content":"二煞乗凶将加臨年命日辰發用必定有死絶之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1698,"lineType":1,"content":"天鬼或與蛇雀併，宅舎須憂火燭驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757537826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"關神動處身灾滯，飛禍之神忌臨辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757554210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1702,"lineType":2,"content":"關神，春丑、夏辰、秋未、冬戌。如入傳加日辰，有勾牽之灾。飛禍春申、夏寅、秋已、冬亥，不宜動用進人口求事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1704,"lineType":2,"content":"皆主灾横。如加日辰，年用不利戰，宜守舊則吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562286225440803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":1708,"lineType":1,"content":"逰都天盗幷天賊，六辛便是五亡神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757570594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":1710,"lineType":2,"content":"逰都煞，甲已日丑、乙庚日子、丙辛日寅、丁壬日巳、戊癸日申。天盗春卯、夏午、秋酉、冬子。天賊者，正月起丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1712,"lineType":2,"content":"逆行四季，與𤣥武併臨日辰年命者，主盗賊發動　必矣。旬中六辛便是五亡煞，刑克日辰，年命，主盗亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"虜都不可漏商稅，天車出外必遭傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757586978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1716,"lineType":2,"content":"虜都甲已未、乙庚午、丙辛申、丁壬亥，戊癸寅，加日辰，不可漏稅作私事。天車春丑、夏辰、秋未、冬戌，出門忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1718,"lineType":2,"content":"此煞，必主驚𢙢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"天喜相和喜慶多，解神憂喜見消磨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757603362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1722,"lineType":2,"content":"天喜春戊、夏丑、秋辰、冬未，與吉将併日辰，人年上見，大吉利也。解神外有起法，逢此者乃吉神也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562286225489955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"成神為用總皆成，天目家中有鬼神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757619746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1728,"lineType":2,"content":"正五九已，二六十申，三七十　一亥，四八十　二寅。與吉将併臨，主事成就。天目春辰、夏未、秋戌、冬丑，占宅有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1730,"lineType":2,"content":"祟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"迷惑始為終不記，刑亡終併事遭凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757636130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1734,"lineType":2,"content":"迷惑正月起丑，逆行四李，占事遇之，迷惑不已。刑亡正戌、　二亥，三子四丑，五申，六酉七辰，八己九午，十未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1736,"lineType":2,"content":"十一寅，十二卯，又與勾虎加年命傳中，刑害日辰，主市曹赴法死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":1738,"lineType":1,"content":"金神四煞占來凶，凶將相幷禍重重。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757652514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":1738,"lineType":2,"content":"金神即破碎，四煞即天殺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":1740,"lineType":2,"content":"金神，孟月酉，仲月己，季月丑。四煞亥卯未在戌，已酉丑在辰，申子辰在未，寅午戌在丑。此　二煞即吉将，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562286225473571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":1744,"lineType":2,"content":"凶，其應速。金煞與四煞與凶将，加年命日辰傳用者，禍大重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神吉將不相生，喜事論之未必成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757668898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"凶將凶神無賊害，","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757685282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"憂疑却得見和平。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757685282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":1750,"lineType":2,"content":"雖是吉将緣却克，戰日辰喜而必凶。占喜不成。凶将不克日辰，占憂事必散而和平矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"軌深不離衰休克，靈驗應須學玉成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757701666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":1754,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬之法，千經萬論，各不出於旺相。相生德合，則吉比和，凶事不成。若休衰刑克，則凶事将成，吉事不就。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"來經攷驗古賢文，翻成新句樂同人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602757718050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562301589143593"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":2302,"lineType":2,"content":"年臨處就為所在之方。若不知生死，以行年臨孟為在，仲病季死。不知行年，以天罡加陽孟為安，加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":2304,"lineType":2,"content":"陰孟小病，加陽仲不死，加隂仲死。加陽季不死，加隂季死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":2314,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗前二神為䘮門，嵗后二辰為弔客。臨日辰年上主灾。更與死氣死神白虎并者，主死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
