{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"此課子孫乘青龍發用，主文職，占子孫及本身前程家","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533246498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"宅事。","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533246498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"他日父子均登高品官爵。","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533262882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"兒子於午年發科，未年","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533279266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"及第，屢於寅午火旺年月轉官，本身見任。","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533279266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年應詔，官","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533295650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562344048033811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"由詞館，屢於巳丑年月轉遷，家宅吉利，招女聰俊，獲配","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533295650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"武弁崇勲，多益母家。","logicSentenceId":"7679067675533295650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"惟朔望弦晦日，忌此課為天煩也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391121954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"觧曰：蓋課得午加酉為元首，主首擢，利見大人。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391138338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳：午","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391154722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"為天馬，卯為天車，子為華蓋，為髙蓋乘軒，三公𡖖之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391154722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰用神旺相，吉將在 ,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"數相乘，主夀。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391416866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"得八十一支為家宅。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391433250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"子上見酉，主招女。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391449634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"乘","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391466018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"太常吉將，主聦俊，配武弁相生，主益母家也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391466018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"此課昔越王有鄭妃當誕，召范蠡占之，以月將申加子","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391515170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"時得一上克下，巳加酉為用，上是旺火，克下死金，上強","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391515170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562321604345882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"下弱，故决生男。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391515170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"如秋占火囚氣課皆隂，則未然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391531554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391547938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"酉日已加酉，𤼵用一上克下，為元首課。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391547938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"巳嵗占則吉㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391564322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"應在一嵗之內。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391564322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"若正月建寅，用起功曹，則事應正月之","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391580706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"內。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391580706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子日立春，用起太乙神后，則事應半月之內。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391597090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391613474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"旬內起神后，則事應十 {"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"元首，一上尅下，以尊制𤰞，大順之徵，為諸課首，故名元首。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391744546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"占主天地得位，品物咸亨，事從外來起，男子憂喜皆實，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391760930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"臣忠子孝，婚諧謀遂，孕生男，兵訟先者勝，賈人獲利，官","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391760930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"職首擢，利見大人。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391760930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"如日辰年命發用，正時六䖏値旺，相","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391777314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562336313638952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"乘吉將，更逢富貴官爵、三光三陽等吉課，仕人貴顯不","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391777314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"可言。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391777314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"此課大象順利十分，然或得凶神惡將，三傳不順，反","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391793698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"主下順上而上不從。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391793698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"又如一上尅下，而上休囚死氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391810082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"下𨚫旺相，徳合嵗月建反主，上雖制下，而下不受制，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391810082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"未可執一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391810082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"課中一克下。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391842850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"元首卦本宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391859234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":160,"lineType":2,"content":"元者，長也。首者，初也。上克下者，諸卦之長也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562344047968275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"起嵗年華問，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391875618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":164,"lineType":2,"content":"本嵗發用，其吉㐫應年内也。假令太嵗在寅，為功曹，其將勾陳，主一年内爭訟田宅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"逢蟾月內尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391875618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":166,"lineType":2,"content":"蟾者，月之名，十二月斗建是也。假令正月斗指寅，以功曹𤼵用，其吉㐫在一月内必應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"傳辰旬日應，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391892002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":168,"lineType":2,"content":"假令正月將甲子日午時，占第二課，子加未，以神后為辰𤼵用，其吉㐫不出十日應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"値日目前辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391892002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":170,"lineType":2,"content":"假令今日甲子，以甲為日，課中功曹𤼵用，其吉㐫當日應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"氣動蟾分體，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391908386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":172,"lineType":2,"content":"蟾者，一月之數也。體者，全之數也。分體，半月之數也。氣動者，二十四氣之首日為𤼵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":174,"lineType":2,"content":"用，每氣十五日。假令丙子日，立春之節，四課之中用起神后，其吉㐫應在半月内也。假令丙子日，立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":176,"lineType":2,"content":"春第五日庚辰，子將卯時占太乙加申，上克下，為用神。初傳勾陳，主財物、田宅、鬬訟、官灾，不出一氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":178,"lineType":2,"content":"之内也。巳火發用，即立春丙子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562344048082963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"候來旬拆身。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391924770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":182,"lineType":2,"content":"候者，七十二候也。旬者，十日也。每一候五日。拆身，是拆破一旬之数也。假令七月初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":184,"lineType":2,"content":"一日，寒蝉鳴為候，是甲申第二日乙酉，寅時午將占事，三傳申子辰也，傳送加乙，一上克下，其吉㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":186,"lineType":2,"content":"應在五日之内也。或用起功曹，亦是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"諸卦從此起，萬𩔖若通神。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391941154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":188,"lineType":2,"content":"凡七百二十卦，皆例此卦斷之。取年月日時為應期，明五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":190,"lineType":2,"content":"行之奥義，通萬事之正理，如神明也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣言官職。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391957538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"春木旺。夏火旺。秋金旺。冬，水旺。四季土旺。如春月戊巳日占事，見木神發用，克今日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":194,"lineType":2,"content":"土，君子有官職，小人爭財，官事。若傳入三光、三陽、三竒、六儀，不可例斷官事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財相氣論。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391973922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":196,"lineType":2,"content":"春，火相，夏，土相。秋，水相。冬，木相。季月，金相。假如春月壬癸日占事，見火神發用，為妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562344048050195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":200,"lineType":2,"content":"財，主財帛事動。若不是妻財，則不可以財帛一例㫁之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"死言䘮者，起","logicSentenceId":"7679069554391990306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":202,"lineType":2,"content":"春，土死；夏，金死。秋，木死；冬，火死。凡死氣為用，乃䘮亡之事，更與闕克日的應。假令春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":204,"lineType":2,"content":"月壬癸日發用，土神克今日干也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"囚動見官刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392006690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":206,"lineType":2,"content":"春，金囚。夏，水囚。秋，火囚。冬，土囚。季，木囚。凡囚氣動者，更克日為官鬼也。假令春月甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":208,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日占，申酉發用，乘㐫，將主官詞刑傷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"休來憂病患。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392023074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":210,"lineType":2,"content":"春，水休。夏，木休。秋，土休。冬，金休。季，火休。凡占休氣動，主疾病災患也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"諸家卦備陳。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392039458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"得旨從天降，不悞後學人。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392055842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":212,"lineType":2,"content":"諸卦用元首、五行、旺、相、死、囚、休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":214,"lineType":2,"content":"斷之。君子得五行之旨趣，分明神報，吉㐫禍福，人事、物𩔖、数目，逺近應期，皆同天降也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562344048066579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":218,"lineType":9,"content":"心鏡","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392072226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"四課之中一克下，卦名元首是初神。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392088610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"臣忠子孝皆從𩔖，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392104994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"憂喜因男非女人。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392104994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":222,"lineType":2,"content":"上克下，事起於男子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"上即為尊下𤰞小，斯為","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392121378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"正理悉皆真。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392121378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"官詞先者皆為勝，後對之人理不伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392137762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"上克下，利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":226,"lineType":2,"content":"為客，爭訟先起是客，後訴者是主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"元首卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392170530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"尊制𤰞，貴制賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392186914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"占事多順，憂喜皆實，皆以神將","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392203298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392203298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"凢事宜先事起男子，然就以神將、支干、四時休旺、","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392219682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562336313753640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"年命三傳推測，乃見吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392219682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"如一上克下為用，而上休囚","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392236066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"死氣，下却旺相徳合當月建，乃下反勝上。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392236066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月甲寅","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392252450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"日，日上酉金加之為用，雖是元首，奈酉金囚氣，甲寅乃","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392252450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"月建，支辰為日，徳禄又旺氣，下既得勢，必不受制，則尊","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392252450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"卑不順，反亂之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392252450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"　如心鏡占孕歌曰：用神克下生","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392268834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"男子。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392268834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"若執此例，不以上下勝負推之，第恐有悞。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392285218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"昔越有","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392301602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭妃，當産於四月辛已日子時，召范蠡占之。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392301602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"月將申加","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392317986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"子，時用得已加酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392317986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"上克下，是旺火克死金，此上強下弱，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392334370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562321604444186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"故生男也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392334370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"如秋月占得此課，則不然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392350754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"切在叅詳，不可","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392367138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"執一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392367138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"凡一下賊上，餘課無克，為重審課。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392399906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"象地事逆，以下犯上。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392416290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"如臣諍君，不敢擅為，必再三詳審，定計而後入，故名重","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392432674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"審。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392432674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"積善者慶，積不善者殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392449058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"君子占之，利以攸往。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392465442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"至哉重","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392481826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"審，含章可貞。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392481826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"或從王事，無成有終。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392498210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"統坤之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392514594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：順天厚載，柔順利貞。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392530978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"一下逆上，豈無憂驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392547362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"貴順福","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392563746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562336313770024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"至，貴逆亂興。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392563746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"事宜后起，禍從內生。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392580130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"用兵主勝，受孕女形。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392596514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"諸般謀望，先難後成。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392612898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"如初傳墓絶，末傳生旺，灾禍自消。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392629282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺傳墓絶，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392645666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"墓絶傳生旺，吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392662050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"初傳克末，㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392678434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"末傳克","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392694818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"初，吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392694818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢龍常隂后六合吉將。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392711202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣、觧神、天徳、月徳、天","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392727586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"喜、徳神、合神、吉神，得一在末傳，可化㐫為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392727586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"君子厚徳，","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392743970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"中道而行，則有坤六五黄裳元吉之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069554392743970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"723","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"二上𩀱克下，卦元分兩名。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453350946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"見機起四孟，求事後須成","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453367330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":788,"lineType":2,"content":"四課","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":790,"lineType":2,"content":"之中有二上克下分，見機察㣲也。假令正月已丑日卯時占事，係二上克下。卯臨未，已臨酉，以已為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562346568974345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":794,"lineType":2,"content":"初傳，是已為孟，故以已為用，求事先難後易也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"用起季兼仲，察㣲産婦驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453383714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡臨四孟，必定舉哀聲","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453400098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":796,"lineType":2,"content":"渉害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":798,"lineType":2,"content":"用仲季者，為察㣲也，主産婦驚恐。如魁罡臨四孟發用，郎主傷産婦也。如正月庚寅卯時占事，戌加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":800,"lineType":2,"content":"寅為初傳，是河魁臨孟也。又酉時占時，天罡臨寅亦是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"渉害淺深為見機。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453514786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"欲用不用，欲言不言，事有兩件而取","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453531170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453531170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"事主遲疑艱難，進退不定，難於先而易於後也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453547554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"以受克神往前數至本位止，遇地所克深多者，即起用。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453563938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"傳若所克俱多，先取孟神，如無，即取仲神為用；如無孟","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453580322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"仲，方取季神。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453580322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"或俱孟俱仲季，受克又同，此之謂復等。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453596706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"陽","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453613090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"日用日上神，柔日用辰上神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453613090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰孟深仲淺季無取。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453629474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"復等柔辰剛日擬","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453645858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"凢課無克，取日干與四課上神相克者為用，曰遥克課。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453793314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562360976293888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"遇有兩克，相比為用，遥相克賊，故名遥克。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453809698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"如蒿矢為鏃，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453826082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"弹射為箭，射物難中，不足為畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453826082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"凢事禍福不測，憂在西","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453842466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"南，而在西北有善乾陽方也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453842466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"葢此課先儘四課上神克","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453858850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"日干為用，曰蒿矢格。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453858850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"如逺神克日，緩而且輕，折蒿為矢，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453875234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"力弱難傷，故名蒿矢。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453875234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"占事始而雷吼驚恐，終却無妨，統","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453891618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"暌之體，乃狐假虎威之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473453891618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"conte {"lines":[{"lineId":"836","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"占主始如雷吼驚恐，終却無事，愈逺愈小，漸漸消磨。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454268450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454284834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562360976343040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"時有客，不可容納，主小人口舌，凢事憂在西南，喜在西","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454284834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"北。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454284834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"西北乾天門也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454301218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"占事，人謀已，利主不利客，利後動，利","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454317602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"小不利大，神將㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454317602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰無氣，主盗賊隂謀，神將吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454333986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454350370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣，則干貴有喜，行人來訪人見","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454350370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"此二課俱主逺事，虚驚不實，縱有成就，亦虚名虚利。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454448674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"帶金圡煞，則能傷人。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454465058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"盖蒿矢見金為有鏃，弹射見圡","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454481442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"為有丸，主驀然有灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454481442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"若傳空，又名遺鏃失矢，不能成","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454497826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"事。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454497826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"大端禍福俱輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454514210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"若見太隂玄武天空，當有欺詐之","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454530594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":950,"lineType":1,"content":"事而禍起。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454530594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"867","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"二課有近射，有逺射。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454546978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"第二課發用為近射，是日之兩","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454563362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562364470198311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"課自戰，多主外事，不干於內，㐫勢畧大，不可出尖。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454563362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"第","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454579746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"三課、第四課𤼵用為逺射，㐫勢漸小。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454579746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"盖第三課乃辰","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454596130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，與日干相競，尚覺㐫重，有力不可先動。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473454596130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"若第四課，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473566220322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"無力也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473566220322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"此課如螣蛇入傳，尤多怪夢憂疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473567776802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"或申加卯，為車輪","logicSentenceId":"7679071473567793186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"倒斵，傳見玄武，㐫甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473567793186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"惟午加卯為明堂，主萬事昌隆。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473567809570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"盖","logicSentenceId":"7679071473567825954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1170,"lineType":1,"content":"午為離明，卯為天駟，房心明堂之宿，遇㐫亦吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473567825954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562379938644002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"上二課剛日本乎天者，親上傳，終歸干上，從天𩔖也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473567842338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"柔日本乎地者，親下傳，終歸支上，從地類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587191860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"以天道","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587208244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1178,"lineType":1,"content":"言，昴星隂氣用事，㣲霜始降，枯槁皆死，此决斷萬物","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587208244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"收斂精神之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587208244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"以人事言，昴星於五行為金，五常","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587224628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"為義，當其言不必信，行不必果，惟義所在，然後决之，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587224628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"故以昴星作課。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587224628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"然雖斷之以義，亦歸責於已，斯可矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587241012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"故終末從其日辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587257396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為天獄，二課最忌刑獄，大端","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587273780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":1188,"lineType":1,"content":"惟潛藏稍吉耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587273780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"四課無遥克，神仙立此門。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587322932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"五陽㸔酉上，見發卦基根。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587339316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":1196,"lineType":2,"content":"四課","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"辰作中傳用，末傳日上論。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587355700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":1200,"lineType":2,"content":"㸔辰上所得之神為中傳，日上所得之神為末傳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"出行遭禁繫，淫亂暗乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587372084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":1202,"lineType":2,"content":"昴星主淫亂奸邪之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"冬蛇交掩目。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587404852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"萬事不相從。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587421236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"五日柔為用，從魁初傳臨，中","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587437620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562378420289547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"傳在寅上，末傳在已宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587437620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":1210,"lineType":2,"content":"五柔日㸔天上，從魁臨地，下盤之神為用也。假如乙未日寅將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":1212,"lineType":2,"content":"辰時，占一課寅乙，二課子寅，三課已未，四課卯已，上下無克，又無遥克，當以昴星觀之，從魁加亥，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":1214,"lineType":2,"content":"為初傳，寅作中傳，巳作末傳也。取此卦為例也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"伏罪何須出，無勞西與東。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587454004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":1216,"lineType":2,"content":"主匿罪不通，不宜出行也。此㐫神之卦，再遇㐫將，尤㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"用起昴星為虎視，秋分在酉知生死。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587486772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"出入闗梁日月門，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587503156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"舉事稽留難進止。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587503156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日出身身不歸，柔日伏匿憂難起。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587519540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":1224,"lineType":1,"content":"女人淫泆問何因，此地名為難禁止。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587535924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日㸔酉，所得之神為用，是虎視轉蓬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587568692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"柔日視從魁，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587585076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"所臨地盤之神為用，是冬蛇掩目卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587585076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"此論昴星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587601460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"占人","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587617844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"主事稽留伏匿，陽日如虎睛光，轉運不息，病主多驚恐，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587617844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"轉運不已。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587617844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"隂日如冬蛇蟄藏，掩目不動，事多暗昧，進退","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587634228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"猶疑驚恐。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587634228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"陽日稽留於外，隂日隠伏於內。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587650612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為天之私","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587666996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"門，肅殺之地，故仰俯取之為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587666996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"昴日鷄，酉中之宿。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587683380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587699764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"昴星者，取鷄鳴必仰之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587699764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"西方白虎，亦昴宿也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587716148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"柔日虎","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587732532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562373664079898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"視者，是取虎視必伏之義，尤忌子午卯酉日得之，昴星","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587732532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"虎視，必災危也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587732532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"凢三課無尅，别取一神為用，曰别責格。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587765300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋陽干常動而","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587781684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"易位，故剛日初傳，用干合上神，如戊癸合，癸寄丑，即丑","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587781684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"上神為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587781684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"隂支常静而守位，故柔日以支三合前一辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587798068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":1258,"lineType":1,"content":"如未日三合前一辰，即亥字為初傳，中末俱并日上。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587814452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1258,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587830836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":1260,"lineType":1,"content":"三課不備，别從其類，責取一合神為用，故名别責。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587830836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":1260,"lineType":1,"content":"占者","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587847220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562378420322315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"凢事不備，主有留連之體。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587847220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：謀為處正，財物不全。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587863604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"臨兵選將，欲渡尋船。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587879988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"求婚别","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587896372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"娶，胎孕多延。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587896372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"損而能益，事遇神仙。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587912756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"如神將㐫日，用休囚","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587929140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"則應㐫象。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587929140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"神將吉日，用旺象則應吉象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473587945524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"八專","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683890176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1418,"lineType":2,"content":"四課缺二，止有兩課","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"有尅照常，以尅賊、比渉等項論。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683890176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"干支同","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683906560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"位，專聚一處，故名八專。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683906560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"占主二人同心，其利斷金，兵資衆㨗，物失內尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683922944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"陽日尊","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683939328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562388939587611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"長欺卑㓜，主事超進迅速；隂日妻奴背夫主，主事退縮","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683939328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"遲緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683939328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚及進人口，主口舌分離。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683955712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"占憂喜事，俱重叠疊。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683972096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"此課若逢龍常天乙吉將，及天月二徳，則又有同人","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683988480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"恊力，衆輕易舉之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473683988480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"帷簿不脩。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684004864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1434,"lineType":2,"content":"八專無克，又無遥克。剛日從干之陽神，連根順數第三位為用。柔日從支之隂神，連","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1436,"lineType":2,"content":"根逆數第三位為用。中末俱重并干上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲寅日，干之陽神亥，順數三至","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684021248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，乃丑亥亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684021248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未日，支之隂神卯，逆數三至丑，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684037632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"丑已已也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684037632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"八專之課，已為尊卑共室，人宅不分矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684054016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562379938791458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"但有克者，尚有制縳，不可以淫佚斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684070400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"獨此無克者，任順","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684086784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"逆數，去伸縮而用之，全無克制防範，故名帷簿不脩。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684086784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"占主外不隔而內不備，事多重叠，憂喜再來，干渉婦人，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684103168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum" {"lines":[{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"獨足","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684135936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1452,"lineType":2,"content":"八專課内，已未日未時酉將占三傳，皆日上酉，酉酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳皆歸一處。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684135936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"如路遥","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684152320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"驛逓，無人傳送，獨占一足難行，故名獨足。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684152320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"伏覩日辰上中末此處論","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684299776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1474,"lineType":2,"content":"如陽日八專，庚申亥將申時，一課亥庚，二課寅亥，二課俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1476,"lineType":2,"content":"同，無克，從申上亥順數三辰得丑為初傳，日辰上見亥為中末也。又如巳未日，亥將酉時，占一課酉巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562379938807842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1480,"lineType":2,"content":"二課亥酉，辰上二課同無克，從亥逆數三辰至酉，復以本日所得之神見酉為中末傳也。此課三酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1482,"lineType":2,"content":"是獨脚課也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1484,"lineType":1,"content":"奸邪驚怪起，淫慾亂乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684316160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1484,"lineType":2,"content":"主隂罪是也。㐫將自不教覺占將事不彰露，重審卦註也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"逆到日辰上，三傳别起根。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684332544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"神仙隠秘法，此課少人温。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473684348928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1486,"lineType":2,"content":"逆行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1488,"lineType":2,"content":"三辰者，神仙隠秘之術，諸人錯用，不得明顕。術人少得温尋，今已明之盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：居者將移，合者將離，道由中止，事宜改為。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697128448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"傳陽人","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697144832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"至，傳隂未歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697144832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"占人求物，不出庭除。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697161216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"如將乘龍，常貴人身，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697177600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，坐而獲喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697177600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"見虎合二馬，静中有動，人信到門。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697193984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"見勾陳，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697210368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"沈屈不伸，動止稽留。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697210368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"見太隂，隂𥝠難明。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697226752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"見天空，主虚詐。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697243136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"見六合，孟神傳陽生男子。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697259520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"或子午全，主道路及望信事。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697275904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉全，主門户事。","logicSent {"lines":[{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697423360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1710,"lineType":2,"content":"十二神各居各位，如子加子，丑加丑之類。有尅，以克者為用。中取初傳所刑，末取中傳所刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"俯","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697423360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562394941669412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"伏本家，不能變動，只有呻吟愁嘆而已，故名伏吟。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697423360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"占主屈不得伸，静中思動。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697439744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"自任","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697456128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1718,"lineType":2,"content":"伏吟課陽日無克，取干上神為用。中、末傳取刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"天地鬼神，不動不克，無所","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697456128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"取擇，自任其已之剛，進用於時，故名自任。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697456128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"占主自強出頭，而當閉塞，惟柔順守静，吉而事成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697472512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697488896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"任已過剛，必成愆咎，行人立至，然亦本家暫出之人，原","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697488896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"非逺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697488896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"失物逃亡俱不逺。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697505280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"胎孕聾啞，禍患流連，病主不","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697521664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1728,"lineType":1,"content":"語而呻吟，淹滯嵗月，干謁不出。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473697521664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":1932,"lineType":1,"content":"占主內外多怪，上下暌隔。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473789976576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1932,"lineType":1,"content":"井上架木，易欹易斜，不能長","logicSentenceId":"7679071473789992960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"乆之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473789992960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"動則宜，静則擾。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473790009344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"事無慿依，一身兩用，傍求易就，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473790025728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1936,"lineType":1,"content":"直道難容，凢事速成易破。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473790025728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":2028,"lineType":1,"content":"凢課用神，日辰旺相，吉神在中，為三光課。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797578767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":2028,"lineType":1,"content":"葢日為人旺","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797595151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":2030,"lineType":1,"content":"相，不但諸鬼不能勝，而人口又能峥嶸，一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797595151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":2030,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為宅旺","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797611535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":2032,"lineType":1,"content":"相，不但宅居廣寛，而諸邪又不能入，二也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797611535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":2032,"lineType":1,"content":"用神為日用，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797627919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":2034,"lineType":1,"content":"動作旺相，不惟所幹無阻，而又事得光耀，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797627919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":2034,"lineType":1,"content":"此三處","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797644303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562405549064201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":2038,"lineType":1,"content":"神更乘吉將，又光其身，又光其宅，又光其動作，三者皆","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797644303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"有光華，故名三光。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797644303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"占者萬事任其所為，皆無費力而成，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797660687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":2042,"lineType":1,"content":"且有吉利，統賁之體，乃光明通達之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797660687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"tex {"lines":[{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":2078,"lineType":1,"content":"占主光輝通逹，百事吉昌，皆無費力，而成官榮，病安囚","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797857295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":2080,"lineType":1,"content":"釋，市賈得利。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797857295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":2080,"lineType":1,"content":"如神將俱和合相生，初末逢吉將，居官遷","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797873679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":2082,"lineType":1,"content":"職，始終慶吉，縱年命㐫煞，亦不為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797873679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":2094,"lineType":1,"content":"用神如旺相，分配一光時。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797955599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":2094,"lineType":2,"content":"如春木旺火相之𩔖。用神得旺相者，為一光也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":2096,"lineType":1,"content":"吉將臨其上，二光得禮義。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797971983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":2096,"lineType":2,"content":"如發用是吉將，即貴青常合等，乘時旺相者，二光也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":2098,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰兼有氣，三光不改移。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473797988367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":2098,"lineType":2,"content":"如春甲乙，夏丙丁之𩔖，所值日時，當為三光也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":2100,"lineType":1,"content":"求事多來速，當官職不遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473798004751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":2100,"lineType":2,"content":"若無三刑六害，主喜事，求官必得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課得旬日之竒，發用或入傳，為三竒課。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902403618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子、甲戌","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902420002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":2258,"lineType":1,"content":"旬用丑，甲申、甲午旬用子，甲辰、甲寅旬用亥，此為旬三","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902420002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":2260,"lineType":1,"content":"竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902420002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":2260,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日用午丙竒，辰乙已丁卯，戊竒，寅已丑庚未辛，申","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902436386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"位壬竒取酉癸戌，云此為日竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902436386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"葢鷄鳴乎丑，日精巳備；","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902452770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":2264,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴夜半鳴，月精已備；斗轉乾亥，星精已備。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902452770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":2264,"lineType":1,"content":"又丑為玉堂，","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902469154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":2266,"lineType":1,"content":"子為明堂，亥為絳宮，此三者日月星精，為旬用之竒，故","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902469154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":2268,"lineType":1,"content":"曰三竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902469154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":2268,"lineType":1,"content":"占者百禍消散，凡事吉利，統豫之體，乃上下悦","logicSentenceId":"7679071473902485538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562405549244425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId {"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課用神生日，及三傳遞生日干，或干支俱互生旺，為","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626406927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562436784259082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"亨通課。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626406927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙申日，三傳申亥寅，初生中，中生末，末生日","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626423311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"干也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626423311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日，三傳酉丑已，末生中，中生初，初生日干也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626439695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"為遞生。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626456079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"主上人推薦，或官員請舉，及文狀事，始終成就。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626472463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日，干上亥，支上辰，為互生。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626488847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，干上寅，生丙，支上","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626505231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，生寅，為俱生。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626505231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"主彼此和順，兩相有益。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626521615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"遇生氣，兩家合","logicSentenceId":"7679071265626537999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content": {"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"凡夫妻行年，俱隨旺氣三合位上為旺孕格。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760526370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"盖三合異","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760542754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"方，同類相望，又逢興旺之時，當主胎孕，故名旺孕格。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760542754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"受","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760559138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"孕法：如妻行年見已，主正月壬日申時受孕。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760559138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"其法妻年","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760575522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"上神後三位受氣為孕月，冲位干為孕日，亦分十干次","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760575522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"第，辰戌月用戊，丑未月用已，前三位臨官為孕時。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760575522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"妻行","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760591906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"年上見午，主二月癸日酉時當受孕，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760591906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562455734059042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻年命上，旺相兩般推。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760624674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"妻金三十四，夫水三十七。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760641058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"女","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760657442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"命亥上覓，夫年寅上推。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760657442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"七月未時占，妊孕無改移。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760673826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760690210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"臨在亥，金旺更無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760690210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":852,"lineType":2,"content":"妻命是金，年上見酉，金旺也。七月全旺占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"年立旺相，子孫有象。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760886818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"謂夫婦行年立旺相之鄉，三五相","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760903202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"望，同類異位，時立旺相氣，其嵗中必有受孕生貴子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760903202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562457386647579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"定章曰：夫妻之年，同類異位者，寅午戌亥、卯未已酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760919586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"丑申子辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760919586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅午戌俱火，相與同類。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760935970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"寅本東方，午本","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760952354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"南方，戌本西方，此同類而各一方，為異方同類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760952354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760968738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"辰相去五位，謂之三五，相望為合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265760968738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"818","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"凡禄馬貴人臨干支年，命併旺相氣發用入傳，更乘吉","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860108322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"將，為榮華課。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860108322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅日，干上申，支上已為干支。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860124706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬申","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860141090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"發用中傳貴人，主君子加官進禄，常人謀為財利，進身","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860141090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"修宅俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860141090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日，干上寅之𩔖亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860157474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"此禄馬又遇貴人，","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860173858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562457386532891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"主人榮達，又遇光華，故名榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860173858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"統師之體，乃士衆擁從","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860190242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860190242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"830","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：支干吉神，人宅俱利，經營俱亨，動止均美。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860206626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"孕育麟","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860223010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"兒，婚成連理。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860223010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"用兵征討，得地千里。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860239394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸丑日，已加癸日","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860255778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"貴為財。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860255778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅日，申加丙日馬為財之類，大利求財。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860272162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860288546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"日，干上丑之類，為干支見晝夜貴人，主事得兩貴，周全","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860288546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"成合。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860288546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉日，子加申之類，為晝貴，坐夜貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860304930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯日，夜酉","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860321314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"加亥之類，為夜貴，坐晝貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679071265860321314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"宜告貴求事，必干兩處貴人","logicSentenceId":"767907
