{"lines":[{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562471294943247"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"閉口，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297135119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1586,"lineType":2,"content":"或旬尾加旬首，乘𤣥武發用。或旬首在天盤，乘𤣥武發川；或旬首在地盤，其地盤上神乘玄武發川，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1588,"lineType":2,"content":"皆是也。又法：不論發用，但㸔𤣥武當旬首，逆推度四神，雖無首尾相加，自有首尾之意。亦是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1588,"lineType":1,"content":"首尾相","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297135119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"加，似物閉藏，環圓無端，不見其口，故名閉口。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297135119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"占主閉宻，機闗莫測，事跡難明。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297151503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"尋人沒影失物，人見不","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297167887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"肯言。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297167887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"縱乘貴，告貴不𠃔。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297184271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"孕生啞子病，痰氣格塞，瘖瘂，或","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297200655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"禁口痢，或喉塞不食。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297200655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"訟屈不得伸，有寃莫訴。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297217039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"傳逢六合，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297233423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"喜事成，㐫難散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297233423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄作閉口，病更㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297249807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"若又值無禄，課","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297266191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297266191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"逆推度四神，專為逃與盗而設。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297282575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲日，旬首乘玄","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297298959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562476235833395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1604,"lineType":1,"content":"武，是謂玄武陽神，其加臨位下，可以捕女。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297298959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1604,"lineType":1,"content":"連根逆數四","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297315343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"位即旬尾，是謂玄女隂神，其加臨位下，可以捕男。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297315343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297331727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"辰日，辰旬首，則丑旬尾。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297331727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"辰乘玄武，臨申，則尋女於西南","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297348111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"申方，逆四度丑臨已則尋男於東南已方是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297348111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"非六甲","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297364495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"日不必度四，但㸔玄武乘地盤為陽神，可以捕女；天盤","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297364495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂神，可以捕男。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297364495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙卯日，卯乘玄武，臨戌，則尋女在","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297380879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"西北戍方，尋男在正東卯方是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297380879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳相克帶㐫神，並","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297397263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1618,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳克武追逃亡武受克，日時可獲。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297397263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1618,"lineType":1,"content":"相生帶吉將難獲","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297413647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562471294992399"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297413647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"失物在隂神生處尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297430031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"如玄武乘金，金生水，藏水中。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297446415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"乘","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297462799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"水，水生木，藏林中。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297462799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"乘木，木生火，藏窰冶中。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297479183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"乘火，火生土，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297495567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"藏泥窖中。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297495567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"乘土，土生金，藏金石下也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297511951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"此課外有旬尾加干，旬首加支，或旬首加干，旬尾加","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297528335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"支，名一旬週遍格。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297528335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"占憂喜事，各皆不脱。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297544719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"試宜代筆，訟","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297561103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"宜換司，交易去而再來。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297561103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"六隂日發用玄武，又名察奸","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297577487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1634,"lineType":1,"content":"課。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297577487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"又有占尋人法，專㸔干徳支刑，所臨之處，相克何如。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297593871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562471294976015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"徳如甲已在寅，乙庚在申之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297610255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"刑如子卯相刑，及辰","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297626639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"午酉亥自刑之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297626639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戍日，甲德在寅，戌德在木。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297643023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"寅","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297659407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"臨未，君子隠西南。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297659407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"未臨子，小人逃正北。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297675791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"而寅木克未","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297692175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"土，是德克刑也，易獲。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297692175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"如已已日，已德在寅，已刑在申。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297708559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"寅臨亥，君子隠西北。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297724943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"申臨已，小人逃東南。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297741327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"而申金克","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297757711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木，是刑克德也。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297757711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"難獲","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297774095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1652,"lineType":9,"content":"觀月經","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297790479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1654,"lineType":1,"content":"凡言閉口卦，其理兩般陳。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297806863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1654,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲當旬上，須推度四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297823247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1654,"lineType":2,"content":"六甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562476751732748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1658,"lineType":2,"content":"即甲子等六日度四辰推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"陽神作玄武，隂逆四旬同。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297839631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"子為玄武，上從魁作陰神，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297856015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1660,"lineType":2,"content":"逆四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1662,"lineType":2,"content":"是終隂。陽神六甲旬首；陰神六甲旬終。子為玄武，隂神在酉，是甲子旬終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"假令河魁下，陰居小吉身。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297872399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1664,"lineType":2,"content":"戊上為玄武，未上是隂神，甲戌旬終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然臨傳送，太乙為使臣。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297888783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1666,"lineType":2,"content":"申為玄武，則已上是陰神，甲申旬終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"易位勝光上，太冲隠去人。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297905167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1668,"lineType":2,"content":"午為勝光，太冲是陰神，甲午旬終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡若作武，大吉是其賔。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266297921551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"功曹居賊下，登明無處伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443100200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"失男陰下去，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443116584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":1672,"lineType":2,"content":"六甲日失，男子奔走，陰神下去也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562476751749132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1676,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武女人奔。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443116584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1676,"lineType":2,"content":"如失了女子，玄武位尋也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":1678,"lineType":1,"content":"賊在陰神下，搜尋此處陳。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443132968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1678,"lineType":2,"content":"假令闕子日亥將卯時占來問女人亊。其將貴神自已逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1680,"lineType":2,"content":"數至申為𤣥武。申為西南。其西南不見尋　神處。申是𤣥武，陰神落於子，子為正北。若捉盗賊，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1682,"lineType":2,"content":"之下正北穫也。此解乃尉山人書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"假如正月占卯時甲子旬，玄武天罡上，天罡下臨申，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443149352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"女往西南去，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443149352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":1686,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥武所在位下臨申，去西南尋人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"急走在北隣，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443165736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉東南去，陰位伏陽人。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443182120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1690,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子日玄武在辰，大吉為陰神，丑臨已，是知東南上㐲陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562476235931699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1694,"lineType":2,"content":"人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"盗賊亦同此兩般一體。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443198504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"陳","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443214888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1696,"lineType":2,"content":"若失盗賊，亦東南去，兩般一解也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":1698,"lineType":1,"content":"不見六旬日，陰居下法真。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443231272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1698,"lineType":2,"content":"若是六旬首日，玄武居之，即在本位下。不在六旬者，用下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1700,"lineType":2,"content":"法推之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"上法推陽首，此法相𠔥陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443247656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1702,"lineType":2,"content":"若非六甲者，𤣥武在已酉丑亥卯未，是陰神之下，除六甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1704,"lineType":2,"content":"之外，皆用此法推之，故曰相𠔥陰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武所乘者為陽，盗賊侵陽之本位處，所見却為陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443264040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1706,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":1708,"lineType":2,"content":"所乘之神為陽神也，便是盗賊之處，其陰神本位上見者，為陰神也。㸔陽神與此方位相度處詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562488239734784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"正月乙卯日午時課六壬，卯為陽，在戌，傳送本位金，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443280424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1712,"lineType":2,"content":"其卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1714,"lineType":2,"content":"為玄武，是陽神。臨戌，其本位卯上見申金也，為陰神。言陽金克木，即易見也。比合難見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"女往西北去，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443296808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1716,"lineType":2,"content":"西北是玄武所臨之下，戌地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"男往正東尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443313192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1718,"lineType":2,"content":"玄武所乘之神臨戍地。亥將加午，其卯加戍，玄武臨之。女逃西北，從地盤之戍，陰求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":1720,"lineType":2,"content":"陽也。男逃正東，從天盤之卯，陽求隂也。　　此解乃尉山人書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"賊盗同陰作。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443329576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1722,"lineType":2,"content":"若失物盗賊則在正東也。失牛問大吉，失馬問勝光。何方雞犬等項，各㸔所屬而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1724,"lineType":2,"content":"之。乃陰神所臨之下也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"此是一段，陳其賊擒不擒。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443345960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳不相克，吉將求難尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443362344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443378728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562488239767552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"將有相克，亡人賊自擒。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443378728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1730,"lineType":2,"content":"但凡玄武陰神所臨之下不見克，㸔發用三傳。若中之傳逢吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":1732,"lineType":2,"content":"將，三傳上下相生，即亡不見也，賊盗難獲也。故云：三傳不相克，吉將求難尋。若𤣥武所居之處，三傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1734,"lineType":2,"content":"相克，更逢㐫將，即亡人易獲也，賊盗自擒。故云：㐫神有相克，亡人賊自擒也。今日玄武陰神申加卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1736,"lineType":2,"content":"上克下將，勾陳凶將，合主申時敗賊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1738,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知藏物處，陰神生處尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443395112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1738,"lineType":2,"content":"申為𤣥武之陰神，屬金。金生水，藏物當在水中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"金來在水下，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443411496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1740,"lineType":2,"content":"金為武之陰，物藏水之中也。謂金能生水也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"水生在髙林。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443427880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1742,"lineType":2,"content":"水為玄武隂神，物藏在林木之中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"木神窰冶處，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443444264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1744,"lineType":2,"content":"木為玄武隂神，物在火焚之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562488227135539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"言。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443460648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"火隠髙岑。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443477032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1748,"lineType":2,"content":"謂火生土，物在高崖之處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"土言坑壑內空墓窰深藏。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443493416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1750,"lineType":2,"content":"土為隂神，在壑穴之處也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"若論尋獲，曰，玄武怕日擒。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443509800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"此法隨身寳，價值百錠金。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443526184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1752,"lineType":2,"content":"木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1754,"lineType":2,"content":"陰神，金日得之，木怕被金克也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":1756,"lineType":9,"content":"心鏡","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443542568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1758,"lineType":1,"content":"陽神作玄武，度四是終陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443558952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1758,"lineType":2,"content":"陽神六甲旬首，隂神六甲旬終。功曹作𤣥武終陰是登明，故曰四是終陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"此名閉口卦，逃者遠追尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443575336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"亡人隨玄武，搦盗往終擒。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443591720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1760,"lineType":2,"content":"逃人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1762,"lineType":2,"content":"在𤣥武方捉，盗在陰神方捉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562488239751168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1766,"lineType":1,"content":"順行陽所起，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443608104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1766,"lineType":2,"content":"太乙順治在𤣥武，陽神所居為起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1768,"lineType":1,"content":"婢走求陽處，奴逃責陰神。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443624488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1768,"lineType":2,"content":"婢走求陽𤣥武，奴逃求陰𤣥武。婢走就奴，故求陽，陽是婢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1770,"lineType":2,"content":"藏之家也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1772,"lineType":9,"content":"袖中金","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443640872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1774,"lineType":1,"content":"旬尾加旬首為閉口，逆數四神責玄武。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443657256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":1774,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占多主閉宻，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443673640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"不能測其機闗。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443673640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"如占病是啞，或中風不語，痰塞咽喉，或","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443690024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1778,"lineType":1,"content":"禁口痢，或咽喉腫疼，不能飲食言語。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443690024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1778,"lineType":1,"content":"占失脱，縱有見賊，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443706408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1780,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不肯説。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443706408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1780,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事閉口無語，又不相𠃔有無之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443722792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1780,"lineType":1,"content":"餘占更","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443739176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562488227168307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443739176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"天將言其事類，如其上乘貴人，告貴不𠃔。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443755560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"上乘朱雀，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443771944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"占訟枉者不伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443771944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"上乘白虎，使人不明遭罪。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443788328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"觀月經刑徳卦，　日干論徳，高人隠之。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443804712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"日支論刑，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443821096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1790,"lineType":1,"content":"賤者所隠方。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443821096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"五陽德自處，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443837480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1792,"lineType":2,"content":"甲丙庚壬戊自居。日德","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"陰來合者，論","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443837480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1792,"lineType":2,"content":"夫唱婦隨之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日庚","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443837480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"為徳，丁開壬户門。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443837480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"已土居陽，甲辛金丙處，云癸徳配在","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443853864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"戍。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443853864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":1796,"lineType":2,"content":"以上論徳，取干合也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1798,"lineType":1,"content":"刑來支上，論","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443870248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1798,"lineType":2,"content":"刑論支也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":1798,"lineType":1,"content":"賢士去徳下。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443870248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1798,"lineType":1,"content":"奴婢走刑村。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443886632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1798,"lineType":1,"content":"徳若克其","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443903016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562488227201075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"刑，逃亡路失魂。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443903016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"刑若克其徳，逃亡有遁門。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443919400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"刑徳不相克，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443935784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1804,"lineType":1,"content":"閉口卦中尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443935784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1804,"lineType":2,"content":"如有逃去，先以徳刑克上推之。如不相克者，閉口卦中尋之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"正月甲戌日辰時發課占：賢士西南去，未地有灾煩。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443952168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443968552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":1808,"lineType":1,"content":"日徳自䖍。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443968552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1808,"lineType":1,"content":"賢士在西南，","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443984936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1808,"lineType":2,"content":"寅臨未也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1808,"lineType":1,"content":"奴婢正走北，刑地驀墻垣。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266443984936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1810,"lineType":2,"content":"戌刑未，未臨子，故奴婢走北去也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"此名德克刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266444001320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"六月已已日卯時走失㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266444017704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"賢士西北去，亥","logicSentenceId":"7679071266444034088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"地上遶欄。","logicSentenceId":"7679071266444034088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1814,"lineType":2,"content":"已徳在甲，甲在寅，寅臨亥也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四課有尅，缺一為不備，及日辰交互相尅，為蕪淫課。","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232032291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"邵先生曰：課得不備，剛日從日上起第一課，柔日從辰","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232048675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"上起第一課。","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232048675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見二陽一隂，為隂不備，如二男爭一女；","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232065059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"二隂一陽，為陽不備，若二女爭一男；及日辰交互相尅，","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232065059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562521672548391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"各自相生是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232065059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"此夫妻皆有私通，兩情相背，荒淫無度，","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232081443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"故名蕪淫。","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232081443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"占者家門不正，事多淫亂，統小畜之體，乃琴","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232097827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"瑟不調之課。","logicSentenceId":"7679065228232097827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"占主不周全，物偏缺，病難愈，求望難成，行人未至。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628581428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"陽不備，","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628597812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"兵訟利為主，賊不來；隂不備，兵訟利為客，賊必來。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628597812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"皆戰","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628614196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"不成。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628614196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳陽多，事起男子。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628630580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳隂多，事因女人。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628646964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"陽多，晴","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628663348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562504241217587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"久。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628663348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"隂多，雨添。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628679732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占多以不周全為斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679067510628696116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"始為上，終為下。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981706275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"上下相克為刑傷，上下相生為和合。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981722659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"正月午時占，夫年立酉，妻年立亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981739043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以陽年為始，天","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981755427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"上從魁也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981755427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"妻以隂年為始者，年上神天罡也，從魁與","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981771811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡相生為始吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981771811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以地盤年上神為終者，功曹也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981788195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"妻以陽年為終者，天上登明也，寅與亥相生為終吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981804579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"主夫妻和合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981820963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"居天寡宿地孤辰，發用須依六甲旬。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981853731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識空亡何宿定，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981870115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌旬中用酉申。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981870115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":312,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌旬中，胃昴畢觜參為寡宿，居天上也。申酉為孤辰，是在地下也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"占人孤獨離桑梓，財物虚無伴不親。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981886499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"官位遇之須改動，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981902883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"出行訪財擬親人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981902883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"所問百事皆無實，卒遭官司不害身。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981919267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":318,"lineType":2,"content":"久病亦畏空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx28u1v/1-SK1599_figure_00023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Qgg%2FcjPzT1ynV222BcDPRfPpmS8%3D","pictureHeight":1235,"pictureWidth":220,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx28u1v/1-SK1599_figure_00023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZOUorLERgS6tPMNiSxbJhGoUYtA%3D","uri":"read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx {"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"地盤空亡為孤辰，天盤孤亡為寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981952035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"葢十干不到之地，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981968419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"五行脱空之鄉，能減㐫禍，主人孤獨，離鄉背井也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981968419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"春巳午孤，子丑寡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441981984803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"夏申酉孤，夘辰寡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982001187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"秋亥子孤，午未寡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982017571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"冬寅夘孤，酉戌寡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982033955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"此二卦各㸔發用，如春占巳午發用，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982050339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"即孤辰卦，子丑發用，即寡宿卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982050339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"餘例倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982066723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦總親情離散之象，若有奇儀三光等救神者，反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982083107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"訂訛","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982099491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562520628330531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡：","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982115875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":342,"lineType":2,"content":"旬中孤寡有三：發用值旬空，陽空為孤，隂空為寡，一也。發用地盤空為孤，天盤空為寡，二也。發用空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":344,"lineType":2,"content":"為孤，未傳空為寡，三也。四時孤寡有二：如春以已為孤，丑為寡等，一也。春又以生我之水絶神在巳為孤，我尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":346,"lineType":2,"content":"之土墓神在辰為寡，二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"十干不到之地，五行藏脱之鄉，前去後空，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982115875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"隂惆陽悵，所謂孤辰寡宿，故名孤寡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982115875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"占主獨孤，離鄉背井。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982132259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"官易位，財空手，婚斷絃，孕虚有，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982148643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"出入防盜。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982148643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰無氣最凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982165027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"孤辰父母災。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982181411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主離宗棄","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982197795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"祖。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982197795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"寡宿，妻子離，六親叛。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982214179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"如旬孤寡，又併四時孤寡為","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982230563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"空孤空寡更㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982230563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"凡值空亡，憂喜皆不成，托人多詐謀，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982246947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562520628346915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"望近事出旬可圖，逺事終難。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982246947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"時空，事亦難成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982263331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"或中傳","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982279715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"空，為斷橋折腰，主事中止難就。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982279715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"或中末俱空，為移逺","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982296099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"就近，動中不動，尋逺人即在近也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982296099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"初中空，推未傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982312483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"中","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982328867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"末空，取初傳，以不空者斷吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982328867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"新病空，病。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982345251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"久病空，人","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982361635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，空反凶㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982361635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"空反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982378019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"此課大端不吉，或遇三竒六儀為救神，及遇太嵗、月","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982394403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"將、月䢖，為孤寡再醮。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982394403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"又今日所坐位值孤寡為用，曰","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982410787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡得位，如庚日用申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982410787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"皆主反禍為福事，先破","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982427171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562521672728615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"後成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982427171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰年命不論空。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982443555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"又有純空反實，或遇嵗月日","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982459939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"時冲起，為逢冲暗動，禍福皆成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982459939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"玄課孤辰卦，四時辰上推。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982492707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"冬北亥子丑寅夘的孤危。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982509091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"南","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982525475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"方巳午未申酉是孤夷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982525475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"春三寅夘辰孤在已午題。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982541859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"秋天","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982558243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉戌，亥子作孤推。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982558243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"父子分離析，夫妻有生離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982574627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然諸","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982591011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"卦救，禍滅福相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982591011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"前孤後是寡，骨肉縱暌違。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982607395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562524721872946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"前言説孤辰，此卦論寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982640163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"倣象孤辰推，在後相驅逐。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982656547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"冬","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982672931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"月申酉戌，發用無骨肉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982672931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"夏天寅夘辰，親情不和睦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982689315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"秋來","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982705699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"午未占，春遇子丑宿。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982705699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶與孤同。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982722083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"有救禍反福。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982738467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四課內三上克下，或三下賊上，為度厄課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982771235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"葢上為尊，","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982787619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"下為𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982787619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"三上克下，則長欺㓜，勢必遭厄，為度厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982804003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"三下賊","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982820387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"上，則長不正，㓜乃凌長，為度厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982820387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"占者家宅欠利，老㓜見","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982836771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"災，統剥之體，乃六親冰炭之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070441982836771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"度厄，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073669667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":434,"lineType":2,"content":"三上克下曰㓜度厄。三下賊上曰長度厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"三上尅下，主𤰞小有厄難，故","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073669667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"曰㓜度厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073669667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"三下賊上，主尊上厄難，故曰長度厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073686051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx296oz/1-SK1599_figure_00024.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=rcaK1mu14Y%2BL3ry3pQNbJ5DuLaI%3D","pictureHeight":1204,"pictureWidth":529,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx296oz/1-SK1599_figure_00024.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=XVr6VhWiRXkilTpSD41xu8utbJY%3D","uri":"read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx296oz/1-SK1599_figure_00024.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562524721922098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"占主家門不吉，骨肉乖離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073702435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"㓜度厄，若子孫發用，凶神入","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073718819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"墓，卑者更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073718819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"長度厄，若父母發用，凶神入墓，尊者更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073735203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"若仕者占主事，從隣邑發動。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073751587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"山鵲合羣，同氣相親之兆","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073767971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073767971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"神將吉，因動成喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073784355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"神將凶，面合心離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073800739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"或反有暗害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073817123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073833507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"與刑殺并及旺相氣，凶易成。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442073833507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"若與徳合併，不能害也。","logicSentenceId":"767907044 {"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"占主在上無禮，卑小不利，孕傷、胎病昜死。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074521635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"占子病死","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074538019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"更騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074538019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"奴婢逃，骨肉散。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074554403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"若旬空發用來人，必主獨身而","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074570787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074570787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"事起男子兵訟，先者勝。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074587171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事動而必靜。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074603555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"占主孤獨失業，多刑傷病必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074636323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"事起女人，兵訟，後者","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074652707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"勝。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074652707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事靜而必動。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074669091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562524722020402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"此課神將凶，骨肉分離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074685475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"若神將吉，來意主分財異居。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074701859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"觀月經：無禄卦，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074718243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"四課俱臨下，男鰥女寡孤。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074734627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳如有救，子必勝于吾。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074751011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":550,"lineType":2,"content":"四課","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":552,"lineType":2,"content":"俱臨下者，為無禄卦。如發用是水神，未傳得金神為救。發用是金神，三傳見土神為救神。吾者，父也。其五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":554,"lineType":2,"content":"行併用此㫁之。假令已未日亥將辰時占四上克下，取比用酉為金神，發用中傳辰土生金為父，末傳亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":556,"lineType":2,"content":"水為子，即有救也。雖是無禄卦，不言絶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"首尾俱相制，臨年子失迷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074767395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"切須看用數，到老有如無。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074783779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":558,"lineType":2,"content":"臨年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"老也。首尾初未傳。若今日發用水神在土上，終傳復見土神，此首尾相制也。假令午將甲寅日未時占，神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562543755542540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":564,"lineType":2,"content":"后臨丑，下克上為用，是首制也。終傳河魁土，是尾制也。其神子水，欲前就功曹為子，又下被大吉怒之。後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":566,"lineType":2,"content":"欲親從魁為母，又被天魁戌土上降災禍。此占人必災也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"四課，上神俱克下，法式嚴峕不可論。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074816547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":570,"lineType":2,"content":"四上克下，即法令嚴加有屈不得伸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":572,"lineType":2,"content":"雪也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"臣子受殃從此起，無禄如何獨處尊。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074832931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"占人孤老誰扶侍，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074849315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"空室窮炊豈得存。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074849315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"官門兢小必當罪，對者應知理不伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074865699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562521672826919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"無禄四上尅下。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074898467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"絶嗣四下賊上。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074914851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"上下之分，貴于忠恕。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074931235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074947619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"下賊上，是無其尊，為不忠矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074947619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"四上尅下，是不容其下，為","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074964003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"不恕矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074964003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"允得此體，則主奴婢散失，子孫他之，孤子空室，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074980387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"上不能保其禄位，下不能友其妻子，不友不親、不弟不","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074980387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"義之恥焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074980387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：無禄主動而必靜，室家孤獨，病不乆退，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074996771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"官事不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442074996771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"囚者脱，逃者獲，凡事宜先舉者。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075013155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"絶嗣主靜而","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075029539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"必動。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075029539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"小人犯上無禮之兆，暗横災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075045923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"病者易死，逃者轉","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075062307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"匿凡事宜後施者。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075062307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"四上克下。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075095075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075111459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"室空無人，老而獨孤，臣子受殃，六","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075127843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"親死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075127843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"當此之時，戰鬭客勝，利以先舉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075144227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"定章曰：父以子為下，君以臣為下，夫以婦為下，兄以","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075160611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"弟為下。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075160611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"四課皆上克下，是為孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075176995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"法曰：君欲害臣，父","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075193379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"欲殺子，兄欲損弟，夫欲傷妻，主欲害奴，是空室無人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075193379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"四下賊其上，名為絶嗣，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075226147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"中年多子息，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075242531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":614,"lineType":2,"content":"五旬為中年，始有子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562543755558924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"暮嵗滅祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442075242531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"五十以後，主老無子。初傳發用是木，末傳有水，為子孫救之也。如未傳見金克木，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":620,"lineType":2,"content":"主絶後也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":622,"lineType":2,"content":"假令甲寅日亥將午時占，即四下賊上，取未上子水為比，用子為水神，未傳見戌土克之，又是孤辰無依也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":624,"lineType":2,"content":"又甲寅日亥將子時占，三傳子亥戍，亦是絶嗣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":626,"lineType":2,"content":"假令巳未日亥將午時占，即四下賊上，三傳巳戌夘。初巳火發用，與今日巳土比合，中傳戌土為子孫，末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":628,"lineType":2,"content":"傳夘木為父母，不得言絶嗣，為有救也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562524722085938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"凡八迍課，得五福為迍福課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195615796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"如死氣為用，旺氣下勝，俯","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195632180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"仰丘仇，帶凶將刑害，傳逢墳墓，下賊上殺，臨日辰相尅，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195632180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"為八迍格。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195632180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"用起初死終旺，子母相生，始凶終吉，年神制","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195648564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"初旺，相臨日辰，為五福格。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195648564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"此八凶者為迍，五吉者為福，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195664948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"故名迍福。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195664948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"葢時令死氣發用為一迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195681332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"下為旺氣所勝為","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195697716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"二迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195697716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"上見丘墓為三迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195714100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"下見讐尅為四迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195730484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"乘凶將為五","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195746868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195746868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刑害，子為墳墓，星主死亡為六迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195763252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"下賊上為七迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195779636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神臨，日辰相克為八迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195796020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"若用起死氣，末傳旺相為一","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195812404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562548486766644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"福。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195812404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"子逢凶，母帶徳解救之為二福。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195828788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"始為凶將，終有吉神","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195845172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"為三福。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195845172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"初傳見鬼賊，年命尅制為四福。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195861556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"日神吉，臨旺相","logicSentenceId":"7679070442195877940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"cont {"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"八迍：","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196402228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":744,"lineType":2,"content":"時令死氣發用，一也；用被地盤旺氣所勝，二也；俯仰見丘墓，仇克，三也；乘凶將，四也；帶刑，五也；下賊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":746,"lineType":2,"content":"上，六也；見墳墓哭泣神，七也；凶神臨日辰，八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"八者，迍邅憂患之象，故名八迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196402228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"占主一切凶病危，遭官坐死，謀無成，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196418612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"小吉臨寅為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196434996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"八迍，春土死，用神是死氣，一迍未土","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196451380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"臨寅，寅旺木勝之，二迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196451380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"木墓在未，仰見其丘；丘土畏","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196467764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"木，俯見其仇，三迍朱雀為初傳，四迍雀與刑併，五迍","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196467764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"中傳子，臨未，下賊上，六迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196467764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"子為虚宿，與白虎同位，七","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196484148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562548486832180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196484148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"午加癸，乘凶將，螣蛇又下賊。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196500532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"八迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196516916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"八迍五福詳吉凶，以意推之無定神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196582452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"欲别凶微吉有力，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196598836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"不然八五是常文。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196598836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"冲破休囚刑墓殺，惡將都看有幾迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196615220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相相生吉神救，又視福之多少均。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196631604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"福力均時殃漸退，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196647988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"病瘥官事理得伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196647988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
