{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課日辰，六害相加，并行年為用，為侵害課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196680756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"六者，父母","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196697140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟妻子六親也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196697140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"害者，損也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196713524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"如子畏午冲，直上穿心，見","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196729908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"未合冲，助仇而為害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196729908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"害則似水，壅滯血氣，未行事多","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196746292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"阻隔。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196746292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"然子未為勢家害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196762676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"子加未，舉事無終始，及官非口","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196779060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"舌。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196779060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"未加子，營謀阻塞，有灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196795444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午夘辰，為少凌長害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196811828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加午，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196828212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"官病憂驚，夫妻不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196828212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"午加丑，事不明不就。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196844596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"夘加辰、辰加","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196860980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"夘，主事虚聲，爭財有阻。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196860980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳、申亥，為競強爭進害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442196877364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"寅加","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262364195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562548486848564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"已，主出行改動，退利進阻。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262364195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"巳加寅，主事艱阻，口舌憂疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262380579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"申加亥，事先的後疑阻，必無終始。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262396963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"亥加申，圖謀未遂，事","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262413347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"無終始。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262413347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌為鬼害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262429731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"酉加戌，隂小，逃亡病凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262446115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"戌加酉，時","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262462499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"有阻病凶事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262462499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"此害神主侵損相害，故曰侵害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262478883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"統損之體，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262495267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"乃防人暗筭之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262495267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：六親失靠，骨肉刑傷，財利譛害，疾病毆傷，求婚人破，出陣","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262511651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"軍殃，胎孕防墮，干謁不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262511651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"如六害神臨日辰，發用又乘凶將","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262528035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"惡殺，主侵害凶禍，當應損九二征凶之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262528035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶合徳善神吉","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262544419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562548486864948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"將，課體雖阻而終成，當應損上九，利有攸徃之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262544419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙子日申時夘將，占子日未害併用，子為侵害課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262560803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課中三刑發用，併行年，為刑傷課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262642723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"葢惡莫大于刑，刑","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262659107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"主傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262659107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅巳申刑者，寅中有木火，巳中有土金，申中","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262675491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"有金水。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262675491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"父子在位相傷，為無恩刑；寅刑巳，主舉動險阻，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262691875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"官事災害，彼刑我鬬，前事生發；巳刑申，長㓜不順，先犯","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262691875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"後成，彼刑我解，仇將恩報。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262691875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"申刑寅，人鬼殘賊，男女相制，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262708259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"彼刑我動。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262708259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"丑戌未刑者，三宫皆土，兄弟以力相傷，為恃","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262724643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"勢刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262724643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"丑刑戌，主官鬼刑禁，尊貴傷卑賤，有撓不明。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262741027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"戌刑","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262757411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562548486897716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"未，少凌長，舉事妻財凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262757411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"未刑丑，大小不和，或見喪服。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262773795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262790179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"夘相刑者，水木母子改節相傷，為無禮刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262790179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"子刑夘，主門","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262806563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"戸淫亂死敗，尊卑不睦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262806563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"夘刑子，去明入暗，水路不通，子","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262822947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"息不律。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262822947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"辰午酉亥自刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262839331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申巳亥，四冲無亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262855715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262872099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"四冲無辰，子午夘酉，四冲無酉午。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262872099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"惟子夘互刑，是四位","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262888483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"無所相刑，為自刑，主自逞髙大，更改自害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262888483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"受此四冲，缺","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262904867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"一不全，欹而不正，三者各自相推，不齊著力，罰而相刑，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262904867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"刑必有傷，故名刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262904867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"若尋奴僕小人，奔走去向，詳支之","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262921251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562551993221170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"刑神所臨之方，追之必獲。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262921251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"統訟之體，乃大小不和之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262937635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：偏欹失位，家門不昌。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262954019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"胎孕欲墮，婚姻不良。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262970403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"征下順","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262986787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"利，鬭上刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442262986787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"謀為乖戾，凡事遭殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263003171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"如刑神為用，或遞互","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263019555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"相加，乘凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263019555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"將臨日辰，皆主傷殘，人情不和。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263035939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"刑于男傷，人","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263052323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"身不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263052323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"刑支，女，病家宅不安。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263068707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"時刑干，憂小口小人，時下","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263085091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"事不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263085091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"善刑惡，無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263101475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"惡刑善，凶至。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263117859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"刑月建者，不可訟人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263134243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"刑日神者，不可逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263150627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"干刑速，支刑遲，或上下相刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263167011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"遇日","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263183395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，主公私之擾，尊長不分，凡事乖戻，謀幹費力，忌小人","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263183395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562551993237554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"見蛇血。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263183395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"支血忌孕必墮胎及血光災。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263199779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"或辰自刑，又見辰","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263216163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"乘凶將，主燥爆，挾刃自傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263216163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"或六處有神，作支之自刑，又","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263232547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"作干鬼結連，三傳為鬼為助刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263232547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"或伐徳，甚凶，當訟上九。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263248931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"或錫鞶帶三褫之凶象。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263265315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇徳神，吉將有氣，事有阻，終","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263281699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"遂象。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263281699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562551993270322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"凡偷盜，男女奔走，止論刑徳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263314467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"葢尊貴以徳，卑賤以刑，故","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263330851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"為刑德格。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263330851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"刑者，寅午戌日，刑在巳午未方。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263347235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰日，刑","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263363619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅夘辰方。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263363619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑日，刑在申酉戌方。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263380003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"亥夘未日，刑在","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263396387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑方。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263396387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"徳者：甲已徳寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263412771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚徳申。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263429155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛戌癸徳巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263445539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263461923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"壬徳亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263461923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"陽徳自處，隂徳從陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263478307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"占奴僕尋刑，徳勝刑易獲，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263494691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"刑勝徳難見。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263494691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"徳刑不相尅，見閉口課中推。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263511075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"尋常人占，但","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263527459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"取天盤上徳刑下所加之地，以别貴賤去向之方是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263527459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚子日戌時亥將，占走奴婢，支刑在夘，下加寅，主去","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263543843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562543755739148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"東北方，追之可獲，應在刑受尅，金徳木刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263543843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"若占貴人","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263560227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"君子，日徳在申，下加未，主往西南，尋之可見，應德受生，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263560227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"日時到也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263560227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"其二者配為徳刑格。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263576611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四仲月將，遇四正及四平日，占得日月宿加四仲，斗","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263609379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"罡繫五未，為二煩課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263609379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲者，子、午、夘、酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263625763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"日宿者，太陽","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263642147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"躔度宫神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263642147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"正月起亥，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263658531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"月宿者，太隂星躔","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263674915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562551993319474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"度宫神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263674915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"正月初一起室，二奎，三胃，四畢，五參，六鬼，七","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263691299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"張，八角，九氐，十尾，十一斗，十二虚，每月初一移一宿，逐","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263691299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"日數二十八宿，遇奎、張、井、翌、氐、斗宿，重筭留一數盡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263691299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"月","logicSentenceId":"7679070442263707683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"cont {"lines":[{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"日宿臨四仲為天煩，月宿臨四仲為地煩。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631921704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"斗繋丑未為","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631938088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"天地煩，不繫丑未則為杜傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631938088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"當此之時，四位倶閉，三光","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631954472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"不明，徳氣在內，刑氣在外，利于居家，不利逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631954472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"男子抵","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631970856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"日，女子抵月。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631970856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"凡舉百事，喜者反怒，解者復結，殃及子孫，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631987240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"禍更復作。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442631987240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"男禁天煩，無抵四正，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442632003624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":1248,"lineType":2,"content":"弦望晦朔之日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"以此舉事，刑戮","logicSentenceId":"7679070442632003624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"大驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442632003624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"女禁地煩，無抵四平。","logicSentenceId":"7679070 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬之日是丁，前一日是丙，丙為金絶之末日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442790944820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679070442790961204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"日占事，未上見太乙，是未日臨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442790961204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"以丙課在巳，此是","logicSentenceId":"7679070442790977588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562566165757978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"四立于上神分明未日臨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442790977588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵天禍四立日干見","logicSentenceId":"7679070442790993972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"昨日天干上發用者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442790993972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"火動燒人死，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791010356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1384,"lineType":2,"content":"若庚辛之日為四立日，見末日臨之，又發用，若火神動者，主雷霆逆禍事。天降火燒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1386,"lineType":2,"content":"人，或天中有叱異之事，如庚辛為未日，又火神動者，主此灾禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"水臨刼盜深。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791026740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1388,"lineType":2,"content":"若水動，有水災賊盜，亦是家中濁濫而生凶禍也。丙丁為末日，又得水神發用者，課","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1390,"lineType":2,"content":"主盜賊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"木因梁屋事，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791043124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1392,"lineType":2,"content":"若木動，主屋塌梁墜，下扎而致死亡之事。如戊已為未日，見木神，主此災禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"土動為爭論。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791043124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1394,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸日立春，得未發用，見土神，主此灾禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562566165774362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"金則兵戈亂，閙處起哀聲。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791059508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":1398,"lineType":2,"content":"如金動，主兵戈刀死刃傷。甲乙日立春，立春時得末發用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1400,"lineType":2,"content":"是金神，主此灾禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"四立日占為百事，切忌干臨向絶辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791108660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1406,"lineType":2,"content":"立春、立夏、立秋、立冬四立前一日為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1408,"lineType":2,"content":"四絶，前日干臨今日干是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此是名天禍卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791125044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"天咎之災四五旬。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791141428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1410,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：禍不出一節，一節四十五日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"今日立春當乙酉，昨暮窮冬是甲申。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791157812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"假令乙酉戌時課，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791174196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562566165839898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"乙將臨甲害凌人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791174196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知禍患縁何起，以將推之決是因。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791190580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎死亡玄武賊，官事追朱鬭勾陳。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791206964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"天空作事主欺詐，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791223348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"若依此法豈遭迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791223348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"天禍四立日，日干臨前一日日干上。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791239732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"　天㓂分至日，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791256116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"日支臨前一日日支上。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791256116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"　創始值於干絶，　旺極值","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791272500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"於支離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791272500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"天禍主九十日。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791288884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"水絶水厄，火絶火災，虎加","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791305268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"病死，玄加盜賊。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791305268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"天㓂主四十五日出行遭刼、造屋、火灾，骨肉不相保，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791321652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562563213115444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"疫癘必相傷，遇之者，上天怒之咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791321652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課囚死墓神發用斗係日，本為天獄卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791370804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"葢囚死者，時","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791387188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2ccgz/1-SK1599_figure_00033.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5g6zcS9XA0KMyNVLUpx1yfolXpU%3D","pictureHeight":1242,"pictureWidth":436,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2ccgz/1-SK1599_figure_00033.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=EY2Dc4k0K1iw9qK0WndgjX0C2tg%3D","uri":"read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2ccgz/1-SK1599_figure_00033.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562562516844585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"令囚死之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791403572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"墓者，日庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791419956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"我克者為死，克我者為囚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791436340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"夫死囚發用，主死喪囚禁之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791452724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"斗者，辰為罡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791469108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"日本者，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791485492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"日干長生位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791485492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"若日本強旺，生日有救。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791501876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"今日本又遭斗","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791518260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"係，不能扶助，用神囚死墓𦵏之氣，如天降災殃，致入罹","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791518260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"獄難逃，故名天獄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791518260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"占者憂患相仍難解，統噬嗑之體，委","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791534644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"靡不振之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791534644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：日用迍邅，刑獄之愆。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791551028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"犯法難解，𣑱病未痊。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791567412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"出行凶","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791583796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791583796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"謀事徒然，兵家大忌，出軍不旋。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791600180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神囚死，俯仰兵","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791616564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562566165856282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"仇。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791616564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"斗係日本，或乙日辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791632948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"加亥，孟神，憂父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791649332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"加夘，仲神，憂","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791665716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"同𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791665716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"加未，季神憂妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791682100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"或帶刑殺灾刼，為真天獄，雖有","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791698484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍，莫能救止。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791698484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"或為魄化奇，係日本，凶禍尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791714868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"當此之","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791731252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"時，不可出行及造作，百事皆凶，則應噬嗑上九，何校滅","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791731252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"耳，凶象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791731252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"然辰為天牢，戌為地網。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791747636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"若罪囚入獄，喜見貴","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791764020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"人臨辰戌，有履獄録囚之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791764020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"更日辰行年，得子孫生氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791780404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"徳合解神，吉將，為獄清平，則危中有救，憂中有喜，官訟","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791780404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1478,"lineType":1,"content":"得理，賊圍可解。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791780404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1478,"lineType":1,"content":"當應九四，得金矢，利艱貞，吉之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791796788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562563213148212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙酉日，春占未土死氣，發用斗罡係亥，為天獄課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791813172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"天獄","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791845940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1486,"lineType":2,"content":"癸用死囚，斗繋日本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"日本者，干長生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791845940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"我克為死，克我為囚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791862324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"死囚發用巳，主死喪囚繫。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791878708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"又是斗罡凶神，臨日本之上，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791895092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1490,"lineType":1,"content":"如天降災，致人罹獄難脱，故名天獄課","logicSentenceId":"7679070442791895092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1588,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四離日占得月宿加離辰，為天㓂課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904338432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1588,"lineType":1,"content":"葢春分秋分，夘","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904354816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月中，隂陽均分而離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904354816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至夏至，子午月中，隂陽俱至","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904371200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"而離。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904371200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"四時之中，惟此春分秋分、冬至夏至四至前一日","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904387584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"為四離，乃隂陽生殺，多主盜賊。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904387584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"月宿者，乃太隂躔度之","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904403968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904403968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"正月初一起室，逆行二十八宿，毎日約行十三度，所","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904420352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"到之宫辰為月宿。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904420352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"隂精刑殺主盜，加此四離之神，明中","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904436736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"為盜，如天降凶㓂，殃及于人，故名天㓂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904436736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":1600,"lineType": {"lines":[{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：隂陽分離，氣不得反。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904469504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"盜賊滋生，軍兵墮懶，病者即","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904485888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，孕婦當産，出路死傷，婚姻拆散。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904485888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"如月宿加離辰，發用","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904502272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"禍事尤速。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904502272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"乘玄武、勾陳，作逰都盜神，定主盜賊，來則必","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904518656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904518656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"或乘虎作鬼刼，為真天㓂，其凶尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904535040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"此時出行市買，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904551424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"主刼盜喪亡，百事不遂，則應蹇，險在前也，其道窮也，凶","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904551424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"象。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904551424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"若占人年命，見月宿加離辰，必已身欲為盜，來問也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904567808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1618,"lineType":1,"content":"故月宿值太陽，日月併明，主盜賊敗露，為敗㓂，當應蹇，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904584192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562566165987354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"見險能止，大人濟蹇之吉象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904584192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"天㓂","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904633344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1628,"lineType":2,"content":"分至日，占得月宿臨離辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"春分、秋分，隂陽均分，冬至、夏至，隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904633344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"俱至。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904633344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"分至前一日為離，乃隂陽離析，盜生盜殺之時。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904649728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"月","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904666112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"宿詳見二煩課中，即正月起室，二月起奎等是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904666112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"逢奎","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904682496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2deeb/1-SK1599_figure_00036.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=LtAY3d69R%2FpUUZL0WvmJH0H5FM4%3D","pictureHeight":1248,"pictureWidth":221,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2deeb/1-SK1599_figure_00036.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=aI5TdZg4ppJAWn55KJZKPZvrNhE%3D","uri":"read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2deeb/1-SK1599_figure_00036.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562577330946111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1638,"lineType":1,"content":"井張、翼氐、斗，皆重留一日，數到四離日，若是月宿加之，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904698880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"當主㓂盜。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904698880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"假如八月初五日丁酉秋分，辰將酉時占事，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904715264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"初一角，初二亢，初三氐，氐該重留一日，初四仍在氐。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904715264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"初","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904731648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"五房，房宿在夘，申為離辰，而夘加之，是離辰上望見月","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904731648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904731648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"月乃金水之精，主刑殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904748032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"又乘四離盗氣之辰，如天降","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904764416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"凶㓂，殃及于人，故名天㓂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904764416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"占主凡事破壊，多值亂離，盗猖兵敗，病者死，孕婦即","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904780800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"産，是女而凶，出路死傷，婚拆散，營造見火災，謀望不","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904780800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562577331028031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"成，一動即有生分死别之象，雖有救神莫解，惟居家","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904780800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"守靜可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904780800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"月宿臨離辰，不在課傳，亦凶，發用更甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904797184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"乘","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904813568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"玄勾作逰都盗神，盗必來，來必戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904813568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"乘虎作鬼刼，為真","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904829952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"天㓂，凶尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904829952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"此時不可出行市賈，主刼盗喪亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904846336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"若占","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904862720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"人年命，見月宿加離辰，必巳身欲為盗，來問也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904862720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"或月","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904879104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"宿值太陽，日月並明，主盗賊敗露，為敗㓂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904879104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"觀月經　四離，見月宿離神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904895488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"地盤上看月宿，天","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904911872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"盤上看","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904911872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562566165970970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"分至四神上，蟾光月正臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904928256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1674,"lineType":2,"content":"分至者，即春分、秋分、夏至、冬至四辰也。如二月初二日春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":1676,"lineType":2,"content":"分是丁夘，先一日是丙寅。初五日夘時占，從奎數至昴為初五，酉是月宿，用戌將加夘時，寅上得酉，是蟾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1678,"lineType":2,"content":"光月正臨也。凡此四日有之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"名為天㓂卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904944640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"百禍俱來侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904961024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1680,"lineType":2,"content":"四課日辰上得月宿太隂之星，舉百事皆凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻有離折，君臣義不深。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904977408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1682,"lineType":2,"content":"主夫妻别離，君臣失義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"傳中雖有救，父子淚淋淋。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442904993792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1684,"lineType":2,"content":"主離别、失財、破散，為四離課也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":1686,"lineType":2,"content":"假令寅日春夘時占，寅上見離辰太隂，更得金神發用，即凶卦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562577330978879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1692,"lineType":2,"content":"假令申日冬至將得未作太隂，加申，更得火神發用，即凶也。其灾害所主，大概與天禍同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽生殺言分至，","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905026560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1696,"lineType":2,"content":"陽至主生，隂至主殺。春分陽氣盗，殺在夘，故榆莢落。夏至隂氣盗，殺在午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1698,"lineType":2,"content":"故菁麥死。秋分陽氣旺，殺在酉，故麥生。冬至陽氣初生，殺在子，是根本，故蘭菊生，萌芽動。此四者，名曰朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1700,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，不得久立也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"前之一日是離神，假令春分今日夘，離神昨日乃居寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905042944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"占時月宿在寅上。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905059328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1704,"lineType":2,"content":"月宿在二煩之卦註定，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其多少悉殃人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905075712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"月是","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905092096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"積隂為殺氣，離上逢之天禍迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905092096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"非是行人去遭刼，即是","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905108480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562577331044415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"修營害其身。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905108480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1710,"lineType":2,"content":"要知心月狐在夘，　危月燕在子，　張月鹿在午，　畢月烏在酉，　遇此乃真月宿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課占時，與用神同克日，為天網課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905141248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"葢時為目前，用為","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905157632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"事始。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905157632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"時用既為日鬼，如人舉目見天網，故名天網。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905174016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"占者","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905190400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事不能踴躍登髙至逺，統蒙之體，乃羅網在頭之","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905190400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070442905190400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1838,"lineType":1,"content":"凡白虎帶死神死氣臨日辰，行年發用，為𩲸化課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013521442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1838,"lineType":1,"content":"葢虎","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013537826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"乃凶將，乘旺相氣受制，不能為害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013537826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇死神死氣及時","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013554210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"囚死之神，則為餓虎，定是傷人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013554210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"如𩲸神受驚，化而飛散，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013570594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"故名𩲸化。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013570594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"死神正月起巳，死氣正月起午，俱順行十二","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013586978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013586978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"其神乘虎克日，占忌巳，身之災，克辰，門戸之灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013603362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"統蠱","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013619746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562578522210304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"之體，乃隂害相連之課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013619746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1852,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：人身喪𩲸，憂患相仍。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013636130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1852,"lineType":1,"content":"病多喪死，訟有憂驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013652514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1852,"lineType":1,"content":"産孕傷","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013668898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"子，征戰損兵。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013668898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"謀而招禍，切莫逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013685282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"如日墓乘虎，或魁罡","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013701666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"作日墓，帶死囚神，發用為虎銜屍，極凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013701666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"或在年命，又為","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013718050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1858,"lineType":1,"content":"日鬼，乃自已喪𩲸，動則自尋死也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013718050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1858,"lineType":1,"content":"或日墓虎鬼臨干，主","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013734434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":1860,"lineType":1,"content":"身受殃，且凶速速。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013734434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1860,"lineType":1,"content":"日墓虎臨支克支，宅有伏屍作怪，或","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013750818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"有形響。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013750818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"虎在陽憂男，在隂憂女。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013767202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"上克下及日外喪，下克","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013783586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1864,"lineType":1,"content":"上與辰內喪。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013783586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1864,"lineType":1,"content":"或人年在魁罡蛇虎之下，無冲克救解，決","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013799970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562578522259456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1868,"lineType":1,"content":"有身主死亡之殃，當應蠱蟲在𠾖，六四往見吝之凶象。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013799970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1870,"lineType":1,"content":"若虎臨鬼門，虎隂神制虎，日辰年命處有冲克，及吉神","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013816354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1872,"lineType":1,"content":"救解，為𩲸化䰟歸，先憂後喜，則應上九髙尚其事之吉","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013816354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1874,"lineType":1,"content":"象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013816354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1884,"lineType":1,"content":"化","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013881890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1884,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎乘死神、死炁，及囚死臨日辰，行年發用。又曰墓乘虎作鬼，加日亦是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1884,"lineType":1,"content":"死神正月起","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013881890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1886,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，死炁正月起午，俱順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013881890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":1886,"lineType":1,"content":"虎乃凶神，乘旺相，自","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013898274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1888,"lineType":1,"content":"貪其旺，或受克制，皆難為害。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013898274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1888,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇死神、死炁，及時令囚","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013914658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1890,"lineType":1,"content":"死，則為餓虎，定是傷人。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013914658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":1890,"lineType":1,"content":"如魄神受驚消散，故名𩲸化，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013931042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1892,"lineType":1,"content":"占主凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013931042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1892,"lineType":1,"content":"病者死，無病亦有病，訟憂驚、孕傷子，戰損兵，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013947426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":1894,"lineType":1,"content":"謀為招禍，逺行更忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013947426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1894,"lineType":1,"content":"如日墓作鬼乘虎，或作魁罡帶","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013963810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1896,"lineType":1,"content":"囚死發用，為虎銜尸，更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013963810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":1896,"lineType":1,"content":"若在年命上，主自尋死，併","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013980194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1898,"lineType":1,"content":"金神三殺、血支血忌，主刀下身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013980194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1898,"lineType":1,"content":"或水神天河地井","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013996578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562580057309234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1902,"lineType":1,"content":"相迫，必是自欲投水溺死，或為懸索勾絞，主自縊死。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443013996578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1904,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵虎克干防身，克支防宅，上克下外喪，下克上內","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014012962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"喪。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014012962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"在陽憂男，在隂憂女。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014029346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"如二月甲戌日課得戌，甲午","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014045730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1908,"lineType":1,"content":"戌午、戌寅午三傳戌午寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014045730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1908,"lineType":1,"content":"將得虎，乘天上死神迫日","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014062114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1910,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014062114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1910,"lineType":1,"content":"必有死喪事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014078498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1910,"lineType":1,"content":"午為陽，憂男子。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014094882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1910,"lineType":1,"content":"下克上，內喪。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014111266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1910,"lineType":1,"content":"又如六","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014127650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1912,"lineType":1,"content":"月壬戌日，課得戌，壬酉戌酉戌、申酉三傳戌酉申。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014127650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1912,"lineType":1,"content":"將","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014144034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":1914,"lineType":1,"content":"得虎，乘地下死神迫日辰，必有死喪事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014144034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":1914,"lineType":1,"content":"戌為陽，憂男","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014160418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1916,"lineType":1,"content":"子上克下，外喪。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014160418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562578522308608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1920,"lineType":1,"content":"此課十分凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014176802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":1920,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴臨鬼門，日辰年命得吉神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014193186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":1920,"lineType":1,"content":"虎被冲","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014209570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1922,"lineType":1,"content":"克，為𩲸化䰟歸，先憂後喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014209570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1924,"lineType":1,"content":"觀月經　　名旱苗無雨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014225954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1924,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎乘死神，死氣臨日辰。行年主有灾殃，病者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":1926,"lineType":2,"content":"不甦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":1928,"lineType":1,"content":"死囚為白虎，來臨日用由。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014242338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1928,"lineType":1,"content":"𩲸化䰟消散，死亡病者愁。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014258722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":1928,"lineType":1,"content":"行","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014275106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":1930,"lineType":1,"content":"年同位上，患者命難留。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014275106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":1930,"lineType":1,"content":"細意看年用，凶神禍病尤。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014291490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":1930,"lineType":2,"content":"假令正月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1932,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳日寅時占戌加癸為發用。上克下。白虎乘死氣來克癸水。三傳又見天羅，日之正墓也，將是螣蛇。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1934,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有死亡之事。若人行年至丑必凶。依元首卦推之，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562578522292224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1938,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎西方本是金，性專刑殺忌加臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014307874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":1938,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇死神相㑹合，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014324258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":1940,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰年上見灾侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014324258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":1940,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此即名𩲸化卦，假若無病也昏沈。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014340642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1942,"lineType":1,"content":"二月寅時甲戌日，勝光為虎是其隂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014357026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":1942,"lineType":2,"content":"甲上天魁，戌上勝光，是甲之隂神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1944,"lineType":1,"content":"死神正巳二居午，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014373410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":1944,"lineType":2,"content":"死神正月在巳，順行十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":1944,"lineType":1,"content":"止怕相𠔥作害深。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014373410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1944,"lineType":2,"content":"虎為死神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1946,"lineType":2,"content":"𠔥之相逼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1998,"lineType":1,"content":"凡天乙逆行，日辰在後，用其凶死。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014684706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1998,"lineType":1,"content":"將乘玄虎，時克行年，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014701090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":2000,"lineType":1,"content":"為三隂卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014701090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":2000,"lineType":1,"content":"葢貴人逆治，日辰在後，隂氣不順，一也；用神","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014717474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":2002,"lineType":1,"content":"囚死，動作無光，隂氣不振，二也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014717474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":2002,"lineType":1,"content":"將乘玄虎，時克行年，隂","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014733858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"氣不利，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014733858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"此三者，暗昧幽晦，故名三隂課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014750242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"占者凡事","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014766626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562578522390528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":2008,"lineType":1,"content":"不通，多有晦滯，統中孚之體，乃羣隂黨惡之課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443014766626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":2308,"lineType":1,"content":"所生為父母，同類兄弟親。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282137088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":2308,"lineType":1,"content":"墓處論妻妾，三竒推苦辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282153472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":2308,"lineType":1,"content":"斗","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282169856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":2310,"lineType":1,"content":"臨遭死損，月至憂患頻。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282169856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":2310,"lineType":1,"content":"日到灾殃散，思量卦有神。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282186240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":2310,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲乙，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":2312,"lineType":2,"content":"為生，寅夘為𩔖，未為墓，是妾。　如丙丁，寅為生，巳午為𩔖，戌為墓。　戊已，巳午為生，四季為𩔖，辰為墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":2314,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛日，已為生，申酉為𩔖，丑為墓。壬癸日申為生，亥子為𩔖，辰為墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":2318,"lineType":1,"content":"天上三竒日月星。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282219008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":2318,"lineType":1,"content":"日為福徳月為刑，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282235392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":2318,"lineType":2,"content":"三竒皆靈竒也。日為福徳者，日出則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":2320,"lineType":2,"content":"奸盗止，鬼神潛，惡獸伏，病者愈，故為福也。月為刑者，月夜矅也，則奸盗不止，鬼神不潛，惡獸不伏，病則劇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562592493469750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":2324,"lineType":2,"content":"故主刑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":2326,"lineType":1,"content":"星是死竒為北斗，更互加之各有靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282251776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":2326,"lineType":2,"content":"星是死竒，謂北斗星也。星斗之光不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":2328,"lineType":2,"content":"及日月之曜，處暗之中，奸盗不止也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":2330,"lineType":1,"content":"加孟所生憂父母，臨仲為身及弟兄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282268160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":2330,"lineType":1,"content":"季上見之妻與子，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282284544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":2332,"lineType":1,"content":"看其藏否與誰併。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282284544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":2332,"lineType":2,"content":"假令今日丙子，斗加寅為孟，所憂父母。臨午為仲，所憂巳身及兄弟。臨戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":2334,"lineType":2,"content":"是季，為妻子奴婢。寅是火生，午是火旺，戌是火墓。他例此。看何竒加何位，即可知之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":2336,"lineType":1,"content":"日主旬中辰月裏，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282300928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":2336,"lineType":2,"content":"竒加日，吉凶在旬内。竒加辰，吉凶在月内。遇竒則吉凶有應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":2338,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗上，一年之內程。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282300928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":2338,"lineType":2,"content":"竒在太嵗，吉凶在一年之内應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562594628272143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":2342,"lineType":1,"content":"星月獨臨當死患","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282317312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":2342,"lineType":2,"content":"星竒主死，月竒主患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":2344,"lineType":1,"content":"其中日照免危傾。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282333696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":2344,"lineType":2,"content":"星月之竒雖主凶惡，若日辰太嵗上或有日竒，則星月不能灾殃也。葢日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":2346,"lineType":2,"content":"出則星月沒故也。　　日竒者，月將也，是太陽，故曰日宿。　月竒者，月宿也，是太隂，是二十八宿直日發用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":2348,"lineType":2,"content":"也，亦如二煩卦論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
