{"lines":[{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":2352,"lineType":1,"content":"三光媞媞，更立三竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282366464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":2352,"lineType":1,"content":"斗為死亡，月為憂患。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282382848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":2352,"lineType":1,"content":"日為福徳，孟","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282399232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":2354,"lineType":1,"content":"為二親，仲為巳身，季為妻子奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282399232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":2354,"lineType":1,"content":"謂斗繫之憂死亡，月","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282415616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":2356,"lineType":1,"content":"照之憂疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282415616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":2356,"lineType":1,"content":"日加之有喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282432000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":2356,"lineType":1,"content":"日，太陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282448384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":2356,"lineType":1,"content":"日加年，雖見斗","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282464768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562592493518902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":2360,"lineType":1,"content":"月，即免凶憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282464768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":2360,"lineType":1,"content":"日為旬期，辰為月期，嵗為年期。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282481152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":2360,"lineType":1,"content":"三者不傷，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282497536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":2362,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗中無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282497536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":2362,"lineType":1,"content":"三者盡傷，嵗中受殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282513920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":2362,"lineType":1,"content":"謂斗繫今日日辰及嵗","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282530304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":2364,"lineType":1,"content":"辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282530304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":2366,"lineType":1,"content":"定章曰：日月星謂之三光，懸象著明為媞。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282546688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":2366,"lineType":1,"content":"若今日日","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282563072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":2368,"lineType":1,"content":"月及斗並見，應天三竒，斗為凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282563072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":2368,"lineType":1,"content":"所繫者死，月為","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282579456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":2370,"lineType":1,"content":"刑氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282579456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":2370,"lineType":1,"content":"所臨者憂，日為福徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282595840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":2370,"lineType":1,"content":"則能救之。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282612224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":2370,"lineType":1,"content":"所生為孟，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282628608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":2372,"lineType":1,"content":"所旺為仲，所死為季。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282628608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":2374,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙日，亥為所生，夘為所旺，未為所死。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282644992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":2374,"lineType":1,"content":"斗月臨孟，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282661376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562594628337679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":2378,"lineType":1,"content":"憂二親。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282661376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":2378,"lineType":1,"content":"斗月臨仲，憂巳身兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282677760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":2378,"lineType":1,"content":"斗月臨季，憂妻子奴","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282694144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":2380,"lineType":1,"content":"婢。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282694144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":2392,"lineType":1,"content":"凡喪車、逰魂、伏殃、病符、喪弔、丘墓、嵗虎發用者，為灾厄","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282792448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562592493535286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":2396,"lineType":1,"content":"課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282792448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":2396,"lineType":1,"content":"葢喪車，一名喪魂，正月起未，逆行四季，為惡鬼臨","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282808832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":2398,"lineType":1,"content":"門，主病疾憂死，婦人産厄，非病有危。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282808832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":2398,"lineType":1,"content":"逰魂，正月起亥，順","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282825216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":2400,"lineType":1,"content":"行十二辰，為鬼祟妖怪不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282825216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":2400,"lineType":1,"content":"主精神驚恐，病患凶災。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282841600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":2400,"lineType":1,"content":"伏","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282857984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":2402,"lineType":1,"content":"殃者正月起酉，逆行四仲，為天鬼煞。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282857984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":2402,"lineType":1,"content":"主殃禍所侵，伏兵","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282874368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":2404,"lineType":1,"content":"殺傷，病符舊。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282874368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":2404,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗臨支克支，主合家病患，并天鬼時疫，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282890752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":2406,"lineType":1,"content":"并白虎，死喪甚凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282890752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":2406,"lineType":1,"content":"或臨干支旺相，帶日財貴人，即宜成","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282907136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":2408,"lineType":1,"content":"合殘年舊事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282907136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":2408,"lineType":1,"content":"喪弔：嵗前二辰為喪門，嵗後二辰為弔客。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282923520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":2410,"lineType":1,"content":"若全加支干，或年命發用，主身被孝服，或并死氣絶神","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282939904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562594628354063"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":2414,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎臨身，弔客入宅，主自身死亡，致宅人掛孝。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282939904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":2414,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎嵗","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282956288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":2416,"lineType":1,"content":"后四神并旬虎臨日辰，最為凶，并鬼病不可療。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282956288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":2416,"lineType":1,"content":"五墓者，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282972672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":2418,"lineType":1,"content":"金丑木未火戌水土辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282972672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":2418,"lineType":1,"content":"主死喪病凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443282989056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":2418,"lineType":1,"content":"三丘庫墓冲位，并","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283005440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":2420,"lineType":1,"content":"虎雀喪門，有𦵏埋事。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283005440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":2420,"lineType":1,"content":"臨丑，有墓田事，或丘墓入傳季神","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283021824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":2422,"lineType":1,"content":"逢丁神將凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283021824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":2422,"lineType":1,"content":"主惡禍官病，凶灾最速。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283038208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":2422,"lineType":1,"content":"此凶殺灾殃危厄，","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283054592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":2424,"lineType":1,"content":"故名灾厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283054592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":2424,"lineType":1,"content":"統歸妹之體，乃鬼祟作孽之課。","logicSentenceId":"7679070443283070976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

380913041408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562592493649974"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"解。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913041408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"如三傳衆鬼雖彰，有制無畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913057792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"或春占，木旺克土鬼，自","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913074176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"貪榮盛，無意興灾，至夏秋，其禍仍發。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913074176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"如傳財太旺，財反","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913090560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"傾危。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913090560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"或冬占，水旺克火長上主灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913106944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"但財自貪生旺，身弱","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913123328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"難受，至身旺財衰之時，或可取。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913123328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913139712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562592493633590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"殃咎","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913188864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":72,"lineType":2,"content":"遞克、夾克，外戦、内戦，乘墓、坐墓皆是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"遞克者，初克中，中克末，未克干；","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913188864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"又末克中，中克初，初克干是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913188864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"夾克者，用神下既坐克，","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913205248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"上又受將克。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913205248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"如午加亥，將乘玄武是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913221632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"外戰者，三傳皆","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913238016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"將克神。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913238016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"內戰者，三傳皆神克將。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913254400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"乘墓者，干上支上各乘","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913270784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"墓神。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913270784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅日，丙上戌，寅上未是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380913287168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pin {"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"九醜：","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914008064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":164,"lineType":2,"content":"戊子、戊午、壬子、壬午、乙夘、己夘、辛夘、乙酉、已酉、辛酉，此十日占丑臨四仲𤼵用是也。不發用而臨支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":166,"lineType":2,"content":"上者，亦是四仲時占更的。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"子為冬至，以陽易陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914008064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"午為夏至，以陰易陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914024448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"夘為春分，陽盛陰絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914040832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為秋分，陰盛陽絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914057216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"此陰陽易絶","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914073600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰，有生殺之道焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914073600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"乙者，雷始震之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914089984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"戊已，北辰下降","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914106368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914106368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"辛者，萬物斷絶之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914122752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"壬者，三光不照之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679068380914139136","marginNoteIdList {"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"凡日辰墓神及日鬼發用，為鬼墓課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430690943016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"葢鬼者，賊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430690959400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"陽見","logicSentenceId":"7679068430690975784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562594628534287"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，陰見陰為鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430690975784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日用申，乙日用酉，丙日用子，丁日","logicSentenceId":"7679068430690992168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"用亥，戊日用寅，已日用夘，庚日用午，辛日用已，壬日用","logicSentenceId":"7679068430690992168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌，癸日用丑未，為鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430690992168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼多主事不美，謀望不成，且災","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691008552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"凶及已身陰鬼，星宿神祗；陽鬼，公訟是非。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691008552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"墓者，䝉昧也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691024936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691041320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙寅夘見未。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691041320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁已，午見戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691057704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己辰戌丑未。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691074088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸亥，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691090472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"子見辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691090472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛申，酉見丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691106856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"若用起，丑加申，辰加亥，未加寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691123240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"戌加已，為用起。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691123240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"四墓格或甲日，未加寅，為墓神覆日，主","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691139624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"人口災晦。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691139624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"或丁夘日，戌加夘，為干墓臨支，主宅舍衰廢，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691156008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562595547037705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"為闗神尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691156008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"闗神春丑夏辰秋未冬戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691172392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"或壬寅，干上","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691188776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":252,"line {"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：五行克賊，死墓之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691385384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"人丁多耗，家宅不昌，行人可","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691401768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"至，病者如狂，謀為遲滯，捕盗深藏。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691401768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"如鬼在日上發用，常","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691418152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"人占事多凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691418152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"或內有徳神旺氣，求官大利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691434536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"或辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691450920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"作日鬼，為魁罡，占科舉必髙中。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691450920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"餘占用神克日，吉凶相","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691467304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562610050695195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"半，事多反覆而後成。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691467304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼帶惡殺，多主怪禍，舉動不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691483688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679068430691500072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"寅加酉，已加子，申加夘，亥加午，為用，乃傳墓入墓，自明"," {"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562609971052584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"占主一切凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692040744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"葢鬼者，賊也，主殘傷；墓者，昧也，主闇塞。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692057128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"都不利謀望，家不昌，病凶，財耗，盜難獲。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692073512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"陽鬼，公訟是","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692089896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"非；陰鬼，神祗星宿。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692089896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"墓有五格，日上得日墓，為墓神覆","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692106280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"日，主人昏晦，乃命運哀弱，天羅自裏，宜醮禳之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692106280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692122664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"得日墓，為干墓臨支，主宅傾頽。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692122664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"或日上得日墓，辰上","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692139048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"又得辰墓，為干支乘墓，人宅俱不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692139048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"或日下臨日墓，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692155432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"辰下又臨辰墓，為干支坐墓，乃自招禍，身心甘受昏","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692155432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"迷，家宅願顧，與人作踐，占病顛狂，行人失路。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692155432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"或日上","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692171816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562609971068968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"得辰墓，辰上得日墓，為干支互換坐墓，彼此各招晦","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692171816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"滯，不宜兩相投奔。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692171816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"辰未為日墓，暗中有明。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692188200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"夜墓坐日","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692204584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692204584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"丑戌為夜墓，昏昧自甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692220968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"日墓坐夜亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692237352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌墓","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692253736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"主事剛速，丑未墓主事柔緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692253736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"墓臨長生，舊事再發，訟","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692270120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"斷又起，病痊又作，事許又悔，仇解又生。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692270120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺入墓，事","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692286504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"成中止。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692286504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"墓入生旺，事廢復興。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692302888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"凡日辰墓乘蛇虎，加夘","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692319272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，與行年併為墓門開。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692319272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"如日墓加夘為外䘮，辰墓加","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692335656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"夘為內䘮，出外宜遷葬以禳之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692335656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"日墓加酉為內䘮，辰","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692352040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562608952000575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"墓加酉為外䘮，入內宜合夀木以禳之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692352040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"夘酉日墓臨","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692368424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"夘酉，為真墓門開，見䘮弔死神死氣尤的。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692368424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔發用","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692384808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"囚死克賊歸墓，是何𩔖神，以定何人䘮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692384808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"大都鬼墓","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692401192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"發用，無氣病最忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692401192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"乘虎必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692417576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"或財神祿神、官星長生","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692433960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"在中，未見墓，仕人不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692433960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"此課常人更忌見鬼，鬼帶惡殺更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692450344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"惟內有徳神旺","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692466728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，求官大利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692466728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"或魁罡及丑未作日鬼，占科名髙中。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692483112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692499496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"日鬼發用，中末逢墓，常人為喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692499496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"或鬼墓臨日辰作生","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692515880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562610050711579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"炁，或自墓傳生，或鬼墓有克制冲破，或墓逢空，變凶為","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692515880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692515880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"病者生，囚者散，凡事先憂後喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430692532264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"凡天乙立夘酉，為勵徳課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791737378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"葢夘酉為陰陽交易之位，貴","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791753762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"人由之而遷易。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791753762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"如日辰陰神在天乙前，貴人不得引從，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791770146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562608952082495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"則退。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791770146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"陰主小吏退剥。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791786530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋小人恃勢，不知謹身修徳，則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791802914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791819298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰陽神在天乙後，貴人前引而從，則進。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791819298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主君子進用。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791835682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋君子知機，而能行仁布徳，則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791852066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"此天道福善禍淫，奨勵","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791868450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"有徳，占利君子，不利小人。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791868450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"統隨之體，乃反覆不定之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791884834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：陽神前引，陰神後隨，君子則吉，小人則危。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791901218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"陰神前","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791917602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"立，陽神後居，小人得意，君子失機。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791917602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"前既曰陽後得貴人","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791933986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"接引，利君子，此又曰陽神后居，君子失機，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791933986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"前乃止","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791950370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"于陽後，今乃陰前陽後俱全，故云君子失機也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791950370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽前，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791966754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562608952066111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"則貴人得其接引；陰前，則貴人受其羈絆。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791966754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"陰在貴人前，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791983138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"訟則卑遭責。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791983138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在貴後，灾則修徳自愈。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430791999522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴立夘酉，陽","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792015906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"前陰後，當應隨六三，係丈夫失小人之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792015906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"陰前陽後，當","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792032290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"隨應六二，小子失丈夫之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792032290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"此課通龜與訂訛皆説不明。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792638498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"止曰日辰陰神在天乙","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792654882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"前，而不説出陽神在何處。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792654882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"如俱在前，為蹉跎；如在後，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792671266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"為君子失機。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792671266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"止曰日辰陽神在天乙後，而不説出陰","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792687650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"神在何處。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792687650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"如俱在後，為微服；如在前，亦為君子失機","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792704034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792704034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"此課止宜以四段定之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792720418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰日辰陰陽俱在天乙","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792736802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562610050777115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"前，為蹉跎格，主小人進職，君子退位。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792736802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰俱在後，為","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792753186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"微服格，主君子遷官，小人退職。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792753186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰陽前陰後，君子","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792769570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉，小人則危。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792769570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"雖曰小人危，乃得陰陽之定位。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792785954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"小人","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792802338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"如守分循理，亦獲吉象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792802338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"四曰陰前陽後，小人得意，君","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792818722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"子失機。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792818722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"雖曰小人得意，葢陰在天乙前，貴人不得引","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792835106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"從，則必退抑其陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792835106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"又小人恃勢，不知謹身修徳，必至","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792851490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"于凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792851490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"雖曰君子失機，然陽乃貴人同類，貴人前引則","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792867874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"則必進扶其陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792867874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"又君子知機而能行仁布徳，終當獲","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792884258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562609971298344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792884258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"葢小人得意，君子失機者，其象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792900642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"其吉凶自取者，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792917026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"在人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792917026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"此理須明。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792933410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"定章曰：天乙立夘酉之上，為二八門刑徳之㑹，揺動","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792949794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"不安所居，法有轉移。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792949794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"陽立於陰者，在天乙之後也；陰","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792966178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"立於陽者，在天乙之前也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792966178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"假令七月辛亥日已將申時，小吉加辛，天罡為陰神","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792982562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"傳送加亥，陰得太乙勝光為天乙立酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792982562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行，小吉傳","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792998946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"送為日辰之陽神，居天乙之後。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430792998946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡、太乙為日辰之","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793015330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562609971265576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"陰，反居天乙之前。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793015330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰陰立天乙前，陽立天乙後。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793031714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"陰","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793048098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"陽錯亂，居非其居，故曰不安。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793048098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在陰位，今當進上；陰","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793064482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"在陽位，今當黜下。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793064482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"以此占人，貴者將遷，下吏罷退，庶","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793080866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"人居宅不安。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793080866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"勵徳言前后者，指天將而言，非論日辰午，以未為前，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793097250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"已為後也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793097250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"賦曰：天乙居中，後六前五是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793113634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2jpyb/1-SK1599_figure_00053.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=xFUH0Zs73SMByvy9H7mVr5LE4mc%3D","pictureHeight":1239,"pictureWidth":229,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2jpyb/1-SK1599_figure_00053.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Q7G49ZHXvlS6pwZSJET3yubHbdc%3D","uri":"read/SK1599/29/ref/1m2k8plx2jpyb/1-SK1599_figure_00053.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"凡太嵗月建及日時，并三傳，皆在四課之中，曰盤珠課","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793146402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793146402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子年七月乙已日酉時已將，占嵗月日時，皆在","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793162786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"四課之上，為天心格，主事逺大非常，及干朝廷，可以成","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793162786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"就。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793162786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛亥日占三傳戌酉申，皆在四課之上，為回還格，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793179170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"主謀為得遂，吉凶之事皆成。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793179170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"此二格合一，如盤中走珠，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793195554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"不出于外，故名盤珠。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793195554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"統大壮之體，乃鳳翔丹山之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793211938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：三傳四課，偶合異常。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430793228322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"吉則成福，凶則成殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959378447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"賊不出","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959394831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562609971314728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"境，行人還鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959394831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"陰私解釋，事反不良。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959411215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"如日用旺相，神將吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959427599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"大利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959427599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"或四課不備，守舊動作亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959443983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"課體吉，諸事利，則應大","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959460367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"壮九二貞吉之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959460367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"外如反吟課為逺，初傳太嵗中未月","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959476751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"日，為移逺就近，緩事為速也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959476751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"或斬闗課，日辰乘龍合，及","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959493135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"占時為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959493135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"中末傳空，乃動中不動，尋逺就近，惟柔日昴","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959509519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"星，伏匿不動耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959509519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"又如太嵗加河魁，魁加嵗為重陰，憂女。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959525903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"月建加天罡，罡加月為重陽，憂男。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959542287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"戌與嵗加月，為陰覆","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959558671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，事在內。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959558671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"月與辰加嵗，為陽覆陰，事在外。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959575055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"此時傳及年","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959591439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562636667748387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"命，雖吉亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959591439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"若盤珠課，占病訟、生産、憂疑，解釋，事反凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959607823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"日用囚死，神將凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959624207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事成禍，憂疑難解，灾甚，則應大壮","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959640591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"九二小人用壮，貞厲。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959640591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"羝羊觸藩，羸其角之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959656975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚戌年十二丑月，甲子日丑時子將占，子加丑為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959673359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時，三傳皆在四課之上，曰盤珠課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959689743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課得三合，俱在傳者，為全局課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959919119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"如三傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959935503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰，水局，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959951887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"名潤下格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959951887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"主溝渠魚網等事。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959968271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"占天陰雨。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430959984655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，火局，名","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960001039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"炎上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960001039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"主爐冶、文書等事。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960017423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"占天晴旱。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960033807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏，火旺相，水囚","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960050191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"死。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960050191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬，水旺相，火囚死。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960066575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"值旺相，老凶少吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960082959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"囚死者，少凶","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960099343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562636667764771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"老吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960099343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"用有氣孕生男。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960115727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"亥夘未，木局，曲直格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960132111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"主般車種植，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960148495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"利修造。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960148495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑，金局，名從革格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960164879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"主兵戈金鐵，利更改。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960181263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"春","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"冬木旺相，金囚死。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"季秋金旺相，木囚死。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960214031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"值旺相，經求利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960230415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"值囚死，坐守利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960246799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"用無氣孕生女。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960263183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未名稼穡。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960279567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"季夏","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960295951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相，動作遂意。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960295951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬衰敗，田墓有憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960312335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"此三方神全入傳，","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960328719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"同類一局，故名全局，統大畜之體，乃同𩔖懽㑹之課","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960328719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960328719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：三方㑹合，得成秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960345103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"吉事必成，凶事難棄。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"尊長","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960377871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562636667797539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"恩榮，常人財喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960377871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"利合婚姻，謀為大利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960394255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"如求財傳有財，財","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960410639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"易得。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960410639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"有官，官易就。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960427023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"日用旺氣相生，神將吉，大利則應。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960443407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960459791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"畜上九：何天之衢，亨象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960459791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"若日用衰，水倒，主事遲逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960476175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"火并","logicSentenceId":"7679068430960492559","marginNot {"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"占主文書金，併主爐冶事。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085797376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"土日生氣，木日盜氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085813760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"火為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085830144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562636667846691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"日象，君宜奏對。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085830144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"得驛馬貞位，為天子持權，仕人差遣","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085846528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"快心。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085846528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬貞位者，以罡加日建，視馬上所得神為貞","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085862912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"神，年命遇更吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085862912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"常人占主口舌及宅不安。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085879296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"火鬼併，火","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085895680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"災。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085895680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀併，官訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085912064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"天空併，屋壊。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431085928448","mar {"lines":[{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1298,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳俱孟，名曰玄胎。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434858536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1298,"lineType":1,"content":"其象嬰兒隠伏之狀，利上不利下，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434874920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1300,"lineType":1,"content":"事主逺而多伏，暗昧不通，觸則成禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434874920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1300,"lineType":1,"content":"申加已，名生胎，為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434891304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"憂課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434891304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"女人懐孕必的，安得不憂？","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434907688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"已加申，為病胎，又名怕","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434924072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"課，又名四病課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434924072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"胎孕有病，安得不怕？","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434940456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"生胎主事生新，病","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434956840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"胎主疾病，見虎入傳為驗。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431434956840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"然皆身喜心憂，事主四人共","logicSentenceId":"7679068431554969652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"課，終見災異，又在臨時消詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431554969652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟四孟，為絶玄胎也。" {"lines":[{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"凡日辰前後夾定，三傳在內，為夾定三傳格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555723316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事進退，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555739700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不由人，以其夾定故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555739700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"占病訟，解除事不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555756084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"問財，喜","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555772468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"并成，合事可為羙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555772468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸酉日，亥加戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555788852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日，戌加亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555805236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午日，辰加夘之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555821620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"凡日辰前後夾定少一位，為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555838004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"夾定虚一格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555838004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事有小節不完，其勢稍緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555854388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"或前虚一，主","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555870772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562637968293897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"初時有阻。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555870772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"或後虚一，主將成小阻。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555887156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"如虚一位，是日財，主","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555903540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"財上不足。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555903540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"父母則長上不足。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555919924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"丁夘日，干上申，三傳辰已","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555936308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"午。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555936308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"欠一未字，是子孫乘朱雀，主卑幼文字，口舌不足。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555952692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"年","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555969076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"命填實，不在此限。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555969076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"此三傳被干支夾定，不能進退，畢竟","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555985460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶皆不散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431555985460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"凡三傳透出日干之外，為夾不住格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556001844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"經","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556018228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"云：夾住不住，留中有去。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556018228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"若進透出者，因進之太過。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556034612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"退透","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556050996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"出者，因退之不及。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556050996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子日，三傳子亥戌是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556067380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"若干透","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556083764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"出支，不利外動，事有回還。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556083764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"支透出干，不利于內，惟宜外","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556100148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562649498222644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"動。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556100148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"或透鬼，鬼在外有凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556116532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"透財在外，有破耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556132916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556149300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"凡三","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556165684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"傳，有支上發傳朝日格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556165684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"神吉傳吉，主合可不求自至，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556182068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"無心中得。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556182068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"或神凶傳凶，主禍來不測，及占病、生産俱忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556198452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅日，干上午，三傳辰已午。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556214836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅日，干上午，三傳辰","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556231220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"已午。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556231220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日，干上戌，三傳子亥戌之𩔖是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556247604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"凡三傳，有干上發傳，及他處𤼵傳，歸支上。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556263988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"有支上自發","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556280372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"用","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556280372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1416,"lineType":2,"content":"闕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"作三傳者。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556280372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳朝支格如臣使君，子使父，不免","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556296756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"俯就于人，被人抑勒不自由。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556296756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相尤可，死囚更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556313140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"利卑","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556329524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562655856689202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"不利尊，利静不利動。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556329524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲午日，三傳辰已午，末傳引","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556345908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"入死地，縁何㑹好？","logicSentenceId":"7679068431556345908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"占病必死，行人未來。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"凡已午、未、申四位皆為天。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689269282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"如間傳遇辰午申，為登三天","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689285666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689285666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"葢龍登天則行雨，官登天位主遷轉，惟忌空脱，爭訟","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689302050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"事情轉大，占病症候彌深，賊來行人至，乆旱則雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689302050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"午","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689318434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"申戌為出三天格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689318434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"葢亢龍有悔，事情逺大，出行失約，病","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689334818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"訟皆凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689334818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"葢戌為天頭，有超三天之象矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689351202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"申戌子為涉","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689367586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562655856721970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"三淵格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689367586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"葢龍 null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辰午為出陽格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689515042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"葢午后陰","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689531426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1490,"lineType":1,"content":"生，自寅傳午，有出三陽之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689531426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":1490,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占，灾咎相仍，病訟皆凶","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689547810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562644834238500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":1494,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689547810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"丑夘已為出户格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689564194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"葢夘為門户，已為地户，自丑傳已，有","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689580578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1498,"lineType":1,"content":"人出户之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689580578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1498,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占訪人，不在行人出利幹望君子升掦，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689596962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"小人狐疑而不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689596962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"夘已未為盈陽格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689613346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"葢夘已為二陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689629730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"未乃陰之始，自夘傳已未，日中將仄，陽已至盈，物極必","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689629730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1504,"lineType":1,"content":"反故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689629730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1504,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事當急就之則吉，遲幹則為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689646114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1504,"lineType":1,"content":"已未酉為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689662498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"變盈格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689662498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"葢陽至午而盈，未為一陰，酉為二陰，自已傳酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689678882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1508,"lineType":1,"content":"物滿必缺， dList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"亥","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689809954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"丑夘為溟濛格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689809954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"葢亥丑陰極，夘為一陽始生，二陰之下","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689826338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1524,"lineType":1,"content":"有明在溟濛時之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689826338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":1524,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占事體不真，憂懼不寧，進","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689842722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"退未决也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689842722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":1532,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子戌為㝠陰格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689875490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1532,"lineType":1,"content":"葢寅為日出曉方，子戍陰氣盛旺，自","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689891874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"寅傳戌，有陽退入陰之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689891874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占事，自明入暗，凶暗在前，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689908258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"猶防暗損，占官最為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689908258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申為偃蹇格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689924642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"葢申亦陰","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689941026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1538,"lineType":1,"content":"方，自子傳申，以陰入陰，歴涉艱難，有重遭荆棘之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689941026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1538,"lineType":1,"content":"凡","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689957410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":1540,"lineType":1,"content":"舉迷暗不明，行軍被圍，出入作為，亦不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689957410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1540,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午為悖","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689973794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"戾格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689973794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"葢午為陰氣始生，申戌乃陰之盛旺，自深退淺，逃","logicSentenceId":"7679068431689990178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1544,"lineType":1,"content":"禍不能
