eIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"惟庚日占病，凶；占","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690121250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"官，大吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690121250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子為涉疑格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690137634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"葢陽主進，寅子不進而反","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690154018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1560,"lineType":1,"content":"退，又自明退入暗處，有涉歴疑難，莫知深淺之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690154018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1560,"lineType":1,"content":"占事，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690170402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1562,"lineType":1,"content":"進退不决，行人未來，欲出不出，闗渡防人賊，埋伏安營","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690170402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562644834304036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1566,"lineType":1,"content":"不吉，不可舉兵用事，官、病皆凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690170402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1568,"lineType":1,"content":"丑亥酉為極陰格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690186786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1568,"lineType":1,"content":"葢陰主退，自丑傳酉，而終於極，有陰","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690203170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1570,"lineType":1,"content":"入陰之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690203170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":1570,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占有淫泆、酒色、姦亂等事，病主死，訟至省","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690219554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1572,"lineType":1,"content":"部，或淫亂而生疾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690219554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1572,"lineType":1,"content":"亥主淫亂，酉主酒色耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690235938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":1572,"lineType":1,"content":"亥酉未為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690252322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"時遁格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690252322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"葢酉為太陰，未中丁為玉女，利隠遁潛形。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690268706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"自亥","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690285090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1576,"lineType":1,"content":"傳未，如人入幽暗求𨼆，有遁身之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690285090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1576,"lineType":1,"content":"占行人不來，出行","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690301474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1578,"lineType":1,"content":"不出，捕盜不獲，賊去不來，君子吉而小人凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690301474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1578,"lineType":1,"content":"酉未已","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690317858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1580,"lineType":1,"content":"為勵明格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690317858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":1580,"lineType":1,"content":"葢已為陽明之地，自酉傳已，從暗入明，有歴","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690334242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562644834336804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1584,"lineType":1,"content":"陰暗而后得明之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690334242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1584,"lineType":1,"content":"凡舉，皆由勉强而后去，君子利取","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690350626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"祿位，小人宜早營運也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690350626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"未已夘為回明格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690367010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"葢未為一陰，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690383394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1588,"lineType":1,"content":"已夘二陽，自未傳夘，由陰至陽，有缺月漸回之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690383394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1588,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690399778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"不可驟舉，只宜遲進。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690399778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"乆雨則晴，吉事漸成，凶事漸消也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690416162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"已夘丑為轉悖格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690432546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"葢已夘二陽，丑乃純陰，已入丑，避明","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690448930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"向暗，以巧就拙，乘正歸邪，事轉悖戾之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690448930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"主家零身怯","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690465314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"怪夢，作事似邪魔，隨事好出頭，不知省檢守分以安命","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690465314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690465314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"夘丑亥為斷澗格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690481698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"葢夘為一陽，丑亥二陰，自夘傳亥，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690498082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562644834353188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1602,"lineType":1,"content":"一陽深入二陰，陽明斷送，漸入深澗水底，有暗長明消","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690498082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1604,"lineType":1,"content":"之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690498082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1604,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占君子退職，小人遇凶事者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690514466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"以上陰陽各有三説。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690530850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"或以晝為陽，夜為陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690547234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"或以子丑、","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690563618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、夘、辰已為陽，午、未、申酉、戌亥為陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690563618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"或以子寅、辰午、","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690580002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"申戌為陽，丑夘、已、未、酉亥為陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690580002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"凡日干支有期限，又為闗隔。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690612770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"如三傳通連日干，為撞干","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690629154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690629154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"或初末傳撞日之闗，主事急及我若向前有為也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690645538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690661922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562655856787506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳自干支內發用，傳出日辰之外，事雖急而終閒慢。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690661922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"或自干支外發用，傳入干支之内，事先緩而後急也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690678306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"辛","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690694690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"已日，丑加夘，三傳丑亥酉，本是退間傳，凡事偃蹇阻滯，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690694690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"縁被末傳撞辛之闗，所以先緩而後急也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690694690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690711074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690727458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳通連日之支辰，為撞支格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690727458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"葢初末傳撞支之隔，主","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690743842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"事宜急，倐被動而我應之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690743842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"或傳帶日貴日財為用，末","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690760226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"傳墓絶，大不利貴人交易，因財而有所屈也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690760226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562662987022372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1638,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四課，三傳俱陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690792994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1638,"lineType":1,"content":"如三傳俱陰，為六純課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431690809378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1638,"lineType":1,"content":"如四課屬陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873736739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"中一課發用，并中未皆陽，為六陽課，宜尊貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873736739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"占天庭髙","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873753123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"尊事，初中空，君子畏之减力，常人賴之省力，未事得理。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873753123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"若四課陰，中一課發用，并中末俱陰，為六陰格。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873769507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"宜卑下。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873785891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"占陰謀奸私事，病者死。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873802275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"此六者，陰陽皆純，故名六純。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873818659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"占","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873835043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"孕，陽男陰女，統革之體，乃天淵懸隔之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873835043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：六陽動達，如登三天。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873851427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"私凶公吉，官遇陞遷。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873867811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"六陰朦","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873884195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"眛，似涉重淵，公凶私吉，病患纒延。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873884195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲午日，干上子，六","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873900579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562655856820274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"陽遇退間，傳為倒拔，蛇名悖戾。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873900579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"及𠔥初傳戌財，引入中","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873916963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"末鬼鄉，凡事艱辛，不免功勞。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873916963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"或夜傳晝，事有明白。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873933347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"或遇","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873949731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"五陽，以人年命定之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873949731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"或六陰遇丑夘已為出户夘，已未","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873966115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"為盈陽酉未已為勵明未，已夘為回明未，可以昏迷斷","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873966115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873966115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"凶中有吉，則應革。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873982499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"九五，大人虎𠮓之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431873998883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"如已夘日，酉","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874015267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"加未，六陰遇晝將入夜，昏迷尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874015267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"將乘后合玄，支干遇","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874031651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"盜氣彈射，發用坐空，費力不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874031651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"問病必死，求望虚耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874048035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"或遇五陰，以人年命定之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874064419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五陰相續，盗氣迤𨓦脱去，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874080803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562649498304564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"為源消根㫁，本命縁不攝而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874080803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占皆脱耗，則應革。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874097187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"上","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874113571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1676,"lineType":1,"content":"六，小人革面，征凶之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874113571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"十干辨假真。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874293795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"生雜本祖宗，死雜兩姓人。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874310179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1696,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵用得本長生者，上祖是本姓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":1698,"lineType":2,"content":"也。如甲乙日用亥戌已，壬癸日用申，庚辛用己，丙丁用寅，生雜卦也，故曰生雜本祖宗。如甲乙日用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1700,"lineType":2,"content":"未，丙丁日用戌，戊己壬癸日用辰，庚辛日用丑，為死雜卦。家中有兩姓人同居，故曰死雜兩姓人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"心鏡：　甲與已合，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874326563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"戊已宫中忌木尅，已來嫁甲合親情。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874342947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"六月已回歸奉戊，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874359331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"瓜菓雖熟色帶青。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874359331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1706,"lineType":2,"content":"六月木死土旺，己却歸戊，故懐木胎。𤓰菓雖熟，尚帶青色，為懐木胎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙東方木畏金，甲將乙妹去合庚。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874392099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"春時木旺乙歸本，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874408483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"所以縁木開瓊花。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874408483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1714,"lineType":2,"content":"東方木畏西方金，尅甲兄乙妹，将乙配與庚合，至春木旺金囚，乙却還東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1716,"lineType":2,"content":"方。木色青，金色白，乙懐庚胎歸還，所以春開白花，是乙中有金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛性怯，南方火，便以妹辛丙合同。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874441251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"秋間火死辛歸去，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874457635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"棗赤霜刑葉落紅。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874457635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1722,"lineType":2,"content":"丙火死，辛歸庚，刑殺萬物，葉落棗亦成赤色帶紅，為辛帶丙色，有火氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"北方水懼中央土，戊癸成親燕新粧。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874539555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬水旺癸還合，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874555939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"土孕懐凝殺草黄。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874555939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1736,"lineType":2,"content":"立冬水旺土囚，癸懐土胎而歸，故殺百草而有黄色，為癸中有土氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課俱取初傳動爻，以别五行純雜數目物色為用，曰","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874588707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"雜狀課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874588707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"純者，子午夘酉四仲為純。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874605091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"寅中有生火，一雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874621475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874637859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562655856853042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"中有水土墓，二、三雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874637859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"已中有生金，四雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874654243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"申中有生土，五","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874670627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874670627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"未中有木墓，六雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874687011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"又申中有生水，七雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874703395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"戌中有火墓，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874719779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"八雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874719779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中有生木，九雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874736163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"丑中有金墓，十雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874752547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅夘為木，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874768931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"春寅懐火雜木，故夘為純木也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874768931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"季火金水皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874785315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"惟土守","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874801699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"中宫，分旺四季，毎季前各旺十八日，總七十二日，合而","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874801699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"成嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874801699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"故辰中有餘木，未有餘火，戌中有餘金，丑中有餘","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874818083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1758,"lineType":1,"content":"水，各十二日。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874818083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1758,"lineType":1,"content":"然四孟月懐胎，仲月娠壯，季月死墓葬，為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874834467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"五行十雜，紛紜衆事，其應不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874834467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562662987087908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：五行陰陽，萬物純雜，凶視救神，吉防害鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874850851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"數目日","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874867235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1766,"lineType":1,"content":"期，顔色物類，覔物尋人，克應可取。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874867235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":1766,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙初用亥例為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874883619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1768,"lineType":1,"content":"生雜，家是上祖本姓人居住。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874883619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1768,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日用丑例是死雜，家","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874900003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":1770,"lineType":1,"content":"有兩姓同居也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874900003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1770,"lineType":1,"content":"如戌為五數，加未八數，吉凶應在五八","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874916387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"四十日，或四個月，旺相倍數，休囚减之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874916387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562649498386484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1782,"lineType":1,"content":"凡課俱取初傳動爻，以别五行、六親、物類、親踈、旺相、休","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874965539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"囚為用，曰物類課。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874965539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙日，日干及寅夘𤼵用，為已身","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874981923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"同𩔖占。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874981923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為兄，夘為弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431874998307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"寅中甲為姐，辰中乙為妹。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875014691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875031075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為伯之兄弟，未中乙為叔之兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875031075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"子為父，亥為母。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875047459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"亥","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875063843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1790,"lineType":1,"content":"中壬為伯，丑中癸為叔。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875063843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1790,"lineType":1,"content":"申中壬為長姑，辰中癸為小姑。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875080227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"申為祖父，酉為祖母。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875096611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"已中庚金為伯祖，戌中辛金為叔","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875112995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"祖，丑中辛金為祖姑。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875112995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"未墓為妻，辰為繼妻，丑為妾，戌","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875129379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"為婢妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875129379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"土生庚申金，為媒人。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875145763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"午為男，已為女。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875162147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"寅中火為","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875178531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562649498402868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1800,"lineType":1,"content":"兄之男女，未中火為弟之男女，戌中火為姐妹之男女。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875178531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"生祖者為曽祖，生曾祖者為髙祖。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875194915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"男生者為孫，孫生者","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875211299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":1804,"lineType":1,"content":"為玄孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875211299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":1804,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日，火，戊已日，土，庚辛日，金，壬癸日，水。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875227683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1804,"lineType":1,"content":"六親","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875244067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，各倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875244067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"惟妻妾則陽為妻，陰為妾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875260451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"若占父母，","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875276835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":1808,"lineType":1,"content":"要父母出現；占子孫，要子孫出現。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875276835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1808,"lineType":1,"content":"或父母興旺，則克子","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875293219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875293219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟興旺，必克妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875309603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相相生吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875325987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚刑克凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875342371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"陽神","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875358755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"下臨陽宫，有徳合為親，入陰宫為踈。","logicSentenceId":"7679068431875358755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"陰神下臨隂宫，有","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020537379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"徳合為親，入陽宫為踈。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020537379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"更以神將吉凶叅詳，則富貴貧","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020553763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562662987104292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":1818,"lineType":1,"content":"賤存亡，應驗瞭然可見此六親吉凶之族類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020553763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1818,"lineType":1,"content":"如剛日","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020570147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1820,"lineType":1,"content":"用起陽神，旺相，有氣加日上是新物。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020570147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":1820,"lineType":1,"content":"用起陰神，休囚，無","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020586531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"氣加日上是舊物。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020586531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"或甲日日辰見亥乃木生，為生事，將","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020602915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"來新物，應在父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020602915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"見夘乃木旺，為目下事，主不新不舊","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020619299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":1826,"lineType":1,"content":"之物，憂在同類、已身朋友。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020619299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1826,"lineType":1,"content":"見未乃木死處，為死事，主已","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020635683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1828,"lineType":1,"content":"過舊事及舊物，憂在妻奴下人。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020635683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":1828,"lineType":1,"content":"又剛日用神在干前為","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020652067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":1830,"lineType":1,"content":"未來，干後為過去。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020652067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":1830,"lineType":1,"content":"柔日用在干前為過去，干後為未來。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020668451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":1832,"lineType":1,"content":"或乙日屬陰，婦徳從夫，日上見辰為陽，是生新物。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020684835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":1832,"lineType":1,"content":"見未","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020701219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562655856885810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":1836,"lineType":1,"content":"為陰，亦是新物，乃陰徳在陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020701219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":1836,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚化金，辰已金生處，未","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020717603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":1838,"lineType":1,"content":"亦金冠帶之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020717603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":1838,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加日上為死，故物，金死墓於丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020733987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"此陰陽盛衰生死新舊之物類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020750371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"如初傳旺相神將吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020766755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"末傳囚死神將凶，為始吉終凶，事先成後敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020766755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"若初傳休","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020783139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"囚神將凶，帶刑害。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020783139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"未傳旺相神將吉，見合徳救制。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020799523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"為始","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020815907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"凶終吉，事先難後遂。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020815907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"此始終吉凶之物類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020832291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"統節之體，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020848675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1848,"lineType":1,"content":"乃蜃氣樓台之課也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020848675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：物以聲應，方以類萃。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020865059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"六親俱現，以用為主。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020881443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相吉","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020897827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562667848204328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"言，休囚凶語。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020897827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"始終吉凶，神將分取。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020914211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙推六親，見亥","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020930595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"夘為今日族類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020930595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"或用起水神，無氣乘凶將，占者當憂","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020946979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1858,"lineType":1,"content":"父母長上及文書。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020946979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1858,"lineType":1,"content":"見木神，憂已身兄弟，及同類爭財事。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020963363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1860,"lineType":1,"content":"見土，為妻奴及婚姻財産事。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020979747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1860,"lineType":1,"content":"推類神，見亥為猪，夘兔未","logicSentenceId":"7679068432020996131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"羊，及酒 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2309","lineNum":2226,"lineType":1,"content":"戊黄，己絳，蓋黄者，中央正色，象黄中通理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403120163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2310","lineNum":2226,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土畏木，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403136547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562679906844711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2312","lineNum":2230,"lineType":1,"content":"以己妹嫁甲木為妻，戊往召已，己懐木氣以應甲，故","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403136547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2313","lineNum":2232,"lineType":1,"content":"有間色綘也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403136547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2314","lineNum":2234,"lineType":1,"content":"子黑，午赤，夘青，酉白，寅碧，申黑，白，已班㸃，亥淡青。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403152931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2315","lineNum":2234,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌、","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403169315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2316","lineNum":2236,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未純黄。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403169315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2317","lineNum":2236,"lineType":1,"content":"寅夘為木，春旺時寅懐火，故夘為純木，寅為","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403185699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2318","lineNum":2238,"lineType":1,"content":"雜木。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403185699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2319","lineNum":2238,"lineType":1,"content":"已午為火，夏旺時已懐金，故午為純火，已為雜火。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403202083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2320","lineNum":2240,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉為金，秋旺時申懐水，故酉為純金，申為雜金。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403218467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2321","lineNum":2240,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403234851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2322","lineNum":2242,"lineType":1,"content":"為水，冬旺時亥懐木，故子為純水，亥為雜水。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403234851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2323","lineNum":2242,"lineType":1,"content":"土居中央，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403251235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":2244,"lineType":1,"content":"分旺四季，故春、夏、秋、冬，辰、戌、丑、未月，各寄旺十八日，四","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403251235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562673636556810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":2248,"lineType":1,"content":"季共七十二日。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403251235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":2248,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之旺，各為三百六十日，以為一嵗","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403267619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":2250,"lineType":1,"content":"功成。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403267619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":2250,"lineType":1,"content":"故辰中有餘木，未中有餘火，戌中有餘金，丑中有","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403284003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":2252,"lineType":1,"content":"餘水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403284003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":2252,"lineType":1,"content":"故十二日，木死於未，火死於戌，金死於丑，水死","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403300387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":2254,"lineType":1,"content":"於辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403300387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":2254,"lineType":1,"content":"故四孟之月，為懐，生氣之所由也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403316771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":2254,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲之月為正","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403333155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"位，盛旺之所立也；四季之月為死氣，葬送之所由也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403333155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403349539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":2258,"lineType":1,"content":"五行十雜，其應不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403349539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":2258,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽五行，萬物所存，吉凶之應，各","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403365923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":2260,"lineType":1,"content":"以其類。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403365923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":2260,"lineType":1,"content":"或吉中有凶，或凶中有吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403382307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":2260,"lineType":1,"content":"徴吉而有大凶，或徴","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403398691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"凶而有大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403398691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"凶則視其所救，吉則視其所害。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403415075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"凶而有救，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403431459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562667848417320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":2266,"lineType":1,"content":"不致于禍；吉而有害，不及于慶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403431459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":2266,"lineType":1,"content":"純凶則禍成，純吉則福","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403447843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":2268,"lineType":1,"content":"生。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403447843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":2268,"lineType":1,"content":"言舉百事，姓音不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403464227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":2268,"lineType":1,"content":"一云五情不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403480611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":2268,"lineType":1,"content":"時日神將，上下","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403496995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"不和，四時旺相，新故差别。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403496995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"和同則吉，乖異則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403513379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"凶則有","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403529763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":2272,"lineType":1,"content":"短，吉則有長。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403529763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":2272,"lineType":1,"content":"紛紛衆事，其應不同者，言五行各有所利，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403546147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":2274,"lineType":1,"content":"各有所傷，故曰不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403546147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":2274,"lineType":1,"content":"各懐其子，以救其窮者，土中有金，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403562531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":2276,"lineType":1,"content":"金中有水，水中有木，木中有火，火中有土，此懐子救母","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403562531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":2278,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403562531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2361","lineNum":2278,"lineType":1,"content":"萬類消息，盡在其中，不可不明。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403578915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2362","lineNum":2280,"lineType":1,"content":"乙中金刑已中之木；已中木刑癸中之土；癸中土刑丁","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403595299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562679906861095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"中之水；丁中水刑辛中之火；辛中火刑乙中之金，是","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403595299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":2286,"lineType":1,"content":"謂五刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403595299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":2288,"lineType":1,"content":"乙中之金，從魁傳送是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403611683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":2288,"lineType":1,"content":"于物為斧斤，于人為下賤土","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403628067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":2290,"lineType":1,"content":"匠人形為頭口咽喉、缺齒，于色為白，於怪為釡鳴。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403628067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":2292,"lineType":1,"content":"已中之木，功曺太冲是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403644451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":2292,"lineType":1,"content":"于物為船車樹木，于人形有","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403660835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":2294,"lineType":1,"content":"奇骨聳起，若病為癰腫，于色為青，于怪為音聲，于畜","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403660835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":2296,"lineType":1,"content":"為野獸驢兔。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403660835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":2298,"lineType":1,"content":"癸中之土，辰戌丑未是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403677219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":2298,"lineType":1,"content":"于物為磚瓦泥土類，于人形","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403693603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562679906893863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":2302,"lineType":1,"content":"為大頭腹腫黄，四肢癰腫，于色為黄，于怪為風塵，垣","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403693603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":2304,"lineType":1,"content":"壁崩頽，孔穴土聚，于畜為子母牛羊狐犬類。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403693603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":2306,"lineType":1,"content":"丁中之水，登明神后是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403709987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":2306,"lineType":1,"content":"于人形為腎，于色為黑，于怪","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403726371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":2308,"lineType":1,"content":"為井沸，于畜為鼠猪。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403726371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":2310,"lineType":1,"content":"辛中之火，太乙、勝光是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403742755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":2310,"lineType":1,"content":"于物為文書、皮毛、文章、爐冶、","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403759139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":2312,"lineType":1,"content":"血光、飛鳥，于人形為髭髪、赤目、有蒼缺損、股腫有疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403759139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":2314,"lineType":1,"content":"于色為赤，于怪為光明，于畜為馬蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403775523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":2314,"lineType":1,"content":"言十二辰以觀","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403791907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":2316,"lineType":1,"content":"親踈也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403791907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562686546411572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":2320,"lineType":9,"content":"親踈","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403808291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":2322,"lineType":1,"content":"日與辰三六合者為親，不合者為踈。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403824675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":2324,"lineType":1,"content":"生日干者父母，如甲乙日以子為父，亥為母，壬癸為外","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403841059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":2326,"lineType":1,"content":"翁姑，午為子，已為女，丙丁為外孫，寅為伯為兄，夘為","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403841059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2392","lineNum":2328,"lineType":1,"content":"為叔為弟，甲為姐，乙為妹。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432403841059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":2328,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未為妻妾。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486105128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":2330,"lineType":1,"content":"日干所尅為正妻，如甲乙見土，丙丁見金，戊己見水，庚","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486121512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":2332,"lineType":1,"content":"辛見木，壬癸見火是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486121512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2396","lineNum":2332,"lineType":1,"content":"以干之墓神為妾，如甲乙見","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486137896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2397","lineNum":2334,"lineType":1,"content":"未，丙丁見戌，庚辛見丑，戊已壬癸日見辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486137896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562667848515624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2399","lineNum":2338,"lineType":1,"content":"妻前一位為媒人，己為甲妻，則己前庚與申為媒。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486154280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2400","lineNum":2338,"lineType":1,"content":"乙為","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486170664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2401","lineNum":2340,"lineType":1,"content":"庚妻，則乙前丙與己為媒。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486170664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2402","lineNum":2340,"lineType":1,"content":"辛為丙妻，則辛前壬與亥","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486187048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2403","lineNum":2342,"lineType":1,"content":"為媒。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486187048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2404","lineNum":2342,"lineType":1,"content":"丁為壬妻，則下前庚與申為媒。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486203432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2405","lineNum":2342,"lineType":1,"content":"癸為戊妻，則癸","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486219816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2406","lineNum":2344,"lineType":1,"content":"前甲與寅為媒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486219816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2407","lineNum":2346,"lineType":1,"content":"日干所尅干神為奴婢，如甲乙日戊己；丙丁日，庚辛之","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486236200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2408","lineNum":2348,"lineType":1,"content":"𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486236200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2409","lineNum":2348,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，干屬外，支屬内。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486252584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2410","lineNum":2348,"lineType":1,"content":"外翁姑、外甥、奴婢，皆以干言。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486268968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2411","lineNum":2350,"lineType":1,"content":"媒辰所合為親家，如申為媒，則夘為親家，乙庚合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486285352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2412","lineNum":2350,"lineType":1,"content":"已","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486301736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2413","lineNum":2352,"lineType":1,"content":"為媒，則戌為親家，丙辛合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486301736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2414","lineNum":2352,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為媒，則未為親家，丁","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486318120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562673636573194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2416","lineNum":2356,"lineType":1,"content":"壬合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486318120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2417","lineNum":2356,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為媒，則未為親家，甲己合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486334504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2418","lineNum":2358,"lineType":1,"content":"子日見亥，寅日見夘。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486350888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2419","lineNum":2358,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰同氣，為本家人。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486367272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2420","lineNum":2358,"lineType":1,"content":"子見丑，丑見","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486383656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2421","lineNum":2360,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，為隣人。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432486383656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2504","lineNum":2448,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為已徳，合庚與乙為徳，丙與辛為宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487317544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2505","lineNum":2448,"lineType":1,"content":"丁徳配在壬，癸","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487333928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2506","lineNum":2450,"lineType":1,"content":"徳配在戊。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487333928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2507","lineNum":2450,"lineType":1,"content":"生死後篇推。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487350312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2508","lineNum":2450,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生原在亥，未是死根基。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487366696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2509","lineNum":2450,"lineType":1,"content":"丙生","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487383080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2510","lineNum":2452,"lineType":1,"content":"寅上是死，戌是分離。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487383080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2511","lineNum":2452,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戊生傳送，天罡見死悲。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487399464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2512","lineNum":2452,"lineType":1,"content":"庚來生","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487415848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2513","lineNum":2454,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙，大吉死無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487415848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2514","lineNum":2454,"lineType":1,"content":"生加日辰上，凡事煥為新。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487432232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2515","lineNum":2454,"lineType":1,"content":"死加日辰","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487448616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2516","lineNum":2456,"lineType":1,"content":"上，凡事更無新。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487448616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2517","lineNum":2456,"lineType":2,"content":"假令甲乙日登明加甲上為新，故曰換為新。如今日甲乙小吉加甲為故，剛日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2532","lineNum":2476,"lineType":1,"content":"新故陰陽不易分，剛柔異類辨斯文。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487546920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2533","lineNum":2476,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日用陽及有氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487563304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2534","lineNum":2478,"lineType":1,"content":"是物裝成不染塵。","logicSentenceId":"7679068432487563304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2535","lineNum":2478,"lineType":2,"content":"剛日用起陽神及有氣神加日上，并主生氣，曰物乃是新物。柔日用起陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2562","lineNum":1930,"lineType":1,"content":"凡空亡有要見，有不要見者，後學不辯，一例而言之，","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189499954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2563","lineNum":1932,"lineType":1,"content":"誠可惜哉。","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189499954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2564","lineNum":1932,"lineType":1,"content":"且夫天盤作空亡者，謂之逰行空亡，其","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189516338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2565","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶有七八分。","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189516338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2566","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"如地盤作空亡者，謂之落底空亡，","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189532722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2567","lineNum":1936,"lineType":1,"content":"其吉凶有十分。","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189532722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2568","lineNum":1936,"lineType":1,"content":"此不可不知之。","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189549106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2569","lineNum":1936,"lineType":1,"content":"且言要空亡者，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189565490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2570","lineNum":1938,"lineType":1,"content":"尅盗墓神及神遥尅日，已上皆要空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189565490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2571","lineNum":1938,"lineType":1,"content":"唯生我者","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189581874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2572","lineNum":1940,"lineType":1,"content":"及救神并天徳生炁財官及日遥尅神，并不宜空","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189581874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2573","lineNum":1942,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，皆返為凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189581874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":1942,"lineType":1,"content":"尤有遇不遇者，有五等於後。","logicSentenceId":"7679070367189598258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
